jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Are you ready to see your career take flight? At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen.

The Source Change Manager role will lead a portfolio of source changes (supplier to supplier or NPI) through the CEM Source Change Process. This role will be responsible for the planning and execution of source changes while ensuring compliance to all relevant GE processes. They will partner with the Quality, Engineering, Delivery, and Source Change leadership to drive OTD, executional excellence and reduce source change lead time.

Job Description

Role Overview:

  • Uses judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems that impact the function. Takes new perspective on existing solutions. Uses technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations. Uses multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own function to arrive at decisions.
  • Accountable for the execution of their assigned source change portfolio with the lead KPIs being OTD and continuity of supply.
  • Partners with supplier teams and suppliers ensuring adequate planning and execution of source changes
  • Participates in SCM daily management to ensure top issues are being adequately problem solved
  • Acts as first line of problem solving for manufacturing and readiness challenges inherent to a source executing an NPI
  • Leverages industry project management standards to drive clear actioning, communication, and escalations.
  • Deploys FLIGHT DECK fundamentals to support team problem solving

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with at least 9 years of experience in aerospace and/or manufacturing).
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in aerospace and/or manufacturing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 30%, based on business needs
  • Flexibility to work across local and U.S. time zones as needed
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including planning, execution, risk management, and cross-functional coordination
  • Proven ability to lead projects across multiple stakeholders, ensuring milestones, deliverables, and business objectives are achieved
  • Experience managing project schedules, priorities, and resource coordination in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to drive execution and resolve issues effectively
  • English language proficiency at CEFR C1 level or above
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
  • Proven demonstration of knowledge and application of FLIGHT DECK principles to drive organizational efficiencies and Standard Work, along with demonstrated Problem Solving experience

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an experienced aerospace professional with strong shop floor credibility, solid project management skills, and a track record of driving execution across suppliers and cross-functional teams. They are action-oriented, data-driven, and skilled at solving problems quickly to protect delivery and continuity of supply. A strong communicator and collaborator, they thrive in fast-paced environments and use FLIGHT DECK fundamentals to drive accountability, continuous improvement, and results.

TITLE: Remote Xactimate Mitigation Estimator (Water / Mold / Fire) - Full Time, US Eastern Hours

LOCATION: Remote (Philippines preferred; open to other locations that can reliably cover US Eastern hours)

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM Eastern

PAY: $13-16/hr USD, depending on experience. Paid weekly in USD via Wise.

REPORTS TO: Office Operations Manager (Carissa Lawrence)

ABOUT US

Dreyer's DKI is a water damage, mold, fire and reconstruction restoration company in the Gainesville / Alachua County, Florida area. Our mission is Restoring Peace in Crisis. Our values: Humility, Unity, Growth, Ownership, Stewardship.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Write Xactimate mitigation estimates for water, mold, and fire/smoke jobs from photos, moisture logs, drying records, sketches, and field notes
  • Draft claim narrative summaries (cause of loss, affected areas, Category/Class)

jobs.description:
The Amazon Account Manager runs day-to-day operations of Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts for Hustler Marketing's clients, manages Amazon PPC advertising, and owns the client relationship. The goal is simple: help each client sell more, profitably, on Amazon.

You will work across multiple brands and marketplaces, mainly the UK, EU, and US, as well as Canada, Mexico, Australia, and Japan. You will analyze sales, inventory, and advertising data, find what is limiting growth, recommend what to do, and make it happen. You will also be the client’s main point of contact.

Amazon changes constantly, so much of this role is solving problems no one has written instructions for. You will have the support of the wider team, training on our processes, and regular feedback to help you grow.

About the Role

Mission statement

Keep our clients’ Amazon accounts running accurately and grow their businesses through sound operations, effective advertising, data-driven decisions, and proactive communication.

Sales on Amazon come from a few fundamentals: stock availability, listing quality, advertising, pricing, and promotions. You will own these for the accounts you handle, understand each client’s objectives, recommend priorities, and make sure agreed actions are delivered.

General Responsibilities

Operations

  • Manage day-to-day Seller Central and Vendor Central operations across marketplaces
  • Forecast demand from sales history, calculate replenishment quantities, and prevent stockouts
  • Identify excess inventory and recommend actions
  • Create and coordinate shipments to Amazon warehouses
  • Support product launches and set up promotions
  • Upload and optimize product content to improve listing quality
  • Monitor listings, investigate issues and resolve them with Amazon Support

Advertising

  • Set up, manage and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns
  • Conduct keyword research and search term analysis to find relevant targeting opportunities
  • Manage campaign structure, targeting, bids, budgets, placements and negative keywords
  • Track ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC and conversion rates, and judge them by their effect on overall profitability
  • Test new approaches, fix underperforming campaigns and reallocate budget to what works
  • Align advertising with inventory, pricing, promotions and launches

Clients and analysis

  • Act as the primary point of contact and build strong client relationships
  • Lead regular meetings on performance, challenges, opportunities and priorities
  • Develop account strategies based on each client’s goals and resources
  • Analyze performance across products, variations and categories to find trends and opportunities
  • Build clear reports and turn complex data into actionable recommendations
  • Set realistic timelines, give regular updates and follow through on commitments
  • Balance client requests with operational needs and team capacity

Improvement

  • Investigate unfamiliar problems to their root cause and find practical solutions
  • Improve account management processes for efficiency and accuracy
  • Collaborate with the team to align priorities and deliver strategies
  • Take part in regular training and feedback sessions

Position Specs

  • Fully remote position
  • Ready to start as soon as possible
  • Start on a probationary period at an hourly rate.
  • Opportunity to transition into a full-time position within the Amazon Operations team with a fixed-rate monthly salary following a successful probation period
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the probationary period
  • Vacation days based on your country of residence, plus national holidays
  • Regular training, feedback sessions, and professional development opportunities

Requirements

About You

Profile

You have hands-on experience with Seller Central or Vendor Central, Amazon PPC, and direct client communication. You understand what drives a brand’s sales on Amazon and can manage several accounts while balancing operations, advertising, and client needs.

You are comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can evaluate performance, calculate inventory needs, spot stock risks, and understand how metrics like ACoS, TACoS, and ROAS connect to the client’s overall business.

You are a resourceful problem-solver. When something unfamiliar comes up, you investigate, test possible solutions, and act. When things go wrong, you explain your reasoning to clients clearly and keep their confidence.

You are detail-oriented, organized, and accountable, and you can turn client objectives into clear plans. You are humble, open to feedback, comfortable working remotely, and motivated to grow your Amazon expertise.

Key Traits for This Position

  • Analytical: You reason from data, spot patterns, and back every recommendation with clear logic.
  • Commercially aware: You understand how operational and advertising decisions affect sales and profit, and you prioritize what matters most.
  • Client-focused: You lead conversations confidently, ask good questions, handle difficult discussions, and keep trust through transparency.
  • Curious and adaptable: You learn new processes quickly and work toward solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Ownership-driven: You are organized and accurate, follow through, and turn recommendations into measurable results.

Key Requirements

  • Practical experience with Seller Central or Vendor Central
  • Hands-on experience with Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display
  • Strong understanding of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, and conversion rates

  • Independent problem-solving with the judgement to ask for help when needed

  • Positive, humble, and collaborative, and open to feedback
  • Comfortable working remotely in a distributed team
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Fluency in additional European languages is a plus
  • Available to start as soon as possible

Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Product Manager, Compliance Operations, owns the operational management of Humana’s FHIR APIs and healthcare interoperability products. This role is accountable for day-to-day API operations, end-to-end partner onboarding, production support, operational performance, and continuous operational improvement.

The role serves as the primary business owner for the operational experience of providers, payers, third-party applications, and other approved partners using Humana’s interoperability APIs, coordinating closely with IT and other stakeholder teams to maintain reliable, scalable, and effective API operations.

The Lead Product Manager, Compliance Operations, leads the ongoing operations of Humana’s healthcare interoperability and FHIR API products. This role owns the operational lifecycle of the APIs, including day-to-day operations, partner onboarding, production support, issue and escalation management, operational performance, and continuous improvement.


The Lead Product Manager owns the end-to-end onboarding experience for providers, payers, third-party applications, and other approved partners, from initial request through access and connectivity, testing, production enablement, and transition to ongoing support.


Following onboarding, this role owns the support model for the FHIR APIs, coordinating with IT and other stakeholder teams to triage and resolve production issues, manage escalations, communicate with partners, and identify recurring operational concerns.


The role also owns continuous operational improvement of the FHIR API ecosystem. Operational trends, onboarding friction, recurring support issues, incidents, and opportunities for automation or process improvement are translated into operational enhancements and prioritized into the product backlog. Business and strategic product enhancements remain outside the scope of this role.


Regulatory Compliance retains primary ownership for regulatory interpretation and compliance oversight. The Lead Product Manager supports Regulatory Compliance by maintaining operational information and providing API, onboarding, support, and performance data as requested.

jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Developer – Web Development & UX, you will join an award-winning creative, marketing, and advertising agency supporting a diverse portfolio of multi-industry client accounts across digital experiences, print, web, email, and analytics.Operating across varied technical environments, you will serve as the hands-on technical engine delivering everything from new custom website builds, landing pages, and campaign microsites to responsive HTML email templates and marketing automation integrations.

This is not a visual page-builder or no-code role. You will step into a dynamic agency setting requiring genuine computer science fundamentals, strong legacy code comprehension, and sharp troubleshooting skills. You will take ownership of maintaining and modernizing inherited codebases—including sites built over a decade ago—while collaborating with creative and design teams to ensure that technical execution reflects high standards of usability, responsive architecture,and user experience.

Accountability

As a Developer – Web Development & UX, your success will be defined by your ability to reliably engineer, launch,maintain, and troubleshoot performant, responsive digital solutions across diverse client technical stacks and CMS platforms.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Website Development, CMS Architecture & New Builds

  • Translate approved creative concepts, business requirements, and design specifications into clean, responsive, and maintainable web pages and websites.
  • Build custom landing pages, campaign-specific microsites, and reusable component architectures across varied project scopes.
  • Architect and maintain custom WordPress implementations using custom themes, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF),and Gutenberg blocks, while supporting existing page-builder instances (Divi, Elementor).
  • Develop, configure, and maintain Drupal content structures, custom content types, taxonomy fields, and core modules.
  • Support HubSpot CMS development, including custom landing pages, interactive forms, and marketing automation components.
  • Execute pre-deployment testing, cross-browser validation, and responsive device testing to ensure launch readiness and seamless post-launch fixes.

Legacy Codebase Maintenance, Debugging & Troubleshooting

  • Review, understand, and debug complex, unfamiliar inherited client codebases and legacy systems dating back over ten years.
  • Investigate broken functionality, technical defects, layout regressions, and CMS-related conflicts without destabilizing existing features.
  • Implement targeted patches, updates, and architectural refactors while preserving full backward compatibility with older hosting and software environments.
  • Support ongoing site maintenance schedules, security updates, and plugin/module upgrades across an extensive multi-client roster.
  • Maintain rigorous documentation around legacy system quirks, architectural dependencies, and technical remediation steps.

HTML Email Development & Campaign Integrations

  • Code responsive, cross-client HTML email templates built from scratch to render consistently across major desktop and mobile email clients.
  • Develop, test, and maintain email assets across specialized platforms including Stripo, Mailchimp, Constant Contact,and HubSpot Email.
  • Troubleshoot rendering anomalies, client-specific CSS quirks, and formatting issues inherent to email platforms.
  • Implement dynamic content, forms, and tracking mechanisms aligned with campaign requirements.

API Connections, Enterprise Coordination & UX Collaboration

  • Connect websites and digital properties to external systems, CRMs, and third-party web services via REST APIs.
  • Troubleshoot data flows, form endpoints, and webhook connections, documenting integration behavior and data mapping.
  • Interface with external implementation partners and support scoping, dependencies, and technical oversight for enterprise platforms (including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CRM, Adobe Experience Manager, and TYPO3).
  • Partner with UI/UX designers and creative leads during project scoping to evaluate technical feasibility, identify potential usability roadblocks, and advocate for practical UX, intuitive navigation, and accessibility standards.

Multi-Client Technical Operations & Quality Assurance

  • Manage multiple concurrent development tasks and shifting deadlines across distinct client environments with high autonomy.
  • Conduct comprehensive end-to-end QA, functional testing, form validation, and performance audits to optimize page load speeds and responsiveness.
  • Coordinate clear, structured technical handoffs and status tracking across project management tools to ensure operational continuity.

Colleagues

You will work directly with the Chief Operating Officer and the Technical Director overseeing developer and studio operations, while coordinating closely with the Technical Requirements Lead to align on platform priorities and architecture. On a day-to-day basis, you will collaborate with cross-functional agency teams—including UI/UX designers,production artists, copywriters, project managers, and data analysts—while liaising with external platform specialists.

At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Developer – Web Development & UX, your vertical strength will be foundational web development and legacy CMS architecture, while your horizontal capabilities should span practical UX design collaboration, cross-platform technical troubleshooting, and multi-client project delivery.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Foundational Experience: 4+ years of hands-on web development experience, demonstrating deep proficiency with HTML5, CSS3/SASS, JavaScript, and modern responsive design principles. Experience within an agency or multi-client setting is strongly preferred.
  • Legacy Code & CMS Mastery: Demonstrated experience understanding, modifying, and debugging inherited or legacy codebases without documentation. Strong hands-on development expertise in WordPress (custom themes,ACF, Gutenberg) and practical exposure to Drupal.
  • Email & Landing Page Platforms: Proven ability to hand-code responsive HTML emails across Stripo, Mailchimp,Constant Contact, and HubSpot, understanding platform-specific email client constraints.
  • Systems, APIs & Integrations: Practical experience integrating third-party APIs, troubleshooting data connections,and managing forms across CMS and CRM ecosystems.
  • Tooling & Workflow: Familiarity with collaborative tools and project management systems such as Microsoft Teams, Notion, Workfront, or Wrike, paired with structured version control workflows.
  • Mindset & Problem-Solving: High autonomy, intellectual curiosity, patience when diagnosing obscure technical defects, and strong communication skills to explain technical realities to non-technical partners. Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools as an accelerator while maintaining complete independent ownership over code validity and debugging.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Legacy Code Debugging & Problem-Solving: How do you approach navigating, diagnosing, and fixing broken functionality in an undocumented codebase built over a decade ago?
  • CMS Architecture & Custom Development: What is your methodology for building custom, maintainable WordPress themes and Drupal configurations beyond pre-built page builders?
  • HTML Email Engineering: How do you handle cross-client rendering constraints, responsive styling, and fallback logic across varied email platforms?
  • UX & Design Alignment: How do you collaborate with creative designers during scoping to balance visual ambition with technical feasibility, accessibility, and intuitive usability?
  • Multi-Client Execution & Prioritization: How do you manage concurrent development priorities across multiple client accounts while ensuring delivery rigor and clean handoffs?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

jobs.description:
Company overview

Veracross is a private-equity-backed leading SaaS EdTech company that has grown 4x in size in 3 years and has consistent industry-leading high retention rates. We serve front line educators with the only market disrupting open API single record architecture in the greater than $5B EdTech market. To date we have configured and deployed our product at over 1,000 leading private K-12 schools in over 20 countries.

Role summary

A Specialist Implementation Manager independently leads all aspects of successful implementations of Veracross or Digistorm software. The role calls for a strong understanding of Veracross or Digistorm software, excellent project management skills, and effective communication (written and verbal). Projects are executed on time and on budget, while fostering trusting relationships with implementing schools and their staff. Specialist Implementation Managers build deep expertise in one or more products and help grow that capability across the team.

This role is based in Australia and supports schools across the APAC region.

Job Responsibilities

    • Guide customer implementation projects across one or more Veracross or Digistorm products/modules. The process includes:
      • Department discovery: working with each implementing department to understand their workflows and needs, and how they connect across school operations.
      • Platform transition options consulting: discovery-infused platform setup options presented, demoed, revised, and finally agreed upon.
      • Change management: orchestrate successful change management, where tailored configurations are office-tested, revised, approved, and deployed, with care given to each department's daily operations.
      • Department workflow consulting: model and document the ways the school's different departments will use the Veracross or Digistorm product(s) across their first operational year.
    • Develop, coordinate, and execute project plans, task schedules, and resource activities to ensure on-time and effective project delivery
    • Work with the Lead Project Manager to build implementation plans covering configuration, data migration and go-live readiness
    • Advise schools on best-practice configuration and how their data and processes connect across products and integrated systems
    • Lead direct training engagements for multiple school departments, and ensure school personnel complete required self-paced trainings
    • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure all phases of the implementation are executed as necessary
    • Act as an internal subject matter expert in one or more Veracross or Digistorm products, coaching other Implementation Managers and helping build team capability
    • Develop tailored support handoffs after go-live and contribute to internal documentation and best practices for implementations
    • Gather client feedback and work with internal teams to improve the implementation process and product offerings

Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
    • 2+ years of experience in technical project management, implementing Veracross or Digistorm, or other SaaS-based software solutions, ideally including data conversion
    • Experience working in or with an independent school a plus
    • Experience with school information systems or other school-facing software a plus
    • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including comfort with public speaking, presentation delivery, and presenting to school leaders and department heads
    • Ability to make complex decisions and recommendations under limited direction, using a high degree of initiative and independent judgement
    • Ability to learn complex, enterprise-level software systems at a level that supports teaching others
    • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
    • Problem-solving skills with ability to perform root cause analysis
    • Highly organised, with the ability to self-manage in a remote environment
    • Ability to travel up to 15% of the time, primarily within Australia and New Zealand

Benefits

The best tools to get the job done!

When you join Veracross, you get a Macbook Pro, and assistance in your home set up.

Growth opportunities!

Veracross is growing fast, allowing you to own your role and grow with us! Operating within a global team, there are opportunities for professional development allowing your skills to grow as the business grows.

Work/life balance

Management encourages taking hour-long lunches and finishing on time and understands that you have a life outside of work. You can take the day off for your birthday and get a $100-a-year allowance for well-being. Massage, anyone?

Parental leave policy

As part of Veracross parental leave policy, you’re eligible for paid leave as a primary parent and secondary parent when you welcome a new child into your family. This is available after 12 months in a full-time role.

Make a difference

Our work makes a positive contribution to our schools, their students and their families around the world!

Snacks, drinks & coffee

Digistorm’s (Veracross) Gold Coast HQ offers a coffee machine, snack bar and fully stocked drinks fridge to keep energy levels high! Vege chips, kombucha, almond milk, cookies; you name it, they have it.

Culture

The Veracross team is fun, relaxed, and sociable, reflected in the casual dress code and social events. The office has an open floor plan, which allows for cross-team communication and a collaborative environment. Join some staff for lunchtime surfing or hit up nearby food spots for a burger by the beach.

It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. About Aretum

Aretum is a mission-driven organization committed to delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions to our customers across defense, civilian, and homeland security sectors. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation, helping agencies solve their most critical challenges. We believe in investing in our people and creating a culture where collaboration, inclusion, and professional growth are at the forefront.

Job Summary

We are seeking a motivated Junior Systems Analyst to support our content management and systems engineering efforts across multiple IT environments. This remote role is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in supporting enterprise content management systems (CMS) like Drupal, WordPress, and OpenText. Most of our systems are hosted on Linux platforms, and many have database backends. The ideal candidate has experience as a Systems Analyst or Web Master and understands service desk-type environments and tier 1, tier 2, and tier 3 support, as well as meeting SLA requirements. This remote position primarily provides tier 1 and tier 2 software and application support for web-based systems tailored to our federal client's needs. We strive to provide high-quality and unparalleled user support, user management, and customer service. This role may require after-hours system support and testing.

Due to the nature of our work as a federal consulting organization, employees may be expected to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and must adhere to applicable safeguarding and compliance requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Respond to and troubleshoot user experience issues; support user questions
  • Enhance and maintain existing web-based applications/systems/web sites
  • Help administer and maintain the web system and infrastructure
  • Perform other short-term and long-term tasks and duties as assigned by management
  • Test software for responsiveness and efficiency
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade software as required
  • Monitor system uptime, performance, and health
  • Create, implement, and validate security and data protection settings
  • Draft/update technical documentation
  • Attend and participate in client meetings

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Minimum of 2 years of overall experience
  • At least 1 year must be in web development, application administration, or Linux administration

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Linux administration

This is a remote position; however, occasional travel may be required based on project needs, client meetings, team collaboration events, or training sessions. Travel is expected to be less than 10% and will be communicated in advance whenever possible.

Aretum is committed to fostering a workplace rooted in excellence, integrity, and equal opportunity for all. If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process due to a disability, please contact for assistance.

Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

Senior Data Scientist

What you will be doing:

The Senior Data Scientist is a Subject Matter Expert that advises on both structured and unstructured analytic models to solve complex data problems in a way that ensures consistency, reusability, and quality across the organization.

This position will have responsibility for the development, delivery, enhancement, integration, integrity, maintenance, and support of the operation of information technology (IT) infrastructure, data, products, solutions, and services to support client operations and business activities. This position will be a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert for strategic initiatives around data exploration, data analysis, and complex, high dimensional datasets.

  • Data Modeling

  • Application Methodology Development

  • AI, Machine Learning, and statistical modeling

Key Responsibilities

Responsibility #1– 35%

Development and Implementation

• Collaborates with Data Science leadership, Product Management, Development, and Research teams in the creation and implementation of machine learning algorithms and statistical models.

• Leads the design and implementation of complex data solutions across teams while maintaining consistency within Premier methodology (e.g. prediction, probabilistic data matching, identifying outliers, confidence scoring, etc.)

• Work with developers and architects to translate prototypes into new products, services, and feature, and provide guidelines for large scale implementation.

• Use a flexible, analytical approach to design, develop, and evaluate predictive models, ML, AI, NLP and advanced algorithms that lead to optimal value extraction from the data.

• Produce innovative solutions driven by exploratory data analysis from complex and highly dimensional datasets

Responsibility #2 – 25%

Strategy and Design

• Serves as a subject matter expert within various business domains (Cost, Clinical, MDM, etc.)

• Participate in data exploration and conceptual design for strategic initiatives

• Apply knowledge of statistics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, programming, data modeling, simulation and advanced mathematics to recognize patterns, identify opportunities, pose business questions, and make valuable discoveries leading to prototype development and product improvement

• Generate and test hypotheses and analyze and interpret the results of product experiments

Responsibility #3 – 20%

Requirements Analysis

• Acts as an active member of the team throughout the design and implementation of the solution.

• Participate in build vs. buy decisions with outside vendors as it relates to analytic-based solutions

• Facilitate & lead meetings with the business/customers and IT teams in order to gather and document requirements

• Analyze business requirements, procedures and problems, to design solutions and make recommendations

• Develop features and stories based on requirements to feed product backlogs

• Conduct impact assessments across all existing applications, integration and data warehouses resulting from the solution implementation

Responsibility #4 – 10%

Knowledge Sharing

• Provide data, data relationships, and data science practice advice, demonstrations and presentations to colleagues, clients, and management. Conduct research, as needed

• Provide mentoring and training

Responsibility #5 – 10%

Data Operations

• Develop project estimates and work plans

• Identifying, developing, reviewing, and evolving best practices, standards, operating procedures, and processes

• Data Analysis: advanced querying techniques (ad hoc, ETL, and 3-tier application context), Oracle, DB2, Postgres, SQL Server & Netezza

Experience:

Current Employees:

If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet.

The University of Miami/UHealth Department of Public Health has an exciting opportunity for a full time Lead Research Analyst to work remote.


The Lead Research Analyst serves as the senior technical resource for FCDS cancer registry record linkage activities, including the development, evaluation, implementation, validation, documentation, training, and continuous improvement of probabilistic, deterministic, and hybrid linkage methodologies, software applications, data integration processes, and supporting technical infrastructure. Supports and contributes to FCDS special studies, research initiatives, surveillance modernization efforts, and emerging data integration projects designed to enhance cancer surveillance, data quality, and public health research capabilities. Participates in the analysis, interpretation, dissemination, training, and communication of research and surveillance findings through scientific publications, technical reports, presentations, and other professional and public-facing activities that advance cancer surveillance practice and knowledge.


Core responsibilities:


  • Analyzes data from multiple datasets using advanced statistical methods. 2. Develops, maintains, and monitors the organization of individual level data and documentation.
  • Prepares results for progress reports, presentations, and peer-reviewed publications.
  • Serves as co-author on peer-reviewed manuscripts.
  • Presents results of statistical analyses to study investigators.
  • Collaborates with other relevant stakeholders on planning and provides statistical consultation to project staff and collaborators.
  • Removes barriers to analyses by collaborating with other methodologists and statisticians.
  • Adheres to University and unit-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets.

Department Specific Functions:

  • Develops and maintains reproducible linkage procedures, quality assurance processes, technical documentation, best practices, and training materials.
  • Conducts linkage training and education and provides support to FCDS staff for these activities.
  • Conducts evaluation and testing of emerging linkage technologies and approaches.
  • Performs and supports complex linkage studies involving multiple data sources and challenging matching scenarios.
  • Collaborates with FCDS staff, the Florida Department of Health, University of Miami Information Technology, researchers, and other stakeholders to support the modernization, reliability, accuracy, and effective use of cancer registry record linkage systems and related data resources.
  • Participates in the planning, development, implementation, testing, analysis, and evaluation of special projects, including but not limited to cancer biology and molecular marker initiatives, administrative and electronic patient data integration efforts, cancer recurrence data collection and analysis projects, pilot studies, data validation activities, and other innovative research or surveillance activities.
  • Collaborates with FCDS staff, researchers, stakeholders, the Florida Department of Health, and others to assess project feasibility, develop methodologies, analyze findings, and support translating project outcomes into operational cancer registry practices.
  • Collaborate with other technical/research staff in coordinating the development, maintenance and implementation of the FCDS educational and curriculum initiative for Florida registrars.
  • Perform statistical and analytical functions for the FCDS Research Division and for extramural researchers as needed.
  • Respond to all routine and ad hoc research requests from external researchers and the Florida Department of Health, which include research collaboration.
  • Contributes to the preparation of scientific manuscripts, technical reports, abstracts, posters, presentations, educational materials, and other dissemination products; presents findings at scientific, professional, and public health meetings; and supports communication of research and surveillance findings to the broader cancer surveillance, epidemiology, and public health communities.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary.


Core Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field required. Master’s Degree in relevant field preferred.
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant experience required . Minimum 10 years experience preferred.
  • Learning Agility: Ability to learn new procedures, technologies, and protocols, and adapt to changing priorities and work demands.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively with others and contribute to a team environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Skilled in using office software, technology, and relevant computer applications.
  • Communication: Strong and clear written and verbal communication skills for interacting with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Skill in record linkage (entity resolution).
  • Skill in collecting, organizing, and analyzing data.
  • Ability to recognize, analyze, and solve a variety of problems.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment in making critical decisions.
  • Skilled in Python and Julia programming language
  • Expert in STATA, SAS, R or other statistical software tools

The University of Miami offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, tuition remission and more.

UHealth-University of Miami Health System, South Florida's only university-based health system, provides leading-edge patient care powered by the ground breaking research and medical education at the Miller School of Medicine. As an academic medical center, we are proud to serve South Florida, Latin America and the Caribbean. Our physicians represent more than 100 specialties and sub-specialties, and have more than one million patient encounters each year. Our tradition of excellence has earned worldwide recognition for outstanding teaching, research and patient care. We're the challenge you've been looking for.

About the Client

A fast-growing US healthcare technology company offering direct-to-consumer and B2B laboratory testing is looking for an Operations Coordinator to deliver highly responsive customer support, document scalable processes, and build AI-powered workflows that reduce manual work.

The company runs an out-of-pocket testing model with no insurance pre-authorizations and has scaled its customer base significantly in recent months, with four client implementations running in parallel. Its support operation already deflects about 70% of cases through AI, and the team is pushing that number higher.

Day-to-day, you will work in Slack, Intercom, and Notion, splitting your time across customer support (about 40%), process documentation (30%), AI automation (25%), and B2B partner operations (5%). This is a Wednesday to Sunday role, so you will keep operations moving through the weekend when the rest of the team is offline. Success means fast and consistent response times, documentation others can follow without help, and a measurable increase in case deflection and automation rates within your first 90 days.

Customer Support & Communication

  • Handle patient information in line with HIPAA requirements (training provided)

Process Creation & Documentation

  • Build new processes to support multiple concurrent client implementations
  • Keep the knowledge base current as products, partners, and policies change

  • Increase the support automation rate beyond the current 60%
  • Identify manual tasks outside Intercom and build AI-powered workflows to remove them
  • Connect automations across Intercom, Slack, and Notion

B2B Partner Operations

Must-Have

  • 2+ years in customer support operations, customer operations, or operations coordination, with at least 1 year at a startup or scale-up
  • Direct customer-facing support experience handling B2C or B2B inquiries through chat, email, or ticketing channels
  • Hands-on Intercom experience (inbox, help center, macros, or workflows)
  • Built at least one automated support or operations workflow (Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI, Zapier, Make, or equivalent) with a measurable result such as case deflection rate, automation rate, or hours saved
  • Created SOPs, process documentation, or knowledge base articles from scratch in Notion or an equivalent wiki, with daily Slack use
  • Available 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST, Wednesday – Sunday, including full Saturday and Sunday shifts
  • C1+ English (CEFR) for direct communication with US customers and lab partners

Nice-to-Have

  • Intercom Fin AI Agent configuration, including agentic procedures or multi-step workflows
  • Healthcare, laboratory testing, telehealth, or digital health operations experience

Job Description: Convergint is looking for a full-time, enthusiastic, results driven and forward-thinking Director of AI - Powered Selling to join our amazing culture. In this role, you will cultivate new relationships, gaining an understanding of our customers’ needs while securing sales opportunities. As an Director of AI - Powered Selling, you are a part of a dynamic sales organization that allows you to grow as Convergint grows.

Who You Are

You build. You experiment. You find a clever way to make something work, and want to show people. AI is your playground. You like turning rough ideas into useful tools, pushing past the obvious and making complicated things feel simple. You can explain what you built, take feedback and make it better. You bring curiosity, integrity and follow-through. You want room to create, people to collaborate with and a real audience for your work.

Who We Are
Convergint’s mission is to be our customers’ best service provider. Our company was built upon a foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs, which guide our culture and our commitment to customers, colleagues and communities. We take pride in protecting lives and assets through our technology solutions and services. We’re now bringing fresh AI thinking to how our Account Executives find opportunities, prepare for customer conversations and grow customer relationships.

What You’ll Do with “Our Training and Your Experience”
As Director of AI Powered Selling, you’ll report directly to the leader of Global Sales Operations and work closely together to co-create practical AI tools for Account Executives worldwide. We bring deep selling experience. You bring AI expertise, fresh ideas and the drive to build.
Our ambition: “creating tools which teach users their own use.”
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.
· Build: Turn concepts into practical AI tools. Experiment, prototype and demonstrate what’s possible.
· Refine: Incorporate feedback, test approved concepts and make tools reliable, intuitive and ready to use.
· Teach: Create and launch the AI Power Selling curriculum covering Market Identification & Lead Generation, Conversation Preparation & Planning, and Account Expansion.
· Showcase: Deliver demonstrations, training and supporting materials that help colleagues understand and use the tools.
· Improve: Gather user feedback and explore emerging AI capabilities to keep the tools and curriculum current.
You’ll have access to AI platforms and resources, with limited technical support. You’ll need to be resourceful and comfortable figuring things out.

What You’ll Need
· Strong, demonstrated expertise in building practical tools with generative AI, preferably ChatGPT.
· Examples of your work: tools, experiments, prototypes or demonstrations.
· Strong communication, presentation and teaching skills.
· The ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems and deliver finished work.
· The ability to collaborate, incorporate feedback and manage competing priorities.
· Curiosity, creativity and a commitment to Convergint’s Values and Beliefs.

Convergint fosters a supportive, accessible and inclusive environment where individuals of different backgrounds and identities can realize their maximum potential. We offer a variety of programs and exceptional benefits:
· Company Holidays and Paid Time Off
· Fun & Laughter Day Off

· Life Insurance & Disability Plan
· Wellness Program
· 401K Matching Plan
· Colleague Assistance Program
· Tuition Reimbursement
· Competitive Salary and Compensation Plan
· Corporate Social Responsibility Day
· And much more

Requirements
· Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
· Experience: Demonstrated hands-on AI tool-building experience. Sales experience is not required; technical, creative and unconventional backgrounds are welcome.
· Location: Must reside in the United States.
· Application: We’d love to see your stuff. Include examples or links to projects, tools or demonstrations you are authorized to share.

Department: Engineering

Location: Home based with occasional travel to the London office

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Hours: 37.5 per week

Salary: (Depending on experience)

A quick note before you apply: This role is strictly UK-based and must be performed entirely within the United Kingdom; we do not employ remote staff overseas, nor do we offer relocation support. Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK prior to commencing employment. While we hold a sponsor licence, visa sponsorship is only considered in exceptional circumstances and is not available as standard for this vacancy

Role Overview

This is a new role. Our culture at Cambridge Spark: engineers who own business outcomes, not just feature backlogs, and who work directly with stakeholders to understand problems rather than waiting for specifications to arrive.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be an early member of a new Engineering Pod: these are small, autonomous teams responsible for the quality, usability, and impact of EDUKATE.ai for the people learning through it and the teams supporting them. You will work across the full platform, from understanding what your pod’s stakeholders actually need, through to shipping and iterating on the solutions you help shape. You will be a multiplier for the engineers around you: raising the bar on how the team thinks about problems, not just how it solves them.

This role reports to one of our Engineering Managers, and you will initially join our Internal Experience pod. You will carry seniority in a team that we're deliberately rebuilding around product ownership and outcome focus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery within the Internal Experience pod: from discovery and problem framing through to production, iteration, and outcome measurement
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders — curriculum, operations, delivery — to understand problems at their root, not just their surface symptoms
  • Shape solutions collaboratively: contribute to proposals, decision records, and discovery conversations, not just pull requests
  • Bring an AI-first approach to your work: use AI tooling actively in prototyping, agentic coding, and accelerating delivery — and help the wider team develop the same habits
  • Hold a high engineering standard across the pod: TDD, code review discipline, and a genuine commitment to quality are non-negotiable here
  • Coach and support less experienced engineers in the pod, sharing your experience of what good looks like in a product engineering context
  • Contribute to the evolution of our engineering practices as the pod model matures

Candidate Specification

Technical

  • Front-end expertise, including UX design: we want to make our product delight internal users and free their time to serve learners
  • Comfort owning the full delivery lifecycle: problem framing, solution design, production, and iteration
  • Strong engineering fundamentals: test-driven development, code review culture, and a demonstrable commitment to quality
  • Active engagement with AI-assisted development: prototyping, agentic coding, and using AI tooling as an accelerant rather than a novelty
  • Experience with edtech, regulated industries, or other complex domains is a plus; the ability to absorb a new domain quickly is essential
  • Professional experience in our stack (React / Vue) is a bonus, but not essential
  • Back-end engineering knowledge is a nice-to-have for this role

Stakeholder and Communication

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with non-technical stakeholders to shape requirements — through product engineering, professional services, client-facing delivery, or similar
  • Strong written communication: you can write a clear proposal, a concise technical decision record, or a stakeholder update that lands without needing translation
  • Comfortable running or contributing to discovery conversations, not just delivering code once the brief is written

Ways of Working

  • Outcome ownership over feature delivery. You question whether the proposed solution is the right one, not just whether you can build it.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. Small pods mean limited process overhead. You make good decisions with incomplete information and know when to escalate versus when to proceed.
  • AI-first mindset. You are not just curious about AI; you actively use it, prototype with it, and bring that practice into the team around you.
  • Collaboration without ego. You care about the outcome more than the credit. You build trust through competence and consistency, not volume.
  • Communicative. You surface problems early, document your thinking, and keep stakeholders appropriately informed without being prompted.

What This Role Is Not

  • It is not a ticket-completion role: if you want a well-defined backlog and a clear brief every sprint, this is probably not the right fit
  • It is not a people management role: you will not have direct reports, though you will be a senior presence in the pod and expected to act like one
  • It is not a big-company environment: we are a bootstrapped edtech business; you will need to be comfortable with resource constraints and a degree of ambiguity about what comes next

Why This Role

  • A genuine opportunity to shape how product engineering works at Cambridge Spark, not just execute a predetermined roadmap
  • Direct access to and influence with senior leadership, including the Head of Engineering and CEO
  • Work that matters: our platform supports thousands of learners across data and AI apprenticeships, and the quality of what you build has a real and traceable impact on their experience and careers
  • An AI-serious engineering culture: we are an AI company and expect our engineering practice to reflect that, including giving you time and space to experiment
  • A stable, values-driven business with a social impact mission in education and skills

Company Benefits

  • Pension with 4% matched contributions, opportunity to opt into salary sacrifice scheme
  • 25 days holiday + flexi bank holidays + 1 day off on your birthday
  • A day for volunteering
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • Health & wellbeing allowance of up to £30 per month
  • Annual summer and Christmas events

jobs.excerpt: Job description:Revenue Cycle ManagerThe Revenue Cycle Manager will serve as a hands-on player-coach, overseeing billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and financial operations for ABA Therapy Partners.
jobs.description:
Job description:

Revenue Cycle Manager

The Revenue Cycle Manager will serve as a hands-on player-coach, overseeing billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and financial operations for ABA Therapy Partners. This role is ideal for a strategic, solutions-oriented leader who can manage day-to-day operations while identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, improve accuracy, strengthen collections, and reduce manual processes through automation and scalable solutions. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of revenue cycle best practices, billing requirements, authorization processes, and reimbursement rules for California regional centers, school districts, and insurance payers. Reporting directly to the CEO, this individual will play a key role in strengthening financial processes, improving revenue performance, and building the operational infrastructure needed to support the company’s continued growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Process Improvement

  • Process Mapping: Document every finance workflow end to end (session data to invoice to payment to cash to month-end close) with clear owners, inputs, outputs, deadlines, and handoffs.
  • Find and Fix Friction: Identify bottlenecks, rework, duplicate entry, and error sources. Prioritize fixes by impact on the business.
  • Automation: Lead automation across billing, AR, AP, and reporting using our systems (HiRasmus, Lumary, Rippling, Quickbooks, Google Workspace) and other tools as needed.
  • Standard Operating Procedures: Write and maintain SOPs and checklists so any team member can be trained to run each process the same way every time.
  • Controls: Build in checks that catch errors before they reach a client or vendor, with clear separation of duties and approval rules.
  • Continuous Improvement: Set baselines, track improvement, and report what changed each quarter.

2. Billing

  • Billing Cycle: Lead the monthly billing cycle for all clients we directly invoice, including Regional Centers and School Districts. Work directly with outsourced billing partners to drive prompt and accurate insurance client billing and collections.
  • Data Integrity: Partner with the appointment rendering and scheduling teams so the data used for billing is clean and complete before billing begins. Close the gaps that cause unrendered or unbilled sessions.
  • Client Billing: Convert documented sessions and session notes into invoices based on authorized hours, rates, and codes (e.g., regional center Purchase of Service agreements and school district contracts and IEPs).
  • Invoice Submission: Manage submissions according to each client's requirements, and resolve discrepancies or denials quickly.

3. Accounts Receivable and Collections

  • AR Management: Own the AR aging, follow up on overdue invoices, and drive down days sales outstanding (DSO), regardless of payer source or billing method.
  • Cash Application: Post incoming payments accurately in our Practice Management system and reconcile them to invoices.
  • Denials and Disputes: Track root causes of short pays, denials, and disputes, and fix the process upstream so they don't repeat.
  • Outsourced Billing Partners: Own the relationship to drive partnership, data integrity, clean claims, prompt payment and collections.
  • Self Pay / Patient Responsibility: Work with families in a professional, respectful manner to establish payment plans and otherwise collect on copays, coinsurance and other patient responsibility items.

4. Accounts Payable

  • Vendor Payments: Manage vendor setup, invoice intake, approvals, and payments on a predictable schedule, meeting vendor payment terms.
  • Approval Workflow: Enforce spending approval thresholds and documentation, and keep AP clean for audits.
  • Spend Visibility: Track recurring spend and subscriptions. Identify savings opportunities.

5. Finance Operations

  • Monthly Financial Rhythm: Define and run a monthly calendar for billing, collections, payment posting, AP, reconciliations, and close.
  • Month-End Close: Support an accurate, on-time close of financials (Quickbooks) with reconciliations and clean handoff / collaboration with our CPA and accounting partners.
  • Cash Management: Monitor cash position weekly and keep leadership 60 days ahead of cash needs.
  • Audit and Compliance: Keep billing and payment records audit-ready and aligned with client contracts and expectations, and funder rules.

6. Analysis, Forecasting, and Reporting

  • KPI Reporting: Produce weekly and monthly finance scorecards: billed vs. authorized hours, unrendered sessions, collection rate, DSO, AR aging, AP aging, cash position, and margin by client and school district.
  • Forecasting: Build and maintain rolling revenue, cash flow, expense and net income forecasts. Update them as placements, rates, and staffing levels change.
  • Budgeting: Support the annual budget and forecasts, and track actual performance against it.
  • Business Analysis: Analyze profitability by client, district, and service line, model the impact of rate changes and new contracts, and support pricing and growth decisions.
  • Ad Hoc Analysis: Answer leadership's financial questions quickly with clear, data-centered analysis.

7. Team Leadership and Collaboration

  • Supervision: Lead billing and finance specialists, providing training, feedback, and clear workflows.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with clinical operations, scheduling, HR, and leadership so finance processes fit the realities of the business.

Knowledge and Experience Requirements

Skills and experience

Job Description

Trip Support Specialist I - Aviation

Location: Webster, TX (Remote)
Schedule: 24/7 operation with rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays
Compensation: $19-$23/hour DOE + bonus potential


Keep Global Aviation Moving

At World Fuel, we support some of the world's most complex and demanding aviation operations. Every day, our team helps commercial, military, and business aviation customers execute missions across the globe by ensuring they have the permits, services, logistics, and operational support required for success.


As a Trip Support Specialist I, you will play a critical role in coordinating international flight operations and serving as a trusted partner to flight crews, operators, and customers worldwide. This is a fast-paced position that combines aviation operations, customer service, logistics, and real-time problem solving.

Whether supporting a business jet crossing multiple countries or assisting military and commercial flight operations, you'll help ensure every trip is executed safely, efficiently, and seamlessly.


What You'll Do

Coordinate Global Flight Operations

Support international and domestic flight operations by arranging and managing:

  • Airport ground handling services
  • Landing and overflight permits
  • Airport slots and aircraft parking
  • Customs, immigration, and regulatory requirements
  • Hotel accommodations for flight crews
  • Ground transportation arrangements
  • Real-time flight following and operational updates

Deliver Outstanding Customer Service

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customers
  • Build strong relationships through proactive communication and operational expertise
  • Respond quickly to schedule changes, operational challenges, and customer requests
  • Ensure trips are executed accurately and efficiently from planning through completion
  • Provide solutions in time-sensitive situations while maintaining exceptional service standards

Manage Aviation Logistics

  • Create and maintain trip records within company operating systems
  • Prepare customer quotations, cost estimates, and operational documentation
  • Coordinate with airports, government agencies, international vendors, and service providers worldwide
  • Track trip progress and proactively communicate updates
  • Ensure accurate operational and billing documentation

Support Flight Planning Activities

Depending on the customer segment supported, responsibilities may include:

  • Assisting with flight planning and route analysis
  • Monitoring weather conditions and operational impacts
  • Providing weather briefing support
  • Utilizing flight planning platforms and aviation operational tools
  • Communicating route, permit, and operational requirements to customers and crews

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Aeronautics, Aviation Management, or a related field preferred
  • 0-2 years of aviation industry experience, or equivalent aviation education and training
  • Strong customer service and communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively within a team environment

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:

  • Flight planning
  • Flight dispatch support
  • Airport operations
  • Business or corporate aviation
  • Commercial aviation operations
  • Military aviation operations
  • Global trip support
  • Aviation customer service
  • Weather briefing services

Technical Skills

Experience with any of the following is preferred:

  • PPS8
  • Air Inc.
  • Navblue
  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • Flight planning software
  • Aviation weather platforms
  • Aviation operational systems

What Makes You Successful

You are someone who:

  • Thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced operational environment
  • Enjoys solving complex logistical and operational challenges
  • Maintains composure and professionalism under pressure
  • Can effectively manage multiple trips and competing priorities simultaneously
  • Communicates clearly and confidently with customers and stakeholders
  • Builds strong working relationships across teams and time zones
  • Takes ownership of customer outcomes
  • Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
  • Has a passion for aviation and global operations

Why Join World Fuel?

  • Support global aviation operations.
  • Work with commercial, military, and business aviation customers.
  • Gain exposure to international flight operations.
  • Develop expertise in trip support, flight planning, and aviation logistics.
  • Join a collaborative team operating at the center of global aviation.

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation

  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

  1. Complete your online job application.

  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

jobs.description:
A part-time college counselor works with students and families through the college search and admissions process. This person must have impeccable communication skills, be able to connect with both high school students and their parents and be incredibly knowledgeable about colleges and the admissions process. The Counselor will also support other college counselors and our essay coaches in their work with students.

The position reports to the Director of Admissions Counseling. Because we work mostly with high school students and their parents, we tend to work in the later afternoons, evenings, and weekends. There is some flexibility in the schedule, as long as it is coordinated with families and the team. The position will evolve over time as the ideal candidate will take our current practices and expand and enhance them.

Families may sign up to do hourly work with a counselor or may sign up for our comprehensive program, which does not count hours. A typical student starts work with a counselor in the early Junior year. A part-time counselor must commit to working with at least 5 "comprehensive" (or hourly equivalent) students in each graduating class.

College Counselor Responsibilities:

We are currently seeking hire an additional College Counselor in one of our offices or remotely to work with high school students and their families through the college admissions process. This position may be part-time or full-time, depending on the candidate’s preference.

Direct Services

  • Work with roughly 30 students (full-time) or 5+ students (part-time) in each graduating class through all aspects of the college admissions process;
  • Communicate with parents on a regular basis;
  • Make use of publicly available data to inform advice and expertise;
Professional Development
  • Regularly participate in professional development opportunities, including regional and national conferences, webinars, college tours, and more;
  • Keep current on current trends in college admissions;
  • Develop training and educational materials for self and others on the team.

Building a Caseload (for Full-Time Counselors)

  • Write blogs and articles targeted at high school students and their parents;
  • Coordinate events to speak publicly about college admissions;
  • Develop relationships with local high school counselors and other educational experts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required / advance degree preferred;
  • A minimum of three years of experience in admissions at a selective college or as an independent college counselor OR a minimum of five years of experience working as a counselor in a high school;
  • Exceptional writing skills;
  • Exceptional communication skills;
  • Attention to detail, with strong organizational skills;
  • Expertise in using web-based tools to advise students;
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends, as needed (determined by students’ schedule).
Compensation and Benefits
  • The full-time position is a salaried position ($70,000-$90,000 based on previous experience and education); the part-time position is compensated on an hourly basis ($60-90 per billable hour; all team members are also paid a prep-time rate for non-billable work).
  • Up to 5% match 401(k) (for eligible employees)

  • Paid membership in professional organizations
  • Stipend for travel for college visits and conferences

jobs.description:
Business Systems Analyst II (m/w/d)

R-293991

Vollzeit / Unbefristet


CSL ist ein weltweit führendes Biotechnologieunternehmen und entwickelt Therapien, die Menschen mit seltenen und schweren Erkrankungen ein besseres Leben ermöglichen. Grundlage vieler dieser Therapien ist menschliches Plasma, und hier kommt CSLPlasma ins Spiel. Wir betreiben eines der größten Plasmaspendenetzwerke der Welt und sorgen dafür, dass dieser wertvolle Rohstoff sicher gewonnen, verarbeitet und transportiert wird. Unsere Mitarbeitenden arbeiten dabei jeden Tag mit geschäftskritischen Anwendungen, die Plasmagewinnung, Produktion und Logistik zuverlässig steuern.

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du unsere Operations-Teams für das Donor Management System und das Plasma Logistics System. Das Donor Management System wird täglich in unseren europäischen Plasmaspendezentren eingesetzt, das Plasma Logistics System in unseren globalen Plasma-Logistikzentren und in den Fraktionierungen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Erstellung und Pflege von Dokumentation sowie auf Test- und Validierungsaktivitäten. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklung und Qualitätswesen zusammen und begleitest Änderungen und Releases von der Anforderung bis zur Freigabe.

× Unterstützung der Fachabteilung zur Definition der Benutzeranforderungen an das Softwaresystem (User Requirements) sowie deren Abstimmung in lokalen & globalen Projektteams.

× Identifizierung des Lösungsdesigns und Erstellung der notwendigen Dokumentation des Systemdesigns (z.B. Architekturspezifikationen, Funktionsspezifikationen, Designspezifikationen, Listen und Diagramme, funktionale und Konfigurationsspezifikationen), um die Darstellung und technische Umsetzung der Benutzeranforderungen zu gewährleisten sowie den Systemprogrammierern entsprechende Anweisungen zu geben.

× Erstellung der Validierungsplanung in Übereinstimmung mit einer Funktion aus dem Qualitätswesen

× Kontrolle und Überwachung der Umsetzung der definierten Maßnahmen im Validierungsplan

× Vorbereitung von Testfällen und Skripts, die für die Design- und Funktionsanforderungen relevant sind, um die CSL-Qualitäts- und Governance-Standards und -Verfahren einzuhalten

× Koordination oder Durchführung der Systemfunktionsprüfung mit geeigneten internen oder externen Ressourcen

× Erstellung und Aktualisierung von SOPs, Betriebs- und Projektdokumentation auf Basis interner und externer Vorgaben

× Durchführung der Wartung von Applikationen für die zugeordneten globalen IT-Funktionsbereiche

× Beurteilen und Umsetzen von Änderungsanforderungen

× Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Prozesseignern / Business Stakeholdern, um die Prüfbarkeit zu gewährleisten

Deine Qualifikationen

× i.d.R. abgeschlossenes Studium zum Bachelor of Science, bspw. Informatik oder Computer Science

× Kenntnisse der MS Office Produkte

× Kenntnisse in allen Aspekten des SDLC

× Technische und funktionale Kenntnisse zur Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen und Architektur von Lösungen

× Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

× 4-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung

× Wünschenswert:

o Erfahrung im GxP-regulierten Umfeld (z.B. Computer System Validation)

o Erfahrung mit Jira/Confluence, GitLab und Veeva

o Erfahrung mit Automated Testing z.B. Playwright

o Kenntnisse in einer relationalen Datenbank, Programmiersprache oder Reporting Engine


About CSL Behring

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
