jobs.excerpt: About Hilo by AktiiaHigh blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year.
jobs.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation.

Role overview

Every Hilo Band that reaches a customer on time is one more person who can start taking control of their blood pressure. As Logistics Manager you own our day- to- day D2C logistics execution end to end: Webshop and Amazon across the USA and Canada markets. That covers daily fulfilment and outbound logistics, inbound transportation from our factories to regional warehouses, last mile delivery, returns, and the daily relationship with our 3PLs and carriers. Our network has grown to six third party logistics partners worldwide, including our newest partner in the US. Your impact comes from running the operation superbly well every day, resolving issues before customers feel them, and steadily making the flows you own smoother, faster and more cost efficient. You contribute to our wider logistics strategy, while overall network architecture sits with Operations leadership. You work as an individual contributor without direct reports, in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Finance, Sales, Quality and Customer Service, with room to grow as the network scales.

Location: US-based, preferably East Coast, must be authorised to work in the United States, with regular traveling. The role requires minimum half-day working hours to overlap with our European-based team (CET), and travel to team and business events quarterly (or as needed).

Core responsibilities

End to end D2C logistics operations

  • Own end to end D2C logistics for Webshop and Amazon across the USA and Canada.
  • Run daily fulfilment and outbound logistics from order processing through final delivery, including last mile, returns and issue resolution.
  • Resolve exceptions fast and cleanly so customers never feel the friction behind the scenes.
  • Contribute to planning and implementing the overall logistics strategy.

3PL and carrier management

  • Manage and scale a multi 3PL network, including ramping up our newly launched US operation.
  • Own SLAs, performance reviews and capacity planning across logistics partners.
  • Be the daily operational contact for 3PLs and carriers, building relationships based on trust and clear expectations.

Inbound and international transportation

  • Own inbound transportation from our factories, for example in China and Vietnam, to regional warehouses.
  • Lead inbound carrier selection, route design, rate negotiation and cost to serve optimisation.
  • Coordinate freight booking, shipping schedules and handover to logistics partners.
  • Manage customs clearance processes and import documentation.

Product integrity and inventory execution

  • Ensure product integrity for devices that are sensitive to temperature, humidity and pressure.
  • Maintain inventory visibility across warehouses and sales channels.
  • Coordinate replenishment to avoid both stockouts and excess inventory.

Reporting and collaboration

  • Define and track logistics KPIs such as OTIF, lead time, cost per shipment and return rate, and report them so the business can act on them.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the operations you run.
  • Collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Finance, Sales, Quality and Customer Service.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in logistics, fulfilment or supply chain operations, ideally in D2C or ecommerce and international distribution.
  • Proven experience managing 3PLs, carriers and cross border shipments.
  • Solid working knowledge of last mile delivery, Amazon fulfilment and international shipping fundamentals.
  • Hands on experience with logistics or ERP tools, and strong analytical skills.
  • Excellent English, written and spoken.
  • USA based, and willing to travel occasionally to warehouses in Switzerland, Germany, UK, Canada, Australia and the USA.

Nice to have

  • BSc in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field. Equivalent practical experience counts just as much.
  • Chinese.
  • Experience in medical device, pharmaceutical or other quality regulated logistics.
  • Experience setting up logistics operations in a new market.

How you work

  • You are a self starter who thrives in a scale up without a large support structure around you.
  • You have a strong execution mindset and real attention to detail.
  • You keep several issues moving in parallel and prioritise well under pressure.
  • You communicate clearly, take ownership and bring solutions rather than problems.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days

  • Day 30 You know our network end to end: every 3PL, carrier, lane and system, and you are the go to person for daily operational questions.
  • Day 60 You run daily fulfilment and inbound execution independently, you have taken over the 3PL and carrier relationships, and you have named the three biggest sources of friction in the current flow.
  • Day 90 Logistics KPI reporting runs on your cadence, your first improvement is live and measurable, and you are driving the ramp up of our US operation.

After one year

  • Orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered on time, consistently and in Americas.
  • Operational issues are identified early and resolved before customers are affected.
  • Our US operation is running to SLA and scaling smoothly with demand.
  • Cost per shipment and inbound cost to serve are trending down with no trade off in service.
  • 3PLs and carriers experience us as a well run, well organised partner, and the customer delivery experience is consistently positive.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is 125,000–140,000 USD, depending on experience and location, plus a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and paid time off. In addition, we offer an attractive ESOP package, giving you the opportunity to participate in Hilo's long-term success and growth.

Why Join Us?

Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting journey.

  • Work on a mission that matters - transforming cardiovascular health at global scale
  • Be part of a fast-growing, high-impact, venture-backed company
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are excited about owning a market from the ground up, thrive in high-autonomy commercial leadership roles, and want to contribute to meaningful impact in healthcare, we would love to hear from you.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hilo by Aktiia is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.excerpt: Teach English Online! • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing • Long-term employment only!
jobs.description:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

Sales Partner – RealAdvisor (Mercado Español)

Buscamos vendedores con mentalidad de closer.

RealAdvisor es una de las principales plataformas digitales del ecosistema inmobiliario europeo. Fundada en Suiza, hoy apoyamos a más de 5.000 agencias inmobiliarias y llegamos a más de 10 millones de usuarios cada año en Europa.

Estamos acelerando nuestro crecimiento en el mercado español y buscamos Sales Partners freelance capaces de transformar oportunidades comerciales en clientes.

No es necesario conocer el sector inmobiliario: te formaremos en el producto y en el mercado. Lo que buscamos es una demostrada capacidad de venta y de cierre.

El resultado que buscamos

Nuestro objetivo es construir un equipo de vendedores capaces de alcanzar al menos 15 ventas al mes.

Para los profesionales que alcanzan un alto rendimiento, el plan de comisiones ofrece un potencial de ingresos superior a 20.000 € al mes, en función de los resultados obtenidos.

El principio es simple: cuanto más vendes, más ganas.

Tu rol

Tendrás la responsabilidad de todo el ciclo de venta, desde el primer contacto hasta la firma del contrato. No buscamos personas especializadas exclusivamente en prospecting o en demos. Buscamos full-cycle sales, capaces de gestionar de forma autónoma una negociación de principio a fin.

Tus responsabilidades incluirán:

  • Prospecting outbound y generación autónoma de oportunidades
  • Gestión de leads inbound
  • Gestión de reuniones cualificadas proporcionadas por nuestro equipo de SDR
  • Cualificación de prospects
  • Demos comerciales por videoconferencia
  • Análisis de necesidades del cliente
  • Presentación de la solución y propuesta de valor
  • Gestión de objeciones y negociación
  • Seguimiento estructurado
  • Envío y gestión del contrato
  • Cierre de la venta
  • Gestión completa del pipeline en el CRM

En resumen: del primer contacto a la firma.

Un rol de alta intensidad comercial

Es importante ser claros sobre el ritmo de trabajo requerido.

El rol prevé indicativamente 5 demos al día, generalmente a través de videollamadas de 20 a 40 minutos.

A estas actividades se suman el prospecting, el seguimiento, la negociación y la gestión del pipeline. Parte de las reuniones estará organizada por nuestro equipo de SDR, pero esperamos que el Sales Partner sea capaz de generar nuevas oportunidades por sí mismo.

Requirements

Requisitos (Quién buscamos)

No se requiere experiencia previa en el sector inmobiliario, pero es fundamental tener experiencia concreta en venta B2B/outbound.

Buscamos profesionales que:

  • Tengan experiencia previa en roles comerciales y venta outbound.
  • Sepan realizar demos comerciales efectivas por videollamada.
  • Dominen la gestión de objeciones, la negociación y el cierre de contratos.
  • Estén acostumbrados a trabajar por objetivos y KPIs.
  • Tengan mentalidad emprendedora, autonomía y disciplina.
  • Tengan experiencia en el uso de herramientas CRM.
  • Cuenten con español nativo o fluido (C1/C2).

No buscamos simplemente un comercial: buscamos un closer.

Benefits

Qué ofrecemos

  • Potencial de ingresos de 20.000 €+ al mes para perfiles de alto rendimiento (contamos con compañeros que superan de forma estable los 30.000 €/mes).
  • Plan de comisiones fuertemente orientado a resultados.
  • Reuniones cualificadas facilitadas por el equipo SDR.
  • Formación completa sobre el producto y el sector inmobiliario.
  • Colaboración freelance a largo plazo.
  • Apoyo continuo de un equipo internacional.
  • Mercado español en fuerte expansión.

Tipo de colaboración

  • Modalidad: Freelance / Autónomo (facturación mensual a nuestra sede en Suiza).
  • Dedicación: Al menos 35 horas semanales.
  • Remuneración: Basada en rendimiento y comisiones por venta.

jobs.description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Canada

New Sales Business | Walnut Insurance | Remote, Canada | Reports to the COO

The role

You'll bring in Walnut's next enterprise partners in Canada, and you'll start with the relationships you already have. This is a pure new-business role. You source your own leads, open the doors, qualify hard, and convert the right ones into signed partners on both sides of our platform: distribution partners such as banks, credit unions, lenders, fintechs, telcos and consumer brands that should be offering insurance inside their products, and insurance carriers looking for new embedded distribution. You'll run your own territory, plan and pipeline with very little oversight. You'll report directly to our COO and work alongside our founders, who still sell with the team. Once a partner signs, our account management and implementation teams take it from there, so your time goes on finding and winning the next one.

About Walnut

Walnut is Canada's leading embedded insurance platform. Partners like Wealthsimple, BMO, KOHO and TELUS use us to launch insurance inside their products in 90 days, compared with nine months or more going direct to a carrier. We hold the carrier relationships, the licenses and the compliance; our partners keep the customer. We're nationally licensed in P&C and life and health across every province, including Quebec.

What you'll do

  • Source your own leads. Start with your network, then build out from it. Work your contacts, referrals, events, associations and outbound to create a steady flow of conversations with decision-makers at Canadian financial institutions, telcos, digital brands and insurance carriers. Nobody hands you a lead list. You build the pipeline.

  • Open doors at the senior level. Get meetings with the people who can say yes: heads of product, partnerships, digital, lending and insurance at distribution partners, and heads of distribution, partnerships and product at carriers. Use warm introductions wherever you have them, and cold outreach that gets answered where you don't.

  • Qualify fast and manage the pipeline. Separate real opportunities from interest early. Keep every lead, contact and next step current in HubSpot, and run a forecast you'd stand behind in front of the board.

  • Convert. Run discovery, build the business case for an embedded program, and take deals through proposal, security review, procurement and legal to signature. Our solutioning, legal and carrier teams back you along the way.

  • Hand off and move on. Pass signed partners to account management and implementation with a clear scope, then go back to sourcing.

  • Run yourself. Set your own territory plan, activity targets and priorities. Report progress weekly and flag what you need before it slows a deal.

  • Bring back what you hear in market. Tell us which segments are buying, which messages land and which products prospects keep asking for.

What you bring

  • A real Canadian network. You have relationships you can call this week at banks, credit unions, lenders, fintechs, telcos, large consumer brands or insurance carriers. We'll ask you to show us where.

  • Seven or more years in B2B sales or business development, with a track record of sourcing and closing new enterprise business yourself, not inheriting it.

  • Proven lead-to-close skill. You can show us pipeline you built from nothing, how it converted, and the revenue it produced.

  • A self-starter who doesn't need managing. You've worked as a one-person team or the first seller in a market and built your own momentum.

  • Comfort with long, complex cycles of six to twelve months or more, with several stakeholders and procurement, legal and compliance review.

  • Commercial fluency. You can talk about premium, commission, attach rate and partner economics with a CFO, a head of product or a carrier's head of distribution. Insurance, creditor insurance, payments or banking-SaaS experience is a strong plus.

  • AI as part of how you sell. You use tools like Claude, and HubSpot to research prospects, personalize outreach and prep for meetings.

  • Bilingual in English and French is a strong asset for Quebec and national accounts.

Your first 90 days

By day 30, you know our products, partners and carriers, have mapped your network against our target segments with the COO, and are booking first meetings. By day 60, you've held at least ten senior conversations and moved three or more into active opportunities. By day 90, you have [$X] of qualified pipeline in HubSpot that you sourced yourself, and at least one deal at proposal stage.

How to apply

Send us three things:

  1. Your resume and a link to your LinkedIn profile.

  2. A short cover letter about an enterprise deal you sourced and closed yourself. Tell us how you found it, who you knew, what nearly killed it, and the outcome.

  3. Ten Canadian organizations (distribution partners, carriers or both) you could get a meeting with in your first 60 days, with the role of the person you'd call at each. Names aren't required at this stage.

Our process includes a review of your past pipeline and results, a conversation about your network, and a mock first meeting with a real Walnut target.

What we offer

A base salary of CAD $110,000 - $150,000 based on background and experience, plus commission under Walnut's sales compensation plan, equity and benefits. Fully remote in Canada, with travel to prospect meetings and industry events. You'll report directly to the COO at a scaling fintech.

jobs.excerpt: Remote, United States | Full time | Reports to Director, Trials Applications close November 20, 2026 Who We AreContrails.
jobs.description:
Remote, United States | Full time | Reports to Director, Trials
Applications close November 20, 2026

Who We Are

Contrails.org is a pioneering non-profit working to establish proven contrail avoidance at scale. We are a small, focused team of scientists, engineers, and aviation experts building the science, tools, and operational playbooks to make contrail management a practical reality. Our open-source modelling framework underpins research worldwide, and our real-world trials with major airlines demonstrate that contrail avoidance delivers verifiable climate benefit at a minimal cost.

Our mission is to meaningfully reduce contrail-induced warming by 2030, while establishing the foundations for contrail avoidance to become standard practice in global aviation. We envision a world where intelligent route planning and air traffic management eliminates climate warming contrails with near-zero cost.

Contrails currently cause the same warming impact as 33 billion tonnes of atmospheric CO₂—roughly one year of global anthropogenic emissions. A small subset of flights generates the bulk of this contrail warming, much of which can be avoided through minor altitude or routing adjustments at negligible cost.

What You’ll Do

Contrails.org is seeking a highly motivated and exceptional trial-focused Research Scientist to join our team. You will plan, execute, analyze, and report on real-world flight trials of contrail avoidance, working closely with partner airlines and air navigation service providers (ANSPs) to demonstrate contrail management at scale. You will design scientifically defensible trials, monitor them as they run, turn trial data into actionable results, and communicate those results to research partners and the broader aviation and scientific community. This role sits within the Contrail Clearing Accelerator (CCA), which will run trials across 4 to 8 airlines and 1 to 2 ANSPs. As part of the CCA, you will help design a standardized trial methodology that can be applied across disparate airlines and ANSPs.

Specific Responsibilities

Development and analysis of flight trials

  • Collaborate with our team, partner airlines, and ANSPs to develop trial options and to design, develop, and implement real-world trials of contrail avoidance.
  • Use Contrails.org and partner tools to plan high-impact, scientifically defensible trials, including pre-test modeling of contrail impacts and effects of trial design decisions.
  • Monitor the progress of trials in execution, including accessing raw data sources, converting data into insights, and clearly communicating trial progress to stakeholders.
  • Conduct post-trial analysis, determining avoidance effectiveness and costs using modeled and observed results, and uncovering relevant human and operational factors.
  • Cross-check flight planning outputs, filed flight plans, flown telemetry, and satellite observations to verify what avoidance was attempted and achieved.
  • Work with partners to provide data and support in using our tools to facilitate the success of trials.

Operational protocol development

  • Document trial learnings and operational findings in a form that supports the development of repeatable, safety-sound operational protocols and playbooks.
  • Support the translation of trial results into procedures and guidance usable by airline and ANSP partners.

Innovation and problem solving

  • Identify innovative solutions to complex technical and operational challenges in trial design and execution, enhancing scientific understanding and technological capabilities and performance.
  • Continuously improve analysis and tools in response to partner feedback.

Collaboration and communication

  • Work closely with team members to align trial work with strategic objectives.
  • Build and help maintain relationships with partner airlines and ANSPs, including preparing briefing materials and representing Contrails.org in partner meetings and before external audiences.
  • Participate in and lead meetings with research and trial partners.
  • Communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders, fostering a collaborative and cohesive work environment.
  • Lead and contribute to written publications in peer-reviewed journals, industry white papers, and our Notebook, describing and contextualizing trial results.
  • Present your work and trial results at international workshops and conferences, and to scientific and industry audiences.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, computer science, data science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in engineering, aviation operations, data science, or a related field.
  • Experience conducting independent research or analysis with minimal oversight.
  • Proficiency in Python or similar programming languages.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to explain scientific concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to rapidly changing requirements.
  • Available for up to 20% travel domestically and internationally.
  • Ability to occasionally work outside standard hours to accommodate partner meetings across diverse time zones.

Preferred

  • Aviation domain expertise, including familiarity with operational and human factors. Flight test expertise particularly valued.
  • Master’s or PhD degree in a relevant field.
  • Experience implementing or working with aircraft performance, aircraft emissions, or contrail models.
  • Experience using optimizers or building scripts to support route or trial planning.
  • Experience running statistical analysis on large datasets using cloud computing.

Salary and Benefits

$120,000 to $140,000 depending on experience, plus a generous benefits package that includes:

  • 10% employer 401(k) contribution
  • Up to $2,500 a month toward medical coverage for you and your dependents
  • Dental and vision covered by Contrails, currently provided as a monthly stipend
  • 20 paid vacation days
  • 17 paid company holidays
  • 12 paid sick days

Commitment to Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.

Job Description

The BilingualTerritory Manager, Non-Acute (remote) base role, is responsible for growing revenue and managing the existing business within the assigned territories of Quebec & New Brunswick. The role develops opportunities with customers, distributors and other channel partners, builds strong stakeholder relationships, and delivers solutions aligned with customer needs and BD’s commercial objectives.


Working collaboratively with the Non-Acute team and relevant Business Units, the Territory Manager, Non-Acute translates strategic priorities into actionable territory plans, maintains a strong pipeline and supports channel partners with the knowledge and resources required to succeed. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong commercial capabilities while consistently applying BD’s sales processes, tools, and ethical standards.


This remote-based role requires the successful candidate to reside near a major airport to facilitate travel across Canada, with travel up to 20% (Quebec and/New Brunswick).

Job Responsibilities:

  • The role manages business through a combination of direct customer engagement and distributor-led sales execution, depending on the account, market segment, and product category.
  • Achieve assigned revenue and growth targets by managing the existing business and developing new sales opportunities.
    Develop and execute against territory plan aligned with BD’s commercial and marketing strategies.
  • Build productive, long-term relationships with customers, distributors, and other channel partners.
  • Identify customer needs and develop mutually beneficial solutions aligned with customer and BD objectives.
  • Build, maintain, and advance a qualified pipeline of opportunities aligned with territory priorities, ensuring clear next steps, timelines, and revenue potential.
  • Protect existing business by maintaining strong customer relationships, monitoring competitive activity, and identifying risks to customer retention within the assigned territory.
  • Apply Strategic Account Planning principles to prioritize customers, identify growth opportunities, and support the execution of territory objectives.
  • Provide accurate territory forecasts and maintain current opportunity, customer, and activity information to support business planning and forecasting accuracy.
  • Support customer quotation, proposal, tender, and contract activities, as applicable, by coordinating required information and collaborating with internal stakeholders in accordance with company processes. Work with channel partners to strengthen product knowledge, sales capabilities, and market execution.
  • Identify and assess new channels, customer and partnership opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain strong clinical, technical, and competitive knowledge across the assigned portfolio.
    Monitor customer needs, market trends, and competitive activity, and share actionable insights with internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the Non-Acute team, Business Units, Marketing and other internal partners to advance priority opportunities.
  • Apply the BD Way of Selling and use approved commercial tools and resources consistently.
  • Conduct all business in accordance with BD’s Code of Conduct, policies and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Education and Experience required:

  • College or University degree required. Business or medical-based studies would be considered an asset.
  • Minimum of two years’ experience in the MedTech and/or medical device industry in sales or related roles required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook required

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Fluency in English and French (read write speak) is required.
  • Customer-focused sales professional with a demonstrated ability to achieve results.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to explain clinical and commercial information to varied audiences.
  • Strong territory, pipeline, and priority management capabilities.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate market insights into action.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and build effective relationships with customers, channel partners, and internal teams.
  • Self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities and opportunities within a matrixed organization.
  • Ability to travel up to 20%, including occasional overnight travel, if applicable.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior experience in selling to Non-Acute environments (e.g. clinics, home care, retail pharmacy, biotech/pharma) and through distribution partners preferred.
  • Previous experience selling remotely considered an asset.
  • Experience with Salesforce.com will be considered a strong asset.

Le ou la gestionnaire de territoire bilingue, soins non aigus, en télétravail, est responsable de la croissance des revenus et de la gestion des activités commerciales existantes dans les territoires désignés du Québec et du Nouveau-Brunswick. La personne titulaire du poste développe des occasions d’affaires auprès des clients, des distributeurs et d’autres partenaires de distribution, établit de solides relations avec les parties prenantes et propose des solutions qui répondent aux besoins des clients tout en s’alignant sur les objectifs commerciaux de BD.

En étroite collaboration avec l’équipe des soins non aigus et les unités d’affaires concernées, le ou la gestionnaire de territoire, soins non aigus, traduit les priorités stratégiques en plans d’action concrets pour son territoire, maintient un solide pipeline d’occasions d’affaires et fournit aux partenaires de distribution les connaissances et les ressources nécessaires à leur réussite. La personne retenue devra démontrer de solides compétences commerciales tout en appliquant de façon constante les processus de vente, les outils et les normes éthiques de BD.

Ce poste en télétravail exige que la personne retenue réside à proximité d’un aéroport important afin de faciliter les déplacements partout au Canada. Le poste nécessite des déplacements pouvant représenter jusqu’à 20 % du temps (Quebec ou Nouveau-Brunswick).


Responsabilités du poste

  • Gérer les activités commerciales au moyen d’une combinaison d’interactions directes avec les clients et d’activités de vente réalisées par les distributeurs, selon le compte, le segment de marché et la catégorie de produits.
  • Atteindre les objectifs de revenus et de croissance attribués en gérant les activités commerciales existantes et en développant de nouvelles occasions de vente.
  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre un plan de territoire aligné sur les stratégies commerciales et de marketing de BD.
  • Établir et maintenir des relations productives à long terme avec les clients, les distributeurs et les autres partenaires de distribution.
  • Cerner les besoins des clients et élaborer des solutions mutuellement avantageuses qui répondent aux objectifs des clients et de BD.
  • Constituer, maintenir et faire progresser un pipeline d’occasions d’affaires qualifiées et alignées sur les priorités du territoire, en veillant à définir clairement les prochaines étapes, les échéanciers et le potentiel de revenus.
  • Protéger les activités commerciales existantes en maintenant de solides relations avec les clients, en surveillant les activités de la concurrence et en cernant les risques liés à la fidélisation de la clientèle dans le territoire attribué.
  • Appliquer les principes de planification stratégique des comptes afin de prioriser les clients, de cerner les occasions de croissance et de soutenir l’atteinte des objectifs du territoire.
  • Fournir des prévisions précises pour le territoire et tenir à jour les renseignements sur les occasions d’affaires, les clients et les activités afin d’appuyer la planification des activités et l’exactitude des prévisions.
  • Soutenir, selon le cas, les activités liées aux devis, aux propositions, aux appels d’offres et aux contrats des clients en coordonnant les renseignements requis et en collaborant avec les parties prenantes internes conformément aux processus de l’entreprise. Collaborer avec les partenaires de distribution afin de renforcer leur connaissance des produits, leurs capacités de vente et l’exécution sur le marché.
  • Cerner et évaluer de nouveaux canaux ainsi que de nouvelles occasions auprès des clients et des partenaires.
  • Développer et maintenir de solides connaissances cliniques, techniques et concurrentielles pour l’ensemble du portefeuille attribué.
  • Surveiller les besoins des clients, les tendances du marché et les activités de la concurrence, et communiquer des renseignements exploitables aux parties prenantes internes.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe des soins non aigus, les unités d’affaires, le Marketing et les autres partenaires internes afin de faire progresser les occasions prioritaires.
  • Appliquer les principes du BD Way of Selling et utiliser de façon constante les outils et les ressources commerciaux approuvés.
  • Mener toutes les activités commerciales conformément au Code de conduite de BD, aux politiques de l’entreprise ainsi qu’aux exigences juridiques et réglementaires applicables.

Formation et expérience requises

  • Diplôme d’études collégiales ou universitaires requis. Une formation en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine médical est considérée comme un atout.
  • Au moins deux années d’expérience dans l’industrie des technologies médicales (MedTech) et/ou des dispositifs médicaux, dans la vente ou dans des fonctions connexes, sont requises.
  • Maîtrise de Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint et Outlook requise.

Connaissances et compétences

  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit, requise.
  • Professionnel ou professionnelle de la vente axé sur la clientèle, ayant démontré sa capacité à obtenir des résultats.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en présentation, en négociation et en relations interpersonnelles.
  • Capacité à expliquer des renseignements cliniques et commerciaux à différents auditoires.
  • Solides compétences en gestion de territoire, de pipeline et des priorités.
  • Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, ainsi qu’une capacité à transformer les renseignements sur le marché en mesures concrètes.
  • Capacité à influencer les parties prenantes et à établir des relations efficaces avec les clients, les partenaires de distribution et les équipes internes.
  • Autonomie, motivation et sens des responsabilités, avec la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante dans un environnement de télétravail.
  • Aisance à gérer simultanément plusieurs priorités et occasions d’affaires au sein d’une organisation matricielle.
  • Capacité à voyager jusqu’à 20 % du temps, y compris occasionnellement avec nuitée, selon les besoins.

Qualifications privilégiées

  • Une expérience préalable de la vente dans les milieux de soins non aigus, notamment les cliniques, les soins à domicile, les pharmacies de détail et les secteurs de la biotechnologie ou de l’industrie pharmaceutique, ainsi qu’une expérience de travail avec des partenaires de distribution, est préférable.
  • Une expérience antérieure en vente à distance est considérée comme un atout.
  • Une expérience avec Salesforce.com est considérée comme un atout important.

jobs.title: French Speaking Rust Coding Evaluation Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English.
jobs.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit. 

About the project 

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result. 

About the roles 

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets. 

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus. 

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context. 

Who we are looking for 

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English. 

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language 

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role. 

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail. 

Project at a glance 

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November 

  • Language: French

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person 

  • Project compensation: US$60 - US$80 per hour

  • Work location: fully remote 

How selection works (major steps) 

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability. 

  2. Language test: short exercises in the target language. 

  3. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track. 

  4. Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role. 

  5. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

jobs.excerpt: First things first: do you enjoy solving problems, writing clean code, and figuring out how to make things work better without making them unnecessarily complicated?
jobs.description:
First things first: do you enjoy solving problems, writing clean code, and figuring out how to make things work better without making them unnecessarily complicated? If so, you might be a great fit for Seez.

Seez is an AI-powered automotive technology company transforming how vehicles are bought and sold. Since 2016, we've been building scalable SaaS and digital retail solutions that help dealerships, OEMs, and marketplaces deliver smarter, more seamless car buying experiences. We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong frontend capabilities, solid backend experience, and a knack for finding practical solutions to real problems.

You'll work across multiple live products, contribute to new features, improve existing applications, and collaborate closely with our Product, Design, Backend, QA, and DevOps teams. This is a great opportunity for someone who's confident in their technical abilities but still hungry to learn, take on greater ownership, and grow into a technical leadership role. We're not looking for someone who knows everything. We're looking for someone with strong foundations, good judgment, and the curiosity to keep getting better.

JOB KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Technical & Engineering
    • Develop, maintain and improve web applications with Node.js, Vue.js and/or React.
    • Balance new features, maintenance and improvements across multiple production applications and repositories.
    • Work within existing architectures, design systems and shared engineering standards, extending what exists before building something new.
    • Write clean, maintainable code and favor simple solutions over unnecessary complexity.
    • Work with DevOps on CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery), deployments and infrastructure.
    • Troubleshoot issues and improve performance and reliability.
  • Product & Collaboration
    • Understand the business need and the client behind each feature, and turn requirements into practical implementations.
    • Challenge assumptions constructively and suggest alternatives, including simpler scopes, when you see a better route.
    • Balance technical quality, timelines and product priorities.
    • Communicate clearly, exchange feedback openly, and collaborate with colleagues across different disciplines and working styles.
  • Ownership & Growth
    • Take responsibility for assigned features and projects, from development through delivery and maintenance.
    • Build confidence in making technical decisions and progressively take on more complex responsibilities.
    • Share knowledge, contribute to team discussions, and support less experienced engineers.
    • Seek feedback, learn from challenges, and actively contribute to improving how the team works.
    • Develop the technical judgment, communication, and mentoring skills needed to grow into future leadership opportunities.

Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE PARTY (MUST HAVES)

  • Around 4–7 years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience building and maintaining production applications.

Description

Nayax is looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner to join our global Talent Acquisition team and take a leading role in driving our US recruitment activity.

Cash Application Specialist

Accounts Receivable / Finance Operations

Work Model: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Build Your Career With Alia Services

Alia Services connects talented professionals with growing companies around the world. We specialize in remote recruitment, workforce, and payroll solutions, helping organizations build exceptional teams while creating meaningful career opportunities for professionals.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Cash Application Specialist to join our client's Accounts Receivable team. This role is responsible for managing all aspects of cash application, credit card transactions, and customer payment processing, ensuring accurate and timely posting of incoming payments.

If you have experience in cash applications and Accounts Receivable, enjoy working with financial transactions, and have strong organizational and problem-solving skills, this is an excellent opportunity to grow your career in an international business environment.

Why Join Alia Services?

At Alia Services, we want our team members to feel supported throughout their employment while having opportunities to grow professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to:

  • 100% Remote Work – Work from the comfort of your home while collaborating with an international team and client.

  • Health Insurance – Health insurance coverage provided through SafetyWing, beginning as soon as you are hired.

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) – Enjoy paid time off to rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Reliable Payroll – Consistent payroll administration and support from the Alia Services team.

  • Dedicated HR Support – Access to our People Operations team for employment-related questions, support, and guidance throughout your time with us.

  • Professional Growth – Opportunities to develop your skills, gain international experience, and grow within your role.

  • Coaching & Feedback – Ongoing mentorship, leadership guidance, and development opportunities.

  • International Experience – Gain valuable experience working with international companies and teams.

  • Ongoing Employee Support – From onboarding through your day-to-day employment, Alia Services serves as your dedicated partner throughout your experience with the client.

About the Role

As a Cash Application Specialist, you will be responsible for processing incoming customer payments through various methods, including checks, wire transfers, and credit card transactions. You will ensure payments are accurately applied and posted, handle payment-related inquiries and disputes, and collaborate closely with Accounts Receivable, Credit, Sales, and Account Executives.

This position also involves managing rebates and coupons, recording write-offs in the General Ledger (GL), identifying trends or recurring issues in the cash posting process, and supporting the team in meeting service-level agreements (SLAs).

What You'll Do

Cash Application & Payment Processing

  • Receive and process incoming payments from customers, clients, and other sources through various payment methods, including checks, wire transfers, and credit card payments.

  • Deposit and post cash payments and physical checks received at the office location.

  • Process credit card transactions, including pre-charging, charging, posting, and handling disputes through multiple channels, such as customer self-service portals and dedicated phone lines.

  • Ensure accurate and timely application of customer payments to the appropriate accounts.

  • Enter rebates and coupons into the system and ensure corresponding write-off amounts are properly recorded in the General Ledger (GL).

  • Perform accurate transactional posting against General Ledger (GL) accounts.

  • Maintain an overall understanding of the Accounts Receivable process and related financial transactions.

Customer Communication & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Contact customers via telephone and email regarding payment application questions, discrepancies, or credit card issues.

  • Collaborate with Credit and Accounts Receivable teams, as well as Sales Executives, to resolve deposit-related questions and obtain customer remittance information.

  • Work closely with Sales teams and leadership to identify and communicate trends observed during the cash posting process, including insufficient or inaccurate information provided by customers or Sales teams.

  • Manage all incoming calls during assigned time frames or shifts to meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED.

  • At least 1 year of direct cash application experience in an office environment.

  • At least 1 year of experience in Accounts Receivable (AR).

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

  • Strong communication and active listening skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in person, over the phone, via email, and through video conferences.

  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.

  • Demonstrated problem-solving abilities and sound judgment when prioritizing tasks and managing time independently.

  • Ability to work overtime when required.

  • Openness to learning, receiving constructive feedback, and responding positively to feedback from others.

  • Appreciation for curiosity, creativity, inclusive teamwork, and achieving results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate Degree in Accounting.

  • Intermediate Excel skills, including experience with Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You'll be a strong fit if you are detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable handling financial transactions with accuracy. You understand the importance of timely payment application, enjoy resolving discrepancies, and can communicate effectively with customers and internal teams. You're also proactive in identifying recurring issues, making sound decisions, and contributing to an efficient Accounts Receivable operation.

Lead Software Engineer

Location: US Remote


Ready to make a difference?


ICF is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to lead the hands-on development and continued evolution of the Demand Response Optimization Program (DROP), a client-facing software product that helps utilities plan and evaluate programs designed to manage electricity demand. DROP brings together customer, program, device, and energy-usage data so utility teams can organize participants, plan operational activities, evaluate results, and improve future program performance.


The successful candidate will combine deep software-engineering skills, product thinking, strong communication, and an AI-first mindset. They will translate analytical methods and client needs into secure, reliable, maintainable software while contributing engineering improvements across Sightline ADAPT.


The Opportunity

DROP has progressed from an analytical concept into a product with automated workflows supporting customer and device assignments, program operations, data preprocessing, telemetry processing, performance analysis, and reporting. The next phase requires disciplined software engineering focused on reliability, extensibility, repeatable deployment, and continued product improvement.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. The Lead Software Engineer will remain hands-on, provide technical leadership to contributing engineers, and collaborate on roadmap decisions, engineering standards, delivery risks, and shared platform needs.

Why you will love working here:

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements, work-life balance
  • Investment of the community: Donation matching, volunteer opportunities
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • And many, many more (Ask your recruiter for more details!)

What you will be doing:

Software Development and Technical Leadership

  • Design, develop, test, document, implement, and maintain DROP components across the user interface, APIs, data services, and analytical workflows.
  • Build capabilities for customer and device assignments, cohorting, program planning, telemetry processing, baselines, performance analysis, reporting, and related demand-response workflows.
  • Refactor and modernize existing code to improve maintainability, performance, modularity, security, and reuse.
  • Lead design decisions, code reviews, troubleshooting, and implementation guidance while coordinating broader technical decisions with the engineering team.
  • Mentor contributing engineers and analytical developers assuming formal people-management responsibility.

Product Development and Client Delivery

  • Partner with product leadership, utility consultants, and analytical specialists to understand user needs and translate them into product capabilities, technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
  • Provide technical options, estimates, dependencies, and delivery risks to support roadmap, sprint, and release decisions.
  • Support client implementations, technical discovery, demonstrations, proposals, scopes of work, and solution reviews.
  • Communicate capabilities, limitations, technical tradeoffs, and delivery risks clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Production Engineering and Data Integration

  • Improve automated testing, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, error handling, data validation, deployment practices, and operational documentation.
  • Develop and maintain data-intensive Python and SQL workflows in Microsoft Azure and Databricks environments.
  • Integrate DROP with utility data sources, DERMS platforms, APIs, telemetry feeds, storage services, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and client environments as applicable.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to define reliable schemas, interfaces, data-quality controls, and secure configuration patterns.

AI-First Engineering and Product Innovation

  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and delivery efficiency while maintaining accountability for quality and correctness.
  • Apply team standards for privacy, security, intellectual-property protection, auditability, evaluation, and human oversight when using AI-enabled tools or building AI-enabled features.
  • Identify practical opportunities to incorporate generative AI, agentic workflows, machine learning, or automation into DROP and the software-development process.
  • Evaluate AI-generated code and outputs critically through review, testing, validation, and monitoring.

What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of software development or data-product engineering experience.
  • Experience building and supporting production web applications in cloud environments.
  • Strong software engineering experience with Python, SQL, APIs, data pipelines, front-end technologies, and cloud platforms.
  • Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Ability to build reliable, maintainable software, leverage AI-assisted development tools, and translate product, analytical, and client requirements into technical solutions.

What we would like you to have:

  • Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information systems, or a related field.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Databricks, Apache Spark, Docker, Power BI, or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, FastAPI, .NET, or comparable modern full-stack frameworks.
  • Experience building data-intensive SaaS products or configurable software using time-series, telemetry, event, AMI, or other high-volume operational data.
  • Experience operationalizing machine-learning, optimization, generative-AI, or agentic capabilities, including evaluation and monitoring.
  • Experience integrating software with third-party platforms, APIs, identity services, and client data environments.
  • Experience with demand response, distributed energy resources, virtual power plants, DERMS, utility customer programs, or grid-interactive technologies.
  • Experience modernizing analytical code or converting data-science workflows into production software.
  • Experience supporting client-facing technical discussions, proposals, demonstrations, or implementation planning.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

Role Summary

The Director, Thought Leader Engagement (TLEL) is responsible for partnering with marketeers to develop and execute a best-in-class, compliant engagement strategy with national and regional Thought Leaders / Opinion Leaders (OLs) to advance Pfizer’s or Specialty Care’s legitimate business objectives (branded and unbranded) across the Gastroenterology (GI) franchise.

This role serves as the primary commercial liaison to identify OLs, creating consistent and high-quality One Pfizer experiences while gathering insights that inform brand, franchise, and customer engagement strategies. The Director will partner closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Sales Leadership, Market Access, and other cross-functional colleagues to ensure engagement plans are integrated, strategic, and aligned to business priorities.


Key Responsibilities

Thought Leader Engagement & Strategy

  • Partner with marketeers to develop and execute a strategic OL engagement plan aligned to brand and GI franchise objectives.
  • Support and inform OL engagement strategy development, and execute approved engagement plans in alignment with cross-functional owners.
  • Map the OL community to identify new/emerging OLs based on brand strategies.
  • Map connections and relationships within the Gastroenterology OL community to inform potential engagement strategies and channels.
  • Support the development and execution of individualized OL engagement approaches.
  • Establish, maintain, and strengthen long-term relationships with national and regional Thought Leaders / Opinion Leaders.
  • Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for assigned OLs, ensuring a consistent and coordinated Pfizer presence.
  • Deliver a One Pfizer experience by aligning engagement activities across functions.
  • Identify ways to advance and expand engagement with OLs through innovative initiatives, including digital and novel engagement models.

Insight Generation & Application

  • Lead insight gathering to support Gastroenterology brand and other Pfizer objectives through 1:1 engagements and small group meetings.
  • Capture, synthesize, and share insights on OL expertise and experience, brand perceptions, treatment patterns, unmet needs, and market dynamics that are capable of being turned into actionable commercial recommendations.
  • Maintain consistent documentation of insights to support longitudinal understanding of relationships, enable knowledge sharing, and inform future engagement.
  • Inform the development and execution of HCP and customer engagement strategies.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Sales, Market Access, and other internal stakeholders to align OL engagement with broader commercial and medical plans.
  • Support brand and franchise planning through OL insights and strategic input.
  • Collaborate with global and regional colleagues, as appropriate, to align engagement approaches.

Congress, Meetings & Engagement Metrics

  • Support Marketing and Medical in developing OL engagement approaches for national and regional congresses and meetings through insights, including recommendations and coordination.
  • Plan and coordinate OL interactions at meetings in partnership with brand teams.
  • Establish and track engagement metrics, including post-engagement evaluations and performance against objectives.
  • Maintain up-to-date OL lists and track engagement activity.

Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure all OL engagements are conducted in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.
  • Partner with marketing project owner, legal, and compliance teams to ensure consistent and appropriate engagement practices.

Basic Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Approximately 8–10+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or related healthcare industries.
  • Experience in commercial, medical affairs, marketing, sales leadership, strategy, or customer engagement roles.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with external Thought Leaders and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success working in a cross-functional, matrixed environment with influence-based leadership.
  • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate customer insights into actionable strategies.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Gastroenterology experience.

  • Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated creativity and problem-solving orientation.

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Strategic and Operational Intelligence Analyst delivers proactive, forward-looking analysis of the cyber threat landscape and translates that analysis into direction and action for Humana's information security organization. You will set the strategic threat picture that guides CTI collection, processing, and analysis while supporting the development of proactive countermeasures that reduce Humana's exposure before threats materialize. Working with operational analysts, the analyst ensures strategic analysis translates into operational outcomes by shaping what CTI tracks, what partners act on, and where Humana strengthens its preparedness. The analyst applies AI, automation, and disciplined analysis to identify what matters most, anticipate changes in the threat landscape, and lead action on priority cyber threats. The analyst is comfortable working directly with threat and security data, exploring patterns, testing hypotheses, and combining quantitative evidence with qualitative intelligence to produce defensible assessments and practical recommendations.

Main Responsibilities

Threat Prioritization

  • Own the actor and threat prioritization framework that guides CTI's operational focus, collection posture, and countermeasure development
  • Identify priority threats and actors relevant to Enterprise Information Protection, Technology, Business, and Enterprise partners; ensure prioritization reflects sector-specific and Humana-specific risk
  • Continuously update the prioritization frameworks as the threat landscape shifts, using AI and automation to help build and maintain them at scale, and ensure they are embedded in how the CTI team and its stakeholders make decisions

Threat Analysis and Reporting

  • Produce recurring and ad-hoc assessments of the current and projected threat landscape, framed for Humana-specific relevance and decision-making
  • Analyze internal and external threat, vulnerability, and security data to identify patterns, assess relevance to Humana, and distinguish meaningful changes from noise
  • Clearly articulate priority current and emerging threats and their implications in both written products and verbal briefings to internal and external stakeholders, including leadership stakeholders
  • Spearhead strategic threat perspectives in support of CTI's engagement with Humana’s strategic initiatives, ensuring policies and planning are proactively informed by the threat landscape
  • Generate industry-leading analysis from concept to delivery with limited direction, sometimes on tight deadlines

Countermeasures Development

  • Contribute to the development of proactive countermeasure packages that translate threat analysis into specific, prioritized actions for Detection Engineering, SOC, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and other consuming teams
  • Work closely with CTI peers and control owners to ensure recommendations are actionable, appropriately scoped, feasible, and tied to current threats

Program Maturation and Tradecraft

  • Influence the maturation and efficacy of the CTI program through continual improvement of analytic practices, tools, and services
  • Review and edit CTI finished intelligence prior to dissemination, ensuring adherence to industry-leading analytic tradecraft standards and reinforcing rigorous analytic thinking across the team
  • Apply AI and automation tools to enhance analysis, improve speed to insight, and deliver higher-impact intelligence outcomes; contribute to how the CTI team adopts and integrates AI into analytic workflows
  • Experiment with data sources, analytic methods, and tools to answer emerging intelligence questions; refine approaches based on what the evidence shows

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of intelligence experience, with meaningful time in all-source cyber threat analysis and demonstrated experience contributing to operational intelligence workflows
  • Demonstrated curiosity and hands-on problem-solving: comfortable exploring unfamiliar data, testing approaches, and adjusting an analysis
  • Experience with the cyber threat landscape, including prominent actors, TTPs, and sector-specific threat trends
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and their application to intelligence analysis, including using AI to accelerate research, structure analysis, and maintain analytic products at scale
  • Experience analyzing structured or semi-structured data to answer intelligence questions, identify trends or anomalies, and communicate the limitations of the data and the confidence of resulting judgments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate complex subjects concisely
  • Experience conducting analysis of the cyber threat landscape and translating that analysis into direction and action
  • Working knowledge of security controls, enterprise technologies, telemetry, and defensive workflows, with experience partnering with detection, hunting, response, or vulnerability
  • Experience producing strategic intelligence products for senior leadership, including executive briefings
  • Demonstrated ability to influence program strategy and improve of practices, tools, and services
  • Ability to work independently, determine methods and priorities, and deliver under tight deadlines
  • Familiarity with structured analytic techniques, MITRE ATT&CK, and standard CTI analytic frameworks

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering with detection engineering, SOC, or vulnerability management teams to translate intelligence into action
  • Experience integrating AI or automation into intelligence workflows, including collection, analysis, or reporting
  • Experience with ISAC engagement and information sharing across peer organizations
  • Relevant security certification

jobs.title: Director, Supplemental Benefits Strategy & Transformation
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community About Humana Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 50 healthcare company with a long history of successful innovation and reinvention.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

About Humana
Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 50 healthcare company with a long history of successful innovation and reinvention. Over its history, Humana has evolved from nursing homes, to hospitals, to health insurance, and today is a leader in consumer-focused health solutions and one of the largest health benefits organizations in the country.

About the Team
The Supplemental Benefits team delivers and oversees some of the most visible and valued benefits that Humana's Medicare Advantage members receive. These benefits extend beyond traditional medical coverage and include dental, vision, hearing, over-the-counter health and wellness products, fitness, transportation, meals, in-home support, connectivity, and other services that help members maintain their health, independence, and quality of life.

We design, launch, and manage a diverse portfolio of supplemental benefits reaching millions of members. Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, vendor partnership, data and analytics, operational execution, member experience and compliance.

This is a team where the work is unusually tangible and high impact. The decisions made here can influence how millions of Medicare Advantage members access dental care, obtain needed hearing support, get to a medical appointment, remain safely and independently at home, or stay connected to their care team. We partner with leaders across the enterprise and with external organizations that deliver these benefits at scale.

As the portfolio grows in size, complexity, and importance, we are building the shared capabilities needed to manage it consistently and at scale — including a dedicated strategy and transformation capability focused on the portfolio's highest-priority opportunities and most complex challenges.

Role Overview

The Director, Supplemental Benefits Strategy & Transformation will build and lead a new team responsible for strategy, transformation, and complex cross-portfolio initiatives across Humana's Supplemental Benefits organization.


This leader will serve as a senior thought and execution partner to Supplemental Benefits leadership, bringing structure and momentum to the organization's most complex and ambiguous priorities and initiatives. Initiatives will span multiple benefits, vendors, and enterprise functions and include vendor strategy and optimization, operating model transformation, implementation capability, regulatory response, portfolio analytics, governance, and emerging strategic opportunities.


Success will require the Director to translate strategic, regulatory, financial, operational, and member-experience considerations into clear recommendations, executable roadmaps, defined ownership, and measurable outcomes — accountable not only for developing recommendations, but for mobilizing stakeholders and driving initiatives through implementation and adoption. Example projects could include reimagining how a multi-million-dollar vendor relationship is structured and governed, designing the operating model for a new benefit reaching millions of members, or building the analytics capability that allows leaders to see portfolio performance clearly. The common thread is work that is consequential, cross-functional, visible to Humana's senior leaders, and improves the daily lives of millions of Medicare Advantage members.


A defining principle of the role is that the team builds and transitions rather than builds and holds. Once a capability, process, or governance routine is designed, implemented, and stabilized, the Director is responsible for transitioning it to Shared Services Operations, benefit owners, or other appropriate teams for ongoing execution — preserving the team's capacity for the next set of high-value problems.


A critical early responsibility will be to build and lead a new Strategy & Transformation team, expected to grow to approximately 4–5 professionals, including defining the team's capabilities and operating model, recruiting and developing high-performing talent, and deploying the team dynamically against the portfolio's highest-priority needs.


This is a hands-on leadership role with significant exposure to senior leaders across Humana and accountability for delivering tangible business and financial outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


Lead Cross-Portfolio Strategy & Transformation

  • Lead the highest-priority strategic and transformation initiatives spanning multiple supplemental benefits, vendors, and enterprise functions
  • Structure complex or ambiguous business problems into clear hypotheses, analyses, workstreams, deliverables, ownership, milestones, and decisions
  • Develop fact-based recommendations integrating financial, operational, member, competitive, regulatory, and vendor perspectives, and translate them into executable roadmaps
  • Rapidly assess the Supplemental Benefits implications of significant regulatory changes and lead cross-functional response teams to drive operational execution and implementation

Drive Portfolio and Vendor Strategy

  • Evaluate emerging supplemental-benefit opportunities, new capabilities, and potential changes as a result of Humana's broader Medicare Advantage strategy
  • Develop forward-looking strategies and multi-year roadmaps to optimize the Supplemental Benefits portfolio and vendor ecosystem
  • Assess benefit and vendor performance, economics, market capabilities, member value, operational complexity, and strategic fit to identify optimization opportunities
  • Develop business cases supporting vendor consolidation, sourcing, RFI/RFP activity, capability investments, and other strategic decisions

Transform the Operating Model and Build Scalable Capabilities

  • Lead transformation of the Supplemental Benefits operating model, including governance, decision rights, management routines, and cross-functional ways of working
  • Establish a repeatable vendor implementation capability spanning requirements, accountability, milestones, testing, readiness, launch, executive visibility, and post-launch stabilization
  • Design portfolio-wide approaches to vendor performance governance — quarterly business reviews, scorecards, KPI and SLA frameworks, escalation standards, and remediation
  • Develop executive reporting, analytics and decision support capabilities that synthesize complex information into clear performance insights
  • Identify fragmented, manual, or inconsistent processes and lead redesign that improves accountability, reduces risk, and increases organizational leverage
  • Transition mature, repeatable capabilities to Shared Services Operations, benefit owners, or other accountable teams, with clear ownership, documentation, and measures in place

Build and Lead the Strategy & Transformation Team

  • Build a new high-performing team, expected to grow to approximately 4–5 professionals, defining its capabilities, roles, operating model, and management routines
  • Recruit, develop, coach, and retain talent with strong structured problem-solving, analytical, communication, and execution capabilities
  • Establish high standards for problem-solving, analytics, executive communication, project management, and implementation discipline
  • Manage a dynamic portfolio of initiatives, making deliberate trade-offs about where deploying the team's capacity creates the greatest business and member impact
  • Create a team culture defined by intellectual curiosity, pragmatism, accountability, collaboration, and bias toward action

Key Outcomes Include:

  • High-priority strategic, regulatory, and operational transformations delivered with clear ownership and measurable results
  • A prioritized multi-year roadmap for optimizing the Supplemental Benefits portfolio and vendor ecosystem
  • Measurable financial and operational value identified and captured across vendors and the portfolio
  • A repeatable vendor implementation capability adopted across significant benefit launches and changes
  • A clearer, more scalable operating model with defined governance, decision rights, accountability, and management routines
  • A high-performing team capable of independently leading multiple complex initiatives simultaneously — with mature capabilities successfully transitioned into recurring operations


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 8+ years of progressive experience within management consulting, corporate strategy, enterprise transformation, healthcare strategy/operations, and/or comparable roles solving complex business problems
  • 2+ years leading and developing high-performing teams, with demonstrated ability to build new capabilities and manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously
  • Meaningful experience within Medicare Advantage, managed care, or closely related healthcare services industries, with demonstrated ability to operate in complex regulated environments
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition and analysis through implementation, adoption, and measurable results
