jobs.description:
Description

About Acadia.io

2024 AdAge A-List - Performance Marketing Agency of the Year

2022 Best Places to Work, The Atlanta Business Chronicle

Small Ad Agency of the Year – AdAge (

Acadia is a modern media and growth agency. We have a bottom-up, audience-based approach to media that is very accountable and addressable. Media is not “one thing” at Acadia, but many. Acadia is a very agile agency environment, with a "roll up your sleeves" mentality needed across all employees.

Our Core Values

  • Can-Do - We dedicate ourselves to helping our clients and co-workers reach their fullest potential. We demonstrate courage and urgency to find solutions and take ownership.
  • Curiosity - We show genuine interest. We are the first to ask why, the first to research, and the first to understand. We ask questions until we find the path to conquer obstacles and build solutions.
  • Candor - We are honest and transparent in all our actions. We strive to foster positive and mutually beneficial relationships — where respect and humanity thrive.
  • Community - We will make lives better for those people, clients, and other deserving causes that we care deeply about.

As a Retail Media Specialist, you will be vital in continuing our efforts as an industry leader by implementing best in-class retail media PPC and display strategies across Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Target, Kroger, Chewy, Ulta and more.

This role is one that is challenging and rewarding as you develop your Amazon PPC skills and stay up-to-date with new paid search features, leveraging Acadia’s industry leading position within the space. The successful candidate has an opportunity to develop an exciting career in a dynamic, growing digital marketing company.

This position reports directly to a Retail Media Manager.

A week in the life of a Retail Media Specialist

A snapshot of a typical week for a Retail Media member captures:

  • No-stress commuting.You work from home so your daily commute is only the amount of time it takes for you to walk into your home office or travel to your favorite coffee shop for a change of scenery.
  • Advertising Optimization. You use our ad management software and native advertising dashboards to identify opportunities and optimize our clients’ advertising campaigns on a daily / weekly basis. You use additional third party software to perform keyword research and implement automated optimization tactics.
  • Communication. Your work calendar has internal & client appointments to present the latest results, activities and planned tactics for the upcoming 90 days. You’ve gotten to the essence of clients’ needs and identified the ways Acadia can be their guide to achieving them.
  • Collaboration. Acadia is a team of go-getters, innovators and industry experts. Over the week, you communicate with colleagues to exchange experiences, coordinate with team members who work on other aspects of the client business (brand protection, SEO, organic marketing) and define strategies that are aligned with one another.
  • Innovation. You check out the competition to see what strategies they’re employing to drive growth.
  • Reporting.You report to clients in your portfolio on a weekly / bi-weekly basis delivering the data but also the story behind the data, as well as next steps to improve performance further.
  • Trends. You can quickly identify trends within the account you manage and take appropriate action to course correct.
  • Thought Leadership. You contribute to the company owned blog, attend company hosted webinars and other live events where you share your latest views on Amazon advertising’s latest developments and opportunities.

Before you know it, another week has come to a close and you go into the weekend energized knowing you’ve once again contributed to the growth and success of Acadia and the brands we support.

Qualifications

Job Expectations

The successful candidate will have a proven track record of ability in the following areas:

  • Managing complex advertising campaigns with thousands of targeting options per account.
  • Working in a collaborative team culture.
  • Ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously.
  • Identifying opportunities for clients’ growth, and new services for existing markets.

Candidates must quickly become comfortable articulating the value of Acadia to clients and prospects by representing our company’s services while maintaining a deep client focus. A lifelong learner with a strong drive for results is essential.

Candidates should possess

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or marketing is preferred
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Ability to work well independently and be self-motivated
  • Excellent analytical, oral and written communication
  • Attention to detail while also having the ability to handle multiple priorities
  • 1+ years of experience with Pay Per Click advertising (Amazon Advertising, Google Ads, Bing Ads, Facebook Ads…) strongly preferred
  • 1+ years of experience with Amazon Advertising is required

Our interview process consists of 3 virtual interviews and a brief technical assessment for successful candidates. We will also ask candidates for 2-3 professional references from past employers when making our offer.

Acadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Our creativity powers business growth and this only happens by having diversity of talent in the room and reflecting society in the experiences we create. We value the diversity of our colleagues, our clients, and the third parties with whom we work. We believe that the more diverse we are, the more creative our work will be!

jobs.title: Development Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Women Donors Network (WDN) and its 501(c)(4) affiliate, Women Donors Action (WDA), are hiring a passionate and seasoned Development Operations Manager to build and manage the systems, data, and workflows that power our rapidly growing donor network and grantmaking organization.
jobs.description:
Women Donors Network (WDN) and its 501(c)(4) affiliate, Women Donors Action (WDA), are hiring a passionate and seasoned Development Operations Manager to build and manage the systems, data, and workflows that power our rapidly growing donor network and grantmaking organization. This role is for a CRM owner, systems builder, and data steward who takes pride in data integrity, reporting, and analytics. You’re energized by designing standards and tools that people actually adopt, and you understand that behind every record is a relationship.

This is a full-time, remote role based in the United States, with occasional travel. The Development Operations Manager reports to the Vice President of Community & Development and works closely with the Finance Team, the Technology Team, and external consultants. Grounded in a deep commitment to social justice, this role helps strengthen the leadership and effectiveness of a multiracial, multigenerational membership community of donor organizers.

ABOUT US

Women Donors Network (WDN) is a national network of women (cis and trans), nonbinary, and gender-expansive individuals committed to protecting and advancing gender, racial, economic, and climate justice. As a growing multiracial and multigenerational community of donor organizers, we connect, grow, fund, and mobilize together in solidarity with movements to transform people, culture, and systems rooted in justice. Through Women Donors Action (WDA), our 501c4 affiliate organization, we work to transform policies, political infrastructure, and political possibilities by investing in advocacy and electoral strategies that center the leadership of historically excluded communities. Together, we envision a just and sustainable world where everyone can safely and freely determine their own futures.

This is an exciting time at WDN and WDA as we move into the fourth year of our bold strategic plan. We have a growing team passionate about social justice and motivated to scale our impact. Our values are rooted in a culture of courage, commitment, curiosity, accountability, hope, and joy. You can read more about our path forward here.

We are a geographically distributed, remote team of 27 from diverse intersectional identities, including cisgender, BIPOC, and nonbinary people. We have a shared staffing structure across WDN and WDA, with our team dedicating a portion of time to each entity. We believe that a diverse team is integral to our work and strongly encourage applications from people of color, people with disabilities, women, LGBTQIA+, and all other applicants from historically excluded identities in the United States.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a pivotal moment for the Development Operations Manager to join the team at WDN/WDA. WDN/WDA is on track to steward $35M+ annually through a bespoke membership model where our members give at levels ranging from four to nine figures. As our membership community and grantmaking continue to grow, the Development Operations Manager will build and manage the development operations infrastructure our community, grantmaking, and organizations need to scale.

As Development Operations Manager at WDN/WDA, most of your time will focus on CRM management, data integrity, and analytics. You’ll own day-to-day use of Salesforce, set the data standards every team follows, and build the dashboards and reports that give senior leadership a clear view of fundraising progress, member engagement, and pipeline health. You’ll partner with the Head of Technology and external consultants on larger builds and platform decisions. Because WDN and WDA share a staffing structure, you’ll process and track gifts across both entities, and apply the distinct acknowledgment and compliance practices each entity requires. A smaller portion of your time will support member coordination, including onboarding, prospective member pipeline management, and engagement at Community & Development events.

In 2027, we’re launching a network power mapping project to better understand the relationships and reach within our community. We see a significant opportunity to clean up and strengthen our donor data, and we’re exploring whether our current CRM will meet our needs as we scale. You’ll be at the center of all three efforts, turning our data into a trustworthy, shared resource that informs how we cultivate, steward, and engage members.

During your first year as the Development Operations Manager at WDN/WDA, you will:

  • Lead a comprehensive cleanup of our donor and member data and establish clear standards to keep it clean, making Salesforce a trusted single source of truth.
  • Build engagement tracking across member-facing teams, Board members, and member Ambassadors that supports WDN/WDA’s member engagement and retention strategy.
  • Strengthen moves management in Salesforce, including stage definitions and pipeline review processes, so the team can track cultivation and solicitation consistently.
  • Evaluate existing Salesforce fields and recommend updates that enable the CRM to serve as the repository for data from our forthcoming network power mapping project.
  • Deliver dashboards that senior leadership relies on to understand fundraising progress, retention, and engagement.
  • Help evaluate our CRM needs and, if we move forward with a migration, play a central role in planning and executing it.
  • Create documentation and training that makes our systems easy to use correctly.


This is a remote position open to candidates based in the United States. Candidates must be available during weekday business hours across U.S. time zones and able to travel occasionally within the United States for meetings, team retreats, and organizational events. Candidates must have at least 5 years of development operations experience and demonstrated comfort with remote work. We are not accepting applications from outside the United States or from staffing agencies.


ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

As Women Donors Network and Women Donors Action continue to implement our strategic plan, the Development Operations Manager will play a critical role in:


CRM & DATA MANAGEMENT

  • Manage day-to-day use of the Salesforce CRM, including data entry, cleanup, and deduplication for membership and fundraising records.
  • Oversee timely, accurate processing and acknowledgment of contributions and pledges across WDN (501(c)(3)) and WDA (501(c)(4)), while partnering with the Finance Team on monthly reconciliation.
  • Continuously improve and optimize Salesforce in partnership with the Head of Technology, the Community & Development Team, and external consultants by building and refining fields, workflows, automations, moves-management processes, and reporting, so the CRM evolves into a stronger, more powerful tool for WDN/WDA.
  • Design systems to track member engagement across all member-facing teams, creating a comprehensive record of member experience that supports seamless member engagement, informs our forthcoming network power mapping project, and sharpens WDN/WDA’s donor cultivation and stewardship strategies.
  • Set and enforce organization-wide CRM data standards, field definitions, and permissions so that every team logs information consistently, while partnering directly with the Head of Technology on data security and access.
  • Write SOPs and training materials so Salesforce and related tools (Slack, iWave, and others) are easy for the team to use correctly, and lead rollouts so new processes stick.
  • Serve as the Community & Development Team’s primary point of contact for CRM consultants and development-related platforms.
  • Assess whether WDN/WDA’s current tools meet the team’s needs and recommend changes, including opportunities to integrate Salesforce with other platforms, Salesforce upgrades, or a potential CRM migration, with requirements gathering, testing plans, data migration, and timeline tracking.

DATA ANALYTICS & INSIGHTS

  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking progress to fundraising goals, member retention, engagement, and pipeline health.
  • Build reports for the Community & Development Team on donor segmentation, prospects, current members, and renewals.
  • Analyze fundraising and engagement data to identify trends and opportunities, and present clear, actionable insights to senior leadership.
  • Lead and represent the Community & Development Team in cross-functional working groups that improve shared workflows and data practices.

MEMBER ENGAGEMENT

  • Coordinate new member onboarding and offboarding, including welcome gifts, notifying staff when new members join, and adding or removing members from WDN/WDA’s suite of communication platforms.
  • Manage the prospective member pipeline, including recruitment materials, event invitations, and discovery call scheduling.
  • Support the Vice President, Community & Development in tracking member solicitations and engagement.
  • Drive member attendance and engagement at Community & Development events by managing invitations, RSVPs, reminders, and follow-up communications, in partnership with the Operations Team which leads event planning and logistics.
  • Support Community & Development events and outreach through list segmentation, campaign coding, and accurate entry of registration and engagement data into Salesforce.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of member profiles and meeting preparation documents.
  • Serve as a go-to resource for members’ and prospective members’ questions and scheduling needs, while responding to inquiries received through the Community & Development inbox.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of member and organizational information.

TEAM ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaborate with the wider team on annual planning and budgeting.
  • Participate in team meetings and projects, sharing insights and collaborating with colleagues to achieve shared goals.
  • Support onboarding and training of new team members, including on CRM practices and data standards.
  • Stay current on development operations best practices and emerging tools, including AI, through training, workshops, and self-directed learning, and bring new approaches back to the team.

Requirements

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

As the Development Operations Manager on the Community & Development Team, you must bring:

  • Development operations expertise. You have at least 5 years of experience in development operations. You’ve overseen gift processing, acknowledgments, and reconciliation with Finance, and you understand the stakes of getting donor data right. Experience with multi-entity organization or 501(c)(3)/501(c)(4) gift processing is a strong plus.
  • CRM management and data stewardship. You’re an advanced CRM user, with Salesforce strongly preferred. Your CRM management, data analysis, and project tracking are highly accurate and dependable. You independently build reports and dashboards, manage imports and deduplication, and configure fields, layouts, and straightforward automations. You know when a project needs a consultant, and you write clear requirements and manage that work to completion. Salesforce Administrator certification and experience with a CRM migration are a strong plus.
  • Strong data analysis and storytelling. You turn raw data into clear insights and recommendations, and you can present them to senior leaders in ways that inform decisions.
  • Systems building and change management. You’ve designed or improved operational systems and processes, and you’ve gotten colleagues to adopt them through thoughtful documentation, training, and follow-through.
  • Proven track record of strong project management. You manage multiple workstreams, competing deadlines, and dependencies with rigor, and you prioritize with sound judgment. You can translate ideas into a clear plan with owners, timelines, and follow-up, and you keep it moving. You take ownership of work from start to finish and drive it forward independently, so colleagues and leadership can count on it getting done.
  • Discretion with sensitive and confidential information. You’ve handled sensitive and confidential donor and organizational information with discretion and care. You communicate comfortably with donors across differences in race, age, wealth, power, influence and privilege. Experience with major donors or membership organizations is a plus.
  • Remote technology fluency. You’re proficient with Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, and MacOS. Experience with prospect research tools such as iWave is a plus. You’re curious about AI tools and integrations, not afraid to try new tools, and eager to find efficiencies and reduce manual work alongside the Technology Team and Finance Team, while safeguarding sensitive donor data.

CANDIDATE CHARACTERISTICS

The ideal Development Operations Manager is:

  • Deeply committed to WDN/WDA’s mission, values and strategy. You’re energized by building and wielding collective power in service of gender, racial, economic, and climate justice. You represent the Community and Development Team with warmth and integrity across staff, members, board members, movement leaders, and partners.
  • Grounded in integrity, curious, and anticipatory. You follow through on your commitments and honor the trust members place in WDN/WDA with their information and relationships. You bring calm and good judgment to busy periods and thrive when processes are still being defined. You actively learn the work, stakeholders, and priorities, notice dependencies and potential friction early, and act before small issues become big ones.
  • A systems thinker who builds for people. You design tools and processes around how people actually work, and you measure success by adoption, not technical elegance.
  • Emotionally intelligent and culturally fluent. You are warm, perceptive, grounded, and self-aware. You build trust across a multiracial, multigenerational community, read interpersonal dynamics, and navigate sensitive situations with care and discretion. You’re comfortable with direct feedback and communicate your own needs clearly.
  • Exacting about data integrity. You hold high standards for accuracy and consistency, and you notice when something doesn’t add up.
  • A translator. You bridge the gap between data and the people who use it, making systems approachable for colleagues and insights meaningful for leadership.
  • A proactive communicator with sound judgment. You communicate early, surface concerns, confirm alignment, and close loops without waiting to be asked. Your updates clearly convey what matters, what you recommend, and any decisions needed. You distinguish what you can handle, what belongs with another team member, and what requires escalation, and you’re honest about mistakes, uncertainty, and capacity.

CANDIDACY PROCESS AND TIMELINE

To be considered for the Development Operations Manager role, please submit an application and resume at this application link on the WDN Careers Page. This role will remain open until filled, prioritizing applications received prior to November 23 when we will begin an initial application review.

To protect the integrity of our structured candidacy process, we kindly ask that all applicants do not call, email or message our office or any member of the WDN Team or Board of Directors about the Development Operations Manager role.

Benefits

The base salary for the Development Operations Manager starts at $110K/year. This role is also eligible to receive WDN's Employee Benefits Package which includes:

We're looking for a Senior Talent Partner who knows the US tech ecosystem, understands AI and infrastructure, and can become one of Runware's key people on the ground as we expand in the US.

What you'll do

Build our US team

You'll own and support hiring across some of our most strategic US roles, particularly in:

  • AI / Machine Learning
  • Infrastructure & Compute
  • Software Engineering
  • Product
  • Leadership and other strategic hires

You'll work directly with founders and senior leaders to understand what we actually need rather than simply execute against a list of open positions.

Build a network, not just a pipeline

We don't want someone whose sourcing strategy starts and ends with LinkedIn Recruiter.

We want you to:

  • Develop strong relationships within the US AI and technology ecosystem
  • Build long-term networks of engineers, founders, operators and technical leaders
  • Attend and help identify relevant meetups, conferences and industry events
  • Create relationships with people who may not be actively looking for their next role
  • Help make Runware better known within the US AI community
  • Identify creative ways to reach exceptional people

San Francisco / Bay Area experience and an existing network there would be a significant advantage.

Understand the technology

You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be genuinely comfortable in technical environments.

You should be interested in topics such as AI inference, GPUs, distributed systems, ML infrastructure, data centers and the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem.

We expect our Talent team to understand what we're building and to be able to have credible conversations with highly technical candidates.

Help us build Runware in the US

We're establishing and growing Runware Inc., so your contribution won't necessarily stop at recruitment.

From time to time, you may help with topics such as:

  • US employment practices and market expectations
  • Employment contracts and onboarding
  • Benefits and People processes
  • Local vendors and partners
  • Employee experience for our US team
  • Identifying when we need external HR, legal or specialist support

You won't be expected to be an employment lawyer or HR specialist. What matters is being curious, pragmatic and willing to take ownership when something needs to be figured out.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Talent Partnering, executive search or a similar role
  • Strong experience recruiting technical profiles in the US
  • Good understanding of the US technology ecosystem
  • Experience recruiting within AI, ML, infrastructure, cloud, developer tools or another highly technical environment
  • Ability to engage credibly with senior engineers, technical leaders and founders
  • A strong network — or clear evidence that you know how to build one
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup where roles and priorities evolve quickly
  • Able to work autonomously and make decisions without waiting for multiple layers of validation
  • Interested in broader People and company-building topics beyond recruitment
  • Strong ownership mentality: when you see something that needs doing, you help make it happen

Nice to have

  • Based in the San Francisco Bay Area
  • Existing network within the AI / ML ecosystem
  • Experience in an early-stage or high-growth startup
  • Experience helping a European or international company establish or scale its US presence
  • Exposure to US People Ops, employment or benefits topics
  • Experience recruiting Staff+, Principal, leadership or highly specialized technical profiles

Benefits

We have core hours for cooperative working and calls, but outside of that your calendar is yours. Work the hours that let you perform at your peak while also building a healthy life.

Our release cycles are fast and intense, but they’re followed by real downtime. After big pushes we expect the team to unplug, recharge, and come back ready & stronger than ever for the next leap.

  • Generous paid time off – vacation, sick days, public holidays
  • Meaningful stock options – share in the upside you create
  • Remote-first setup – work from home anywhere we can employ you
  • Flexible hours – own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
  • Family leave – paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time

jobs.excerpt: Who we areWELL Health Technologies is an innovative technology-enabled healthcare company whose overarching objective is to positively impact health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower and support healthcare practitioners and their patients.
jobs.description:
Who we are

WELL Health Technologies is an innovative technology-enabled healthcare company whose overarching objective is to positively impact health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower and support healthcare practitioners and their patients.

WELL has built an innovative practitioner enablement platform that includes comprehensive end to end practice management tools inclusive of virtual care and digital patient engagement capabilities as well as Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and data protection services. WELL Health Technologies, uses this platform to power healthcare practitioners both inside and outside of WELL Health Technologies’ own omni-channel patient services offerings.

WELL owns and operates Canada’s largest network of outpatient medical clinics serving primary and specialized healthcare services and is the provider of a leading multi-national multi-disciplinary telehealth offering. WELL Health Technologies is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol “WELL”.

To learn more about the company, please visit: www.well.company.

Who we need

Reporting to the System Lead - Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP, we are hiring a D365 Support Analyst to own functional support for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations as WELL Health builds and strengthens its ERP team. You will investigate and resolve system challenges, support critical financial processes, and work with internal teams and external partners to improve system reliability and the user experience. Beyond day-to-day support, you will help establish a more proactive, effective approach to ERP support as WELL’s business needs and D365 capabilities evolve.

This is a full-time, permanent, remote role based in Canada, with a preference for candidates who can support Eastern Time business hours.

What’s in it for you

The chance to build. You will join WELL Health as we establish a dedicated ERP team, with the opportunity to influence how D365 support works from the ground up. Your ideas, initiative, and problem-solving will matter. You will have the autonomy to go beyond fixing individual issues, identify what could work better, and help build a support function that grows stronger as the business evolves.

A role that grows with you. You will be trusted to own challenges from investigation through resolution, with the opportunity to take on more complex technical work gradually. From environment management to deployments and system enhancements, you will expand your expertise beyond day-to-day functional support. You will have room to stretch your skills, build confidence, and become an increasingly valuable resource across the organization.

Meaningful impact, every day. Your work will directly influence how effectively people across WELL use the systems they depend on. Whether you are resolving a recurring issue, improving a financial workflow, or helping prepare for new D365 capabilities, you will see the difference your work makes. As WELL continues to grow, you will help build the ERP foundation that supports that growth.

As our new D365 Support Analyst, you will

  • Own the solution. You will investigate and resolve D365 Finance & Operations support requests, taking issues from initial diagnosis through resolution. You will identify root causes, explore practical solutions, and coordinate escalations as needed, keeping users informed throughout.
  • Keep critical processes moving. You will support financial and operational workflows across multiple business entities, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, fixed assets, expenses, procurement, and intercompany transactions. You will troubleshoot approvals, batch jobs, data imports, and month-end issues to help teams work without unnecessary disruption.
  • Strengthen the platform. You will support user access, security roles, application configurations, integrations, and routine system administration. Working with the ERP team, you will build your knowledge of environment management, releases, and deployments while helping test changes and ensure new functionality works as intended.
  • Connect people and solutions. You will collaborate with Finance, Operations, IT, and external technology partners, to resolve complex issues and coordinate technical support. You will translate business challenges into clear requirements, support user acceptance testing, and help teams use D365 effectively.
  • Optimize support. You will document solutions, identify recurring issues, and recommend improvements that reduce user friction. As WELL introduces new modules, enhancements, and business integrations, you will contribute to a more consistent, scalable approach to ERP support.

Here’s what you bring

  • The D365 experience. You have hands-on experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations in a live business environment. You understand how the platform works, can investigate functional issues independently, and know when to involve technical specialists or external partners.
  • The financial understanding. You are familiar with core finance processes such as general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end close. You can connect a system issue to its impact on a business process and work with users to find a practical resolution. Experience with procurement, inventory, or multi-entity environments is an asset.
  • The technical curiosity. You are comfortable working with workflows, configurations, user permissions, integrations, and testing. Exposure to tools such as Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Platform Admin Center, Lifecycle Services, Azure DevOps, or Power BI is valuable, but you do not need to know them all. You are motivated to expand your technical skills and take on new responsibilities.
  • The problem-solving mindset. You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and follow issues through to completion. You can balance competing requests, investigate unfamiliar challenges, and find solutions without needing step-by-step direction.
  • The collaborative approach. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues, build productive relationships, and work effectively with external vendors. You are responsive, open to feedback, and committed to helping others succeed.

Why join us?

Healthcare is our sector, and we know that for WELL to be a winning team, we must provide an open environment to prioritize health and wellbeing and multiple resources to discuss mental, physical, and psychological needs openly. From the CEO to the newest hire, everyone comes together as part of our culture of respect, openness, support, and communication. We unite to empower each other to be the best we can be.

Apply now

We recognize that the best way to serve our diverse patient communities is by reflecting that diversity. With almost 65% of our team members identifying as female and 70% of our leadership identifying as a visible minority, we are proud of our diverse, equitable and inclusive organization.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the System Lead to discuss your D365 Finance & Operations experience, technical troubleshooting approach, and ability to take ownership of support challenges.
  • A final interview with the VP, Business Transformation to explore how you collaborate, approach problem-solving, and contribute to a developing ERP function.

Compensation

The anticipated annualized salary range for this full-time, permanent position is $85,000–$100,000 CAD. The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At WELL, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

WELL is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome and celebrate the diversity of applicants and team members across ability, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, and lived experience. We strive to create an environment where differences are valued and contribute to our collective success – this is the WELL Way.

WELL has been independently certified as a Great Place to Work® by the Great Place to Work Institute® Canada. This recognition reflects our commitment to building a workplace culture rooted in trust, inclusivity, and employee well-being. It also aligns with our Healthy Place to Work pillar and the priorities outlined in our annual Sustainability Impact Report.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to own two core projects: consolidating our overlapping training materials into one streamlined library, and reviewing our Human Resources SOP manual so it is clear, complete, and aligned with state-by-state requirements.

The ideal candidate is a strong writer and editor who can take dense, repetitive, or legal-heavy content and turn it into simple, step-by-step processes anyone can follow. They are curious, persistent, and comfortable tracking down missing information from managers, department leads, and reliable public sources until every SOP is finished.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

Training Material Consolidation

  • Inventory all existing training materials (documents, slide decks, videos,
  • checklists, handbooks, and LMS content) across departments and locations.
  • Build and maintain a master training tracker in Excel or Google Sheets listing each item's topic, owner, audience, format, location, and last-updated date.
  • Identify overlapping, duplicate, outdated, and conflicting content, and flag it for review.
  • Merge duplicate materials into a single approved version for each topic, preserving the best and most current information.
  • Rewrite and reformat content so it is concise, consistent, and easy to follow, using plain language, clear headings, numbered steps, and checklists.
  • Organize materials into a logical structure by role, department, and onboarding stage so employees can quickly find what they need.
  • Create consistent templates and formatting standards for all future training materials.
  • Develop quick-reference guides, job aids, and one-page summaries for frequently used processes.
  • Set up a clear file-naming convention, folder structure, and version control system for the training library.
  • Route revised materials to subject-matter experts and managers for review and approval, and track sign-offs.
  • Archive retired materials so outdated versions are no longer in circulation.

HR SOP Manual Review & Completion

  • Review the full Human Resources SOP manual section by section, covering areas such as hiring, onboarding, payroll, timekeeping, leave, benefits, performance, discipline, and offboarding.
  • Identify state-specific requirements and terminology that differ by location (for example, paid sick leave, final paycheck timing, meal and rest breaks, overtime rules, required notices, and record retention).
  • Build a state-by-state reference matrix showing which policies vary by state and where each variation appears in the manual.
  • Flag legal language, outdated references, and possible compliance gaps for review by HR leadership and legal counsel.
  • Rewrite each process in plain, easy-to-understand language, removing jargon while keeping the meaning accurate.
  • Break each procedure into clear, numbered steps with defined owners, timelines, required forms, and approval points.
  • Add simple flowcharts, checklists, and examples where they make a process easier to follow.
  • Identify missing procedures, incomplete steps, missing forms, and unanswered questions throughout the manual.
  • Gather missing information by interviewing HR staff, managers, and department leads, and by researching official state labor department and government sources.
  • Maintain a gap log tracking every open item, who it was sent to, follow-up dates, and resolution.
  • Assemble the completed SOP booklet with a consistent format, table of contents, glossary of terms, and revision history.
  • Set up a process for keeping the manual current as laws and internal policies change.

Note: This role organizes, simplifies, and flags compliance questions. It does not provide legal advice; final legal review and approval remain with HR leadership and legal counsel.

Coordination & Project Support

  • Create and manage a project plan with milestones and deadlines for both the training consolidation and the SOP review.
  • Schedule review meetings with managers, subject-matter experts, and HR leadership, and track action items to completion.
  • Follow up consistently on outstanding information, approvals, and feedback.
  • Provide weekly progress updates summarizing completed work, open gaps, and decisions needed.
  • Maintain organized, secure digital files for all drafts, approved versions, and source materials.
  • Handle confidential HR and employee information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Recommend improvements to how training and SOPs are created, reviewed, and maintained going forward.
  • Assist with related administrative and special projects as needed.

Qualifications & Skills

Required & Preferred

  • 2–3 years of experience as a Virtual Assistant, HR Assistant, HR Coordinator,
  • Training Coordinator, Technical Writer, or similar role.
  • Excellent written English, with a proven ability to simplify complex or technical content into clear, plain language.
  • Strong editing and proofreading skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience creating or updating SOPs, process documentation, training manuals, or employee handbooks.
  • Working knowledge of common HR processes (onboarding, leave, payroll, performance, offboarding).
  • Strong research skills and comfort using official government and state labor department sources.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office, especially Word and Excel.
  • Ability to manage a large, multi-part project independently and follow through without constant supervision.
  • Strong follow-up skills and comfort reaching out to managers and stakeholders for missing information.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Familiarity with US employment law differences across states.
  • Instructional design or curriculum development experience.
  • Experience with an LMS or knowledge base tool (e.g., Trainual, Notion, Confluence, SharePoint, TalentLMS).
  • Experience with project management tools such as Asana, ClickUp, Trello, or Monday.com.
  • Ability to create simple flowcharts and visual job aids (e.g., Canva, Lucidchart, Visio).
  • Familiarity with AI and productivity tools to speed up drafting and organizing content.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

  • work-from-home opportunity.
  • A chance to make a lasting impact by building the training and HR resources the whole company relies on.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment.

Job Details

Location: CA, US. Remote in CA, with regular travel (including international) to meet funders

Basis: Permanent. Full-time, part time or flexible
Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in the USA

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Development Manager to grow our income from, private foundations, family foundations, family offices and philanthropic institutional funders. This is primarily a new-business role, focused on securing six- and seven-figure gifts that help us reach more young people. You will also steward a small number of existing relationships, which may include some corporate partners.

Reporting to the VP of Global Development, you will lead a small team and work closely with our global development team, program teams, and senior leadership. This is an opportunity to shape how we engage philanthropic funders and to build a high-performing team in the US.

  • Alongside the VP of Global Development and UK based Senior Manager, line manage and develop the fundraising team

  • Coordinate prospect assignments with the global development team, including the UK-based Senior Development Manager
  • Ensure fundraising follows our values and policies, including due diligence on funders and sources of wealth
  • Keep accurate records in Salesforce

Experience and personal attributes

We recognise that everyone has the potential for growth. We welcome applications from candidates who can demonstrate that they have some, but not necessarily all, of the experience and personal attributes listed here.

  • Commitment to the mission and values of the Raspberry Pi Foundation
  • Significant experience (typically five or more years) in foundation fundraising
  • Strong understanding of how private foundations and family offices make funding decisions
  • Experience managing people, ideally including remote team members
  • Excellent proposal writing and pitching skills, including building project budgets
  • A confident relationship-builder and natural collaborator, comfortable with senior stakeholders, high-net-worth individuals, and their advisors
  • Highly organized, with experience managing a complex pipeline against income targets
  • Willingness to travel regularly, including internationally
  • A track record of seven-figure gifts (desirable)
  • Experience in education, youth, or technology causes, and an interest in computing or AI education (desirable)
  • An existing network among foundations, family offices, or philanthropic advisors (desirable)
  • Experience with corporate partnerships, fundraising across more than one country, or Salesforce (desirable)

About us

The Raspberry Pi Foundation is an independent, global charity with the mission to enable all young people to realise their full potential through the power of computing and AI.

We enable schools to teach computing and AI through high-quality classroom resources, purpose-built software, and teacher professional development. We inspire millions of young people to become tech creators through a global network of coding clubs, project-based instructional materials, and engaging challenges. We undertake original research to deepen our understanding of the teaching and learning of computing and AI, and use that knowledge to advance the field.

All of our resources and learning experiences are available for anyone to use at no cost. We are particularly focused on creating opportunities for young people who experience educational disadvantage and those who come from backgrounds traditionally underrepresented in technology industries.

Over the past decade, we have supported hundreds of thousands of educators and tens of millions of students. We have teams in India, Ireland, Kenya, South Africa, the UK, and the USA, and partnerships with mission-aligned non-profit organisations in over 60 countries.

We are at the forefront of the global movement to expand access to computing and AI education. You can learn more about our work in our latest Annual Review.

Benefits

  • Paid time off. In addition to public holidays, full-time employees in the US receive 15 days of paid time off, plus 3 additional days of paid time off for the company-wide closure at the end of each year.
  • Retirement Savings Plan (401)(k). We match 100% of employee contributions up to the first 5%.
  • Private Healthcare. We provide private healthcare (including dental and vision) for you and for your dependents through United Healthcare and Guardian.
  • Flexible working. We have clear policies to provide flexibility over when and where you work, helping you balance work responsibilities with the rest of your life.
  • Support for parents and carers. We provide generous family leave and flexibility for parents and carers.
  • Group term life insurance & disability insurance. We provide insurance and income protection schemes to provide peace of mind for you and your family.
  • Investing in learning and development. We invest in your growth and development, including through access to learning resources and training, with dedicated time for all employees.

Timetable for applications

Phone screen: Week commencing 30 November 2026

Our recruitment process

All of our workplaces are inclusive spaces where we want people to feel respected, valued, and able to do their best work. We are committed to building teams that bring together people with a broad range of backgrounds, skills, and perspectives. That starts with our recruitment process.

  • Eligible applications will be reviewed by our recruitment team and the hiring manager. We review all applications for authenticity. While we embrace the use of AI tools to assist you, all content must genuinely represent your own work, and have been reviewed and personalised by you.

jobs.description:
Overview

About Cherre, a RealPage Company

Real assets software has served consumers across two completed eras. Era One built systems of record to capture transactions. Era Two built data warehouses and dashboards to inform analysts. Era Three is now open, and its primary consumer is the AI agent.

Cherre, now part of RealPage, is building the ultimate trust layer for real assets: a resolved, governed, semantic infrastructure that AI agents can reason against, decide from, and act through. The world's largest institutional CRE investors and operators, collectively holding more than $5T in AUM, run on Cherre today. Combined with RealPage's operating data footprint and scale, we hold the foundational institutional truth that next-generation real asset intelligence runs on.

The Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Senior Product Manager with elite, deep-domain Commercial Real Estate product expertise to play a core role in our semantic, graph modeling, and platform activation layers. You will own day-to-day product execution across the Semantic Layer (Luna, Meridian), Graph Modeling (Meridian), Reasoning Agents (Atlas), and platform workstreams, partnering with product leadership to turn complex, highly disparate real estate data into reliable, agent-ready data systems.

You will step completely away from traditional "product management theater." There are no 30-page PRDs, rigid screen-by-screen wireframing dependencies, or slow-moving human-overhead sprints here. Instead, you will operate under an inverted "Build First, Evaluate Second" model, collaborating directly with highly autonomous engineers using agentic development environments (ADEs) to evaluate functional prototypes in real time.

Responsibilities

Core Workstream Responsibilities

1. Semantic Layer (Luna, Meridian) & CRE Knowledge Graph

  • Drive the product lifecycle for our entity resolution engine (Luna) and graph-based knowledge mapping system (Meridian), hardening them to enterprise production standards for the world's largest institutional CRE data portfolios.
  • Map complex, multi-tiered CRE ontology structures directly into our graph database, ensuring that property, portfolio, loan, lease, and market performance variables seamlessly resolve across varying schemas.
  • Lead the development of graph and resolution systems that serve external agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling seamless global ontology harmonization and multi-org comparison capabilities tailored to institutional CRE standards.

2. Bedrock Infrastructure & Agentic Activation

  • Oversee the migration and production hardening of our platform infrastructure onto our next-generation stack.
  • Scale the Bedrock platform MVP to unify onboarding, data quality, enterprise governance, and global administration into a consolidated, intuitive command UI.
  • Architect the foundational agentic layer: empowering clients to build custom agents on top of our governed semantic infrastructure, deploying the Janus hypothesis engine, and launching Agentic chat featuring advanced plan modes and programmatic source citations.

Qualifications

Deep CRE Domain & Product Expertise Requirements

This is not a generalist SaaS PM role. To teach AI how to reason about commercial real estate, you must understand the domain at an atomic level. You should be strong in most of the following. No one is expected to be expert in all of them.

  • Semantic & Graph Modeling Fluency: Working command of Semantic Data Modeling (SDM: defining business meaning, metrics, and relationships as a governed layer over raw data), Universal Data Modeling (UDM: standardized, source-agnostic entity models that many systems map into), and graph modeling (representing entities and their relationships as nodes and edges for resolution and reasoning). These are the foundation of everything we build. Strength here counts more than any other qualification on this page.
  • Advanced CRE Structural Domain Expertise: Deep, practical knowledge of commercial real estate data structures, lifecycle stages (acquisition, asset management, disposition), investment mechanisms, and joint-venture operating structures.
  • Ontology & Mapping Mastery: A profound understanding of how diverse datasets interlock, including property management systems (RealPage, Yardi, MRI), debt platforms, valuations, and market data. You must know how to map unstructured and semi-structured property records into a unified "Golden Source" entity hierarchy.
  • Institutional Financial Literacy: Solid understanding of institutional financial reporting standards, fund administration gates, and real estate performance metrics (e.g., NOI, IRR, cap rates, debt yield) across global asset classes. Experience mapping to global performance standards (like INREV and ANREV) is highly preferred.
  • Lineage & Audit Acumen: The ability to trace data mutations through bronze, silver, and gold transformation layers. You understand how investment committees make data-driven calculations and what a regulator or auditor looks for when verifying the lineage of a billion-dollar transaction decision.

Experience

  • 6+ years of product management experience delivering enterprise software, including 3+ years on data platforms, CRE technology, or institutional fintech.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the end-to-end product lifecycle for enterprise offerings.

Key AI-Native Competencies We're Tracking

  • Probabilistic System Design & Model Behavior: You understand that AI products are non-deterministic. You excel at shifting logic from rigid deterministic acceptance criteria to shaping adaptive system behavior, defining clear system instructions, and optimizing RAG architectures over CRE data.
  • Failure Mode Thinking: You actively anticipate what can go wrong in intelligent real estate systems, such as context drift, hallucinations in lease abstraction, or confidence-biased incorrect calculation actions, and you design the system architecture to handle failures gracefully.
  • Strategic Risk & Governance Ownership: You will define and configure continuous evaluation frameworks (Evals-as-a-North-Star) to verify data quality and precision. You'll champion an immutable unified audit trail where both human and AI actions record into the same lineage so that every investment decision is perfectly reproducible.

What We Are Looking For (Hiring Signals)

  • True Builder Mentality: You don't manage work from a distance. You feel productive discomfort when doing things manually that an agent could automate. You are comfortable using LLM frameworks, prompting tools, and basic scripting to rapidly materialize your own functional software prototypes.
  • Deep Technical Intuition: While you don't need a PhD in machine learning, you possess the structural intuition to reason clearly about graph databases, vector search, model thresholds, API constraints, and data orchestration tools.

Why Join Us?

Over $5 trillion in real estate asset value runs safely in production on Cherre systems today, now backed by RealPage's scale and resources. We offer a workplace culture engineered specifically around maximizing human leverage rather than tracking human headcount.

SALARY AND BENEFITS RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:• Health, dental, and vision insurance.• Retirement savings plan with company match.• Paid time off and holidays.• Professional development opportunities.• Performance-based bonus based on position. Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Pay Range

USD $94,700.00 - USD $161,300.00 /Yr.

This is a remote position.

Meta Description:Join Rutherford’s Talent Clearinghouse as an executive mentor, coach or specialist consultant supporting employee development through the Talent Accelerator.

Executive Mentors, Coaches & Specialist Consultants
Evergreen Expression of Interest — Rutherford Talent Clearinghouse™
Executive Talent Accelerator Programme
Canada · United States · United Kingdom

Put your experience to work developing others

Rutherford International welcomes expressions of interest from experienced executives, professional coaches and subject-matter specialists who can help professionals strengthen their performance, develop their judgement and prepare for greater responsibility.

Through the Executive Talent Accelerator, Rutherford matches assessed employees of enterprise clients with development expertise suited to their objectives, behavioural profiles and organisational circumstances.

This posting recruits independent providers of mentoring, coaching and specialist consulting services. It is an Evergreen Expression of Interest, not a current vacancy or a guaranteed assignment.

Augmenting internal career development

The Executive Talent Accelerator augments employers’ internal career and leadership development programmes with dedicated mentoring capacity, structured coaching and targeted specialist expertise.

Annual reviews can establish clear development priorities, but managers’ operational responsibilities may leave limited time for consistent guidance, practice and follow-up. Effective mentoring and coaching also require capabilities and interpersonal qualities that differ from those needed to manage performance.

Rutherford provides additional support to help employees act on agreed development objectives, working alongside their employer’s internal programme.

Three distinct ways to contribute

Executive Mentors

Provide longer-term, holistic guidance grounded in personal experience, career wisdom and relevant leadership responsibilities. Mentors help participants examine career direction, navigate organisational challenges, strengthen judgement and prepare for broader responsibilities.

Effective mentors explain their reasoning, share relevant experience and help participants develop their own judgement.

Executive Coaches

Provide structured, focused support for short-term skill development and performance improvement. Coaches help participants establish specific objectives, practise new approaches and review progress against agreed outcomes.

Assignments may address communication, delegation, stakeholder relationships, leadership behaviours or readiness for a defined responsibility.

Subject-Matter Specialist Consultants

Provide focused expertise addressing a particular functional, technical or business need. Specialists may explain a method, examine a decision, review work or help participants apply unfamiliar knowledge.

The scope, intended contribution and limits of the advice are established for each assignment. Implementation work is agreed separately.

Professionals may offer more than one service. Suitability and engagement scope are considered separately for each role.

Who should register

We welcome:

  • Current and former executives with relevant leadership experience and a demonstrated ability to develop others.
  • Professional coaches who can explain their methods, qualifications and evidence of contribution.
  • Senior functional and technical specialists who can translate expertise into practical learning.
  • Experienced consultants interested in supporting enterprise-sponsored development.

A distinguished career or senior title alone does not establish mentoring or coaching capability. We look for evidence that you can listen, explain, challenge appropriately and adapt your approach to another person’s needs.

Assessment and matching

Rutherford evaluates providers across three complementary areas:

  • Functional expertise:demonstrated knowledge, judgement and relevant experience.
  • Development capability:the ability to mentor, coach or teach effectively within the service offered.
  • Service orientation and relationship fit:the motivation and interpersonal capacity to support another person’s progress.

The RutherfordINTEL Assessment informs curator review alongside professional history, qualifications, references and examples of developmental work.

Matching considers the employee’s objectives, behavioural profile, enterprise context and practical needs, together with the provider’s expertise, approach and availability.

Working with Rutherford and enterprise clients

Rutherford International markets the Executive Talent Accelerator, holds and manages the enterprise client relationship, coordinates development mandates and matches providers to participating employees.

Providers deliver agreed services as independent contractors to Rutherford International. Each assignment establishes the scope, objectives, professional fees, time commitment, reporting requirements and engagement terms.

Providers are expected to:

  • Prepare thoroughly and deliver relevant, actionable guidance.
  • Maintain accurate timesheets and submit them through the agreed process.
  • Support development objectives aligned with the client’s internal programme.
  • Respect confidentiality and agreed information-sharing boundaries.
  • Disclose conflicts and work within their professional competence.
  • Distinguish developmental support from management authority or separately commissioned implementation work.
  • Review progress and raise concerns when the match or scope needs to change.

Employer sponsorship does not automatically provide access to private assessment results or confidential development discussions.

Assessment, membership and assignment fees

Initial expression of interest — Free

Registering creates no payment obligation.

Assessment and feedback — USD $250

If invited to proceed, this stage includes behavioural and leadership profiling, relevant benchmark interpretation and professional feedback.

Clearinghouse directory membership — USD $125 per month, with a 12-month term

For accepted members, membership includes assistance with the Rutherford Consultant Thesis™, business-development profiling, talent promotion, lead generation, sector research community access and career or project-success advisory support.

Rutherford-managed Accelerator assignments

Rutherford invoices the enterprise client for agreed services delivered by the provider.

Rutherford retains20% of professional billings, excluding applicable taxes. The provider receives the remaining80% of professional billings, subject to the agreed engagement terms.

This service fee isadditional to the monthly directory membership feeand reflects Rutherford’s client acquisition, matching, programme coordination, client relationship management and billing responsibilities.

Membership does not guarantee assignments or income.

Conversion to employment

If a consulting assignment converts to employment with the contracting client, the client pays a conversion fee of25% of annual salary and bonus income before six months from the assignment’s start, or20% from six months to one year.

Rutherford International retains agency rights for12 months after the consulting assignment ends.

Register your interest

Select“I’m interested”to complete Rutherford International’s Talent Registration form.

Indicate whether you wish to be considered as an executive mentor, executive coach, subject-matter specialist consultant or a combination of these roles.

Following initial review, a curator may invite you to provide further information and proceed to assessment and membership consideration.

Registration does not guarantee acceptance, representation, a client introduction or an assignment.

About the Role

Mission statement

Keep our clients’ Amazon accounts running accurately and grow their businesses through sound operations, effective advertising, data-driven decisions, and proactive communication.

Operations

Clients and analysis

  • Analyze performance across products, variations and categories to find trends and opportunities

  • Balance client requests with operational needs and team capacity

Improvement

Requirements

You have hands-on experience with Seller Central or Vendor Central, Amazon PPC, and direct client communication. You understand what drives a brand’s sales on Amazon and can manage several accounts while balancing operations, advertising, and client needs.

You are comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can evaluate performance, calculate inventory needs, spot stock risks, and understand how metrics like ACoS, TACoS, and ROAS connect to the client’s overall business.

AlphaGov delivers public-sector consulting for cities, counties, school systems, special districts, utilities, and related agencies. AlphaGov is hiring a Compensation Analyst to evaluate compensation for represented employee groups in public utilities. You will turn job and market data into clear, defensible pay recommendations that support competitive compensation and sound workforce decisions.

  • Review represented job classifications, existing pay schedules and relevant labor agreements to define a consistent comparison framework.

Required

  • Experience conducting compensation surveys or pay studies for public-sector employers or utilities.
  • Experience evaluating represented employee classifications and interpreting labor-agreement pay provisions.
  • Ability to match jobs by substantive duties and responsibilities rather than title alone.
  • Ability to analyze compensation data and explain assumptions, limitations and recommended adjustments.

Nice to have

  • Public utility or other operational-workforce compensation study experience.
  • Experience presenting compensation findings to HR leaders, management and employee representatives.

jobs.description:
The Amazon Account Manager runs day-to-day operations of Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts for Hustler Marketing's clients, manages Amazon PPC advertising, and owns the client relationship. The goal is simple: help each client sell more, profitably, on Amazon.

You will work across multiple brands and marketplaces, mainly the UK, EU, and US, as well as Canada, Mexico, Australia, and Japan. You will analyze sales, inventory, and advertising data, find what is limiting growth, recommend what to do, and make it happen. You will also be the client’s main point of contact.

Amazon changes constantly, so much of this role is solving problems no one has written instructions for. You will have the support of the wider team, training on our processes, and regular feedback to help you grow.

About the Role

Mission statement

Keep our clients’ Amazon accounts running accurately and grow their businesses through sound operations, effective advertising, data-driven decisions, and proactive communication.

Sales on Amazon come from a few fundamentals: stock availability, listing quality, advertising, pricing, and promotions. You will own these for the accounts you handle, understand each client’s objectives, recommend priorities, and make sure agreed actions are delivered.

General Responsibilities

Operations

  • Manage day-to-day Seller Central and Vendor Central operations across marketplaces
  • Forecast demand from sales history, calculate replenishment quantities, and prevent stockouts
  • Identify excess inventory and recommend actions
  • Create and coordinate shipments to Amazon warehouses
  • Support product launches and set up promotions
  • Upload and optimize product content to improve listing quality
  • Monitor listings, investigate issues and resolve them with Amazon Support

Advertising

  • Set up, manage and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns
  • Conduct keyword research and search term analysis to find relevant targeting opportunities
  • Manage campaign structure, targeting, bids, budgets, placements and negative keywords
  • Track ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC and conversion rates, and judge them by their effect on overall profitability
  • Test new approaches, fix underperforming campaigns and reallocate budget to what works
  • Align advertising with inventory, pricing, promotions and launches

Clients and analysis

  • Act as the primary point of contact and build strong client relationships
  • Lead regular meetings on performance, challenges, opportunities and priorities
  • Develop account strategies based on each client’s goals and resources
  • Analyze performance across products, variations and categories to find trends and opportunities
  • Build clear reports and turn complex data into actionable recommendations
  • Set realistic timelines, give regular updates and follow through on commitments
  • Balance client requests with operational needs and team capacity

Improvement

  • Investigate unfamiliar problems to their root cause and find practical solutions
  • Improve account management processes for efficiency and accuracy
  • Collaborate with the team to align priorities and deliver strategies
  • Take part in regular training and feedback sessions

Position Specs

  • Fully remote position
  • Ready to start as soon as possible
  • Start on a probationary period at an hourly rate.
  • Opportunity to transition into a full-time position within the Amazon Operations team with a fixed-rate monthly salary following a successful probation period
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the probationary period
  • Vacation days based on your country of residence, plus national holidays
  • Regular training, feedback sessions, and professional development opportunities

Requirements

About You

Profile

You have hands-on experience with Seller Central or Vendor Central, Amazon PPC, and direct client communication. You understand what drives a brand’s sales on Amazon and can manage several accounts while balancing operations, advertising, and client needs.

You are comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can evaluate performance, calculate inventory needs, spot stock risks, and understand how metrics like ACoS, TACoS, and ROAS connect to the client’s overall business.

You are a resourceful problem-solver. When something unfamiliar comes up, you investigate, test possible solutions, and act. When things go wrong, you explain your reasoning to clients clearly and keep their confidence.

You are detail-oriented, organized, and accountable, and you can turn client objectives into clear plans. You are humble, open to feedback, comfortable working remotely, and motivated to grow your Amazon expertise.

Key Traits for This Position

  • Analytical: You reason from data, spot patterns, and back every recommendation with clear logic.
  • Commercially aware: You understand how operational and advertising decisions affect sales and profit, and you prioritize what matters most.
  • Client-focused: You lead conversations confidently, ask good questions, handle difficult discussions, and keep trust through transparency.
  • Curious and adaptable: You learn new processes quickly and work toward solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Ownership-driven: You are organized and accurate, follow through, and turn recommendations into measurable results.

Key Requirements

  • Practical experience with Seller Central or Vendor Central
  • Hands-on experience with Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display
  • Strong understanding of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, and conversion rates
  • Experience with keyword research, search term analysis, bids, budgets, and campaign structure
  • Understanding of inventory, shipments, promotions, product setup, and content
  • Experience handling operational issues and working with Amazon Support
  • Experience with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Amazon Ads Campaign Manager, or similar tools
  • Ability to work across multiple marketplaces and client brands
  • Strong spreadsheet skills
  • Ability to analyze sales and inventory data, calculate replenishment needs, and spot stockout or overstock risks
  • Understanding of how inventory, pricing, promotions, content, and advertising together drive sales
  • Ability to recognize missing information and identify the data needed to decide with confidence
  • Direct client experience, including leading meetings and presenting reports
  • Ability to explain recommendations clearly, manage expectations and set realistic timelines
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities and deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail, ownership and follow-through
  • Independent problem-solving with the judgement to ask for help when needed
  • Genuine interest in Amazon, e-commerce and digital marketing
  • Positive, humble, and collaborative, and open to feedback
  • Comfortable working remotely in a distributed team
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Fluency in additional European languages is a plus
  • Available to start as soon as possible
  • Long-term mindset and motivation to grow within the Amazon team

Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

We are seeking a SCADA Engineer to support the design, configuration, programming, integration, and commissioning of SCADA systems across substation, DER, BESS, solar, wind, and microgrid projects. This role partners closely with protection and control engineers to deliver reliable automation and communications solutions across the full project lifecycle, from design through field implementation.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Design, configure, and program SCADA systems for utility and renewable energy projects, including RTUs, PLCs, controllers, HMIs, historians, and Windows Server-based systems
  • Program and configure SEL-RTAC platforms for substation RTU, EMS, microgrid, and related automation applications
  • Develop and configure HMI and interface solutions using platforms such as Ignition, GE, and Schneider Electric
  • Design and implement substation communications architectures and protocols, including IP-based networks and DNP3 communications
  • Prepare SCADA I/O point lists, network architecture documentation, and related technical deliverables
  • Review manufacturer drawings and develop or support AC/DC schematics, EWDs, and CWDs
  • Create test plans, test procedures, and commissioning documentation for SCADA and automation systems
  • Perform remote and onsite testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and checkout of SCADA, network, and automation equipment across project sites in the United States
  • Conduct site visits to collect field data and assess existing SCADA, automation, and communications infrastructure
  • Collaborate with protection and control engineers, project managers, and field teams to deliver integrated project solutions

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, controls engineering, or a related field; equivalent technical experience may be considered
  • 7+ years of experience in SCADA, automation, or substation controls engineering
  • Hands-on experience with RTUs, PLCs, HMIs, historians, and industrial communications systems
  • Experience programming and configuring SEL-RTAC systems
  • Experience with SCADA testing, commissioning, and field troubleshooting
  • Ability to read and interpret protection and control drawings, including single-line diagrams, three-line diagrams, DC schematics, panel drawings, wiring diagrams, and bills of materials
  • Experience developing test plans and test procedures
  • Ability to travel to project sites as needed

Lead the Change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. What C&F will bring to you

  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off

Product Designer, LHH CTM

We are looking for a curious, customer-obsessed Product Designer to help shape and validate innovative products, services, and experiences for students, graduates, and early-career professionals. This is not a traditional design role. We are seeking someone who thrives in ambiguity, uncovers unmet customer needs, and transforms insights into compelling product opportunities that create meaningful value for both customers and the business.
This role is part of LHH's central Product Design team. The initial focus is on innovation projects for students, graduates and early-career professionals, with work across our design system, research and other product initiatives over time.
As a Product Designer, you will take new product concepts from discovery through prototype, pilot and validation, working closely with the product lead and with engineering, marketing and business stakeholders to bring ideas to life. You will combine strong design craft with an experimental mindset, using research, prototyping and data to test assumptions and show what works, what doesn't, and why. Comfortable synthesizing complex inputs into practical design solutions, you will keep the design work connected across workstreams so concepts move smoothly from idea to execution.
The ideal candidate is a creative problem solver, skilled in user research, journey mapping, prototyping, and experience design, with a passion for testing assumptions and learning quickly. You leverage AI and emerging technologies to accelerate research, concept development, and experimentation, and you are energized by the opportunity to create innovative solutions that help the next generation navigate their education, career, and professional growth journeys.

Reporting Relationships:

  • Reports directly to the Global UX Design Lead, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Global Head of Innovation Lab.

Direct Reports:

Location:

Travel:
