In this role you can expect to:

Key Accountabilities

  • Lead the design of new product concepts from discovery through to prototype, pilot and validation.
  • Own the end-to-end user experience across products, services and customer journeys within innovation initiatives.
  • Conduct user and market research to uncover unmet needs and translate insights into product opportunities.
  • Synthesize messy inputs - research, pilot data, user feedback, market signals - into a clear point of view on what's driving value and a concrete recommendation on what to do next.
  • Create prototypes and run experiments to test assumptions, validate concepts and accelerate learning.
  • Partner with product, engineering and business stakeholders to develop solutions that are desirable, viable and feasible.
  • Connect the moving parts across research, design, marketing, engineering and program delivery - holding the threads together day to day so nothing falls through the cracks as a concept moves from pilot to build.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to measure success, inform decisions and guide iteration.
  • Initially focus on shaping and testing new propositions for students, graduates and early-career professionals.

How you work:

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and turning uncertainty into clear next steps.
  • Naturally curious, with a passion for learning, experimenting, and challenging conventional thinking.
  • Evidence-driven, balancing intuition with research, testing, and measurable outcomes.
  • Highly collaborative and skilled at influencing and partnering with cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing for B2C audiences, particularly students, graduates, or early-career professionals
  • Strong understanding of Gen Z behaviors, motivations, and digital expectations
  • Experience working in startup, scale-up, or innovation-led teams
  • Passion for emerging technologies, AI-driven experiences, and rapid experimentation

All About You

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto layout, variables/tokens, and interactive prototyping. Experience contributing to and evolving scalable design systems.
  • Strong experience designing user flows, information architecture, and end-to-end customer journeys, with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions and trade-offs.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI-powered design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, v0, Lovable, Claude, Cursor) to rapidly bring concepts to life and validate ideas with users.
  • Practical user research expertise, including planning and conducting usability testing, user interviews, and leveraging analytics, experimentation, and A/B testing insights to drive product decisions.
  • Proven ability to partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers, providing clear developer handoffs and supporting designs through implementation.
  • Solid understanding of accessibility best practices and WCAG guidelines, with a commitment to creating inclusive user experiences.
  • Experience designing AI-enabled product experiences, such as conversational interfaces, recommendation engines, copilots, or other intelligent and assistive workflows.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing shipped products, validated prototypes, or measurable business and and user outcomes, with clear evidence of problem-solving and design impact.

What we offer

  • We prioritize learning to stay agile in an increasingly competitive business environment.

jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Building the AI Infrastructure for Construction

  • Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.

  • Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.

  • The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.

  • PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.

  • We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.

  • This is one of those rare moments where product decisions directly influence how the physical world gets built.

Location

  • Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (Monday, Wednesday and Friday in-office). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

Role Overview

  • We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Head of Product Operations to build and lead PermitFlow’s Product Operations function.

  • In this role, you will define how our Product organization plans, operates, launches, and measures its work. You will evolve our Product Operations capabilities from a small team into a well-staffed, strategic organization that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and the founding team to help the company execute more effectively.

  • You’ll be responsible for hiring and developing a team of Product Operations Managers, defining the company’s Product operating system and quality standards, and building the systems and processes that enable great product execution at scale.

  • This is a player-coach leadership role that requires exceptional operational judgment, strong product instincts, and the ability to operate both strategically and hands-on in a fast-paced startup environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and lead PermitFlow’s Product Operations organization, evolving it into a strategic partner embedded across the business.

  • Hire and develop a team of Product Operations Managers to support stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Customer Success, Operations, and more.

  • Define PermitFlow’s Product operating system, including planning processes, PRD standards, launch processes, product metrics, customer feedback systems, and cross-functional collaboration models.

  • Do hands-on Product Operations work yourself, particularly on the systems and programs that set the quality bar for the rest of the team.

  • Own and evolve the systems that support Product planning, execution, launches, and measurement to ensure consistency, scalability, and clarity as the company grows.

  • Establish consistent quality standards and review processes across the Product organization, ensuring teams have clear goals, requirements, success metrics, and launch plans.

  • Partner closely with leadership to improve Product execution in ways that directly impact business metrics, including activation, retention, customer satisfaction, and product velocity.

  • Set the vision for how AI transforms the Product Operations function, driving adoption of AI tools and evolving workflows across the team.

What We’re Looking For

We’re open to calibrating the level of this role based on the candidate’s experience and scope of impact, from Manager through Head of Product Operations. We’re ultimately looking for the strongest product operations leader for the business, with title and scope matched to their track record and leadership experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or B2B SaaS product leadership. Experience supporting complex workflow products with data-heavy systems and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • 3+ years of experience leading and managing teams, ideally in a high-growth startup or technology company.

  • Proven experience building Product Operations teams and functions from early-stage to scale.

  • Exceptional operational judgment across planning, prioritization, product development, launches, measurement, and cross-functional execution. Systems thinking, not just strong project management.

  • Player-coach mentality with the ability to do hands-on Product Operations work while simultaneously building and scaling a team.

  • Active AI fluency, with AI tools integrated into your daily operating workflow. Strong opinions on how AI is changing the way Product Operations teams work and a track record of evolving your own process accordingly.

  • Strong experience standing up Product operating processes, including planning rituals, PRD quality standards, launch readiness, product reviews, customer feedback systems, and product metrics.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership and hold your own in strategic and technical conversations.

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

Closing

If you’re excited by the opportunity to build AI-powered products that simplify complex real-world workflows - and want to help define a category from the ground up - we’d love to talk.

Inside PermitFlow: The Team Transforming Construction Permitting

jobs.description:
Request for qualifications from independent bookkeeping practices.

About goCloudOffice®

goCloudOffice® is a modern, AI-driven IT consulting company. Founded in 2003 and based in Silicon Valley, we serve customers nationwide across the United States. Our customers are small businesses of 5 to 50 people, in industries that include biotechnology, law and professional services. They own their business applications, and we run their IT with senior engineering judgment and AI-augmented support that has been in daily production since summer 2024.

The engagement

Engagement: outsourced bookkeeping services for a California S-corporation (IT consulting; QuickBooks Online Advanced; QuickBooks Online Payroll) — monthly close and reconciliations, accounts-payable preparation, payroll-run review, year-end package for our CPA. Initial scope approximately 1–2 hours per week; providers propose a monthly fee and terms.

The S-corporation is goCloudOffice® itself. This engagement outsources goCloudOffice®'s bookkeeping function: the practice owns the monthly close, the reconciliations and accounts-payable preparation, and goCloudOffice®'s finance administrator is its internal approver and liaison. goCloudOffice®'s own AI bookkeeping tools prepare draft categorizations, reconciliation worksheets and reports for the practice to review.

This is a business-to-business engagement under a services agreement between goCloudOffice® and your practice, which invoices for the services it delivers.

Engagement contact: the CEO, who approves and releases all payments.

Scope of services

  • Monthly close and reconciliations. Close the books each month and reconcile every bank, credit-card and merchant (payment-processor) account, with a close package for the CEO.
  • Accounts receivable. Apply customer payments to invoices and review receivables aging.
  • Accounts-payable preparation. Enter and code bills with their source documents. Prepare vendor payments for the owner's approval and release. Route every new payee and every change to a payee's bank details to the owner for verification before use.
  • Payroll-run review. Review each scheduled payroll run for accuracy and report exceptions before it processes. Tie each run to the ledger afterwards, tie out the quarterly payroll returns, and verify that retirement-plan deferrals are remitted on time.
  • 1099 and sales-tax support. Collect Forms W-9 through the year, prepare Forms 1099-NEC and California DE 542 reports for the owner's review and filing, and reconcile the sales-tax accounts.
  • Year-end package for our CPA. Deliver the trial balance, general ledger, fixed-asset and loan schedules, the 1099 batch, the annual payroll reconciliation and the S-corporation officer-compensation and shareholder items. The CPA firm prepares and signs the tax returns.
  • Monthly billing reconciliation. Review the monthly reconciliation of managed-device counts against recurring invoices that goCloudOffice®'s AI tools prepare, and book the corrections goCloudOffice® approves.
  • QuickBooks Online Advanced hygiene. Keep the chart of accounts, classes and bank rules clean and consistent month to month.

Services must meet goCloudOffice®'s financial-control, security and confidentiality policies and the service levels in the services agreement.

The provider uses its own equipment and business identity; goCloudOffice® grants only the QuickBooks and view-only banking access the services require.

Your practice serves its other clients alongside this engagement.

What your practice brings (required qualifications)

1. An established bookkeeping practice serving small professional-services or IT firms, with references from current clients. Your practice:

  • operates and invoices under its own business name;
  • serves other current clients;
  • is listed publicly, for example in the QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor directory or on its own website;
  • holds the business license its location requires;
  • carries errors-and-omissions insurance of at least USD 250,000, third-party fidelity or crime coverage for client funds of at least USD 50,000, and network security and privacy liability coverage of at least USD 250,000 with breach-response cover; the services agreement sets the final limits.

Every business form is welcome, including a sole-proprietor ProAdvisor with an established practice.

2. QuickBooks Online Advanced proficiency: day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online, including bank feeds and rules, reconciliations, bills, classes, custom user roles, the audit log and month-end reports.

3. Typically five or more years of bookkeeping for small professional-services or IT firms.

4. Payroll-run review with an automated payroll (QuickBooks Online Payroll or comparable): reviewing each scheduled run for accuracy before it processes, reporting exceptions, and tying payroll to the ledger and the quarterly returns.

5. Accounts-payable preparation under owner approval: entering and coding bills, preparing vendor payments for the owner's approval and release, and routing every new payee and every bank-detail change to the owner for verification.

6. Year-end and CPA collaboration: tax-ready books, a year-end package a CPA can work from directly, and Forms 1099 prepared on time.

7. AI-assisted bookkeeping. Providers should demonstrate at least one year of AI-assisted bookkeeping in their practice (for example, AI-assisted categorization, reconciliation or reporting). We look for:

  • Tools:any mainstream assistant, such as Intuit Assist in QuickBooks, Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.
  • A clear method for checking AI output: tying every AI-proposed category or match back to the bank statement or source document, reviewing each AI-proposed entry before it posts, and keeping client financial data inside tools the client approves.

8. Clear written communication: concise month-end summaries, precise questions, and plain-language explanations a busy CEO can act on quickly.

9. Remote service from the United States: services performed from within the United States (our financial and payroll data are processed only in the United States).

Where a qualification names years, equivalent depth gained in fewer years counts; tell us how.

Also valuable (preferred qualifications)

  • A.Experience with S-corporations: officer payroll, shareholder distributions, and the year-end items an S-corporation return needs.
  • B.Exposure to NinjaOne, Stripe or subscription (SaaS) billing, including recurring invoices priced per device or per seat.
  • C.Experience designing QuickBooks Online Advanced custom user roles and approval workflows.
  • D.Experience working alongside AI-generated reconciliation or categorization drafts.
  • E.More than one qualified person in your practice who can perform the work, for coverage continuity.

About the Role

Mission statement

Keep our clients’ Amazon accounts running accurately and grow their businesses through sound operations, effective advertising, data-driven decisions, and proactive communication.

Sales on Amazon come from a few fundamentals: stock availability, listing quality, advertising, pricing, and promotions. You will own these for the accounts you handle, understand each client’s objectives, recommend priorities, and make sure agreed actions are delivered.

  • Manage day-to-day Seller Central and Vendor Central operations across marketplaces

You are comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can evaluate performance, calculate inventory needs, spot stock risks, and understand how metrics like ACoS, TACoS, and ROAS connect to the client’s overall business.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You Will Build

  • Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.

  • Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.

  • Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production.

  • Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.

  • Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale.


What We Look For

  • Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.

  • Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools.

  • Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack.

  • Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not.

  • Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time.

  • Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

  • Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

  • Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

  • People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

  • Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
The Amazon Account Manager runs day-to-day operations of Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts for Hustler Marketing's clients, manages Amazon PPC advertising, and owns the client relationship. The goal is simple: help each client sell more, profitably, on Amazon.

You will work across multiple brands and marketplaces, mainly the UK, EU, and US, as well as Canada, Mexico, Australia, and Japan. You will analyze sales, inventory, and advertising data, find what is limiting growth, recommend what to do, and make it happen. You will also be the client’s main point of contact.

Amazon changes constantly, so much of this role is solving problems no one has written instructions for. You will have the support of the wider team, training on our processes, and regular feedback to help you grow.

About the Role

Mission statement

Keep our clients’ Amazon accounts running accurately and grow their businesses through sound operations, effective advertising, data-driven decisions, and proactive communication.

Sales on Amazon come from a few fundamentals: stock availability, listing quality, advertising, pricing, and promotions. You will own these for the accounts you handle, understand each client’s objectives, recommend priorities, and make sure agreed actions are delivered.

General Responsibilities

Operations

  • Manage day-to-day Seller Central and Vendor Central operations across marketplaces
  • Forecast demand from sales history, calculate replenishment quantities, and prevent stockouts
  • Identify excess inventory and recommend actions
  • Create and coordinate shipments to Amazon warehouses
  • Support product launches and set up promotions
  • Upload and optimize product content to improve listing quality
  • Monitor listings, investigate issues and resolve them with Amazon Support

Advertising

  • Set up, manage and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns
  • Conduct keyword research and search term analysis to find relevant targeting opportunities
  • Manage campaign structure, targeting, bids, budgets, placements and negative keywords
  • Track ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC and conversion rates, and judge them by their effect on overall profitability
  • Test new approaches, fix underperforming campaigns and reallocate budget to what works
  • Align advertising with inventory, pricing, promotions and launches

Clients and analysis

  • Act as the primary point of contact and build strong client relationships
  • Lead regular meetings on performance, challenges, opportunities and priorities
  • Develop account strategies based on each client’s goals and resources
  • Analyze performance across products, variations and categories to find trends and opportunities
  • Build clear reports and turn complex data into actionable recommendations
  • Set realistic timelines, give regular updates and follow through on commitments
  • Balance client requests with operational needs and team capacity

Improvement

  • Investigate unfamiliar problems to their root cause and find practical solutions
  • Improve account management processes for efficiency and accuracy
  • Collaborate with the team to align priorities and deliver strategies
  • Take part in regular training and feedback sessions

Position Specs

  • Fully remote position
  • Ready to start as soon as possible
  • Start on a probationary period at an hourly rate.
  • Opportunity to transition into a full-time position within the Amazon Operations team with a fixed-rate monthly salary following a successful probation period
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the probationary period
  • Vacation days based on your country of residence, plus national holidays
  • Regular training, feedback sessions, and professional development opportunities

Requirements

About You

Profile

You have hands-on experience with Seller Central or Vendor Central, Amazon PPC, and direct client communication. You understand what drives a brand’s sales on Amazon and can manage several accounts while balancing operations, advertising, and client needs.

You are comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can evaluate performance, calculate inventory needs, spot stock risks, and understand how metrics like ACoS, TACoS, and ROAS connect to the client’s overall business.

You are a resourceful problem-solver. When something unfamiliar comes up, you investigate, test possible solutions, and act. When things go wrong, you explain your reasoning to clients clearly and keep their confidence.

You are detail-oriented, organized, and accountable, and you can turn client objectives into clear plans. You are humble, open to feedback, comfortable working remotely, and motivated to grow your Amazon expertise.

Key Traits for This Position

  • Analytical: You reason from data, spot patterns, and back every recommendation with clear logic.
  • Commercially aware: You understand how operational and advertising decisions affect sales and profit, and you prioritize what matters most.
  • Client-focused: You lead conversations confidently, ask good questions, handle difficult discussions, and keep trust through transparency.
  • Curious and adaptable: You learn new processes quickly and work toward solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Ownership-driven: You are organized and accurate, follow through, and turn recommendations into measurable results.

Key Requirements

  • Practical experience with Seller Central or Vendor Central
  • Hands-on experience with Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display
  • Strong understanding of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, and conversion rates
  • Experience with keyword research, search term analysis, bids, budgets, and campaign structure
  • Understanding of inventory, shipments, promotions, product setup, and content
  • Experience handling operational issues and working with Amazon Support
  • Experience with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Amazon Ads Campaign Manager, or similar tools
  • Ability to work across multiple marketplaces and client brands
  • Strong spreadsheet skills
  • Ability to analyze sales and inventory data, calculate replenishment needs, and spot stockout or overstock risks
  • Understanding of how inventory, pricing, promotions, content, and advertising together drive sales
  • Ability to recognize missing information and identify the data needed to decide with confidence
  • Direct client experience, including leading meetings and presenting reports
  • Ability to explain recommendations clearly, manage expectations and set realistic timelines
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities and deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail, ownership and follow-through
  • Independent problem-solving with the judgement to ask for help when needed
  • Genuine interest in Amazon, e-commerce and digital marketing
  • Positive, humble, and collaborative, and open to feedback
  • Comfortable working remotely in a distributed team
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Fluency in additional European languages is a plus
  • Available to start as soon as possible
  • Long-term mindset and motivation to grow within the Amazon team

jobs.title: Principal AI Architect — OleOle
jobs.excerpt: OleOle is seeking an exceptional, hands-on Principal AI Architect to lead the architecture, development, deployment, and ongoing evolution of artificial intelligence initiatives across our global consumer SuperApp.
jobs.description:
OleOle is seeking an exceptional, hands-on Principal AI Architect to lead the architecture, development, deployment, and ongoing evolution of artificial intelligence initiatives across our global consumer SuperApp.

This is not a position for someone whose primary experience is connecting applications to ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini APIs. We need an engineer with deep, firsthand experience developing, fine-tuning, deploying, and operating AI models and infrastructure.

stablishing our overall AI architecture and leading initiatives that include AskOle, real-time multilingual translation, our AI-powered sports history and content generation systems, our sports data engine, and future AI capabilities that have yet to be conceived.

The role requires someone who understands AI at a fundamental engineering level and can determine how different models, technologies, and infrastructure should work together efficiently, reliably, and at global scale.

The Principal AI Architect will work alongside our existing engineering teams and specialized AI engineers, providing technical leadership while remaining directly involved in architecture, model development, fine-tuning, optimization, integration, and deployment.

We are particularly interested in engineers with deep experience in open-source foundation models, self-hosted AI infrastructure, GPU optimization, and production AI systems. The objective is to build an adaptable, cost-efficient AI foundation that allows OleOle to develop new capabilities without becoming dependent on any single AI provider or technology.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position, not a project management or advisory role. We need someone capable of making critical architectural decisions, writing code, solving difficult engineering problems, and taking responsibility for delivering functioning AI systems.

Beyond today's initiatives, this person will help identify, evaluate, and implement emerging AI technologies that can create entirely new products, capabilities, and business opportunities throughout the OleOle ecosystem.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of software engineering, machine learning, or AI engineering experience, with demonstrated principal-level technical leadership.

Extensive hands-on experience developing, training, fine-tuning, and deploying production AI models.

Expert proficiency in Python, PyTorch, transformer architectures, and deep learning frameworks.

Demonstrated experience with open-source foundation models, including Llama, Qwen, Mistral, or equivalent.

Strong experience with LoRA, QLoRA, supervised fine-tuning, model evaluation, and optimization.

Deep knowledge of GPU computing, model quantization, batching, memory management, and inference performance.

Production experience with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, or comparable inference technologies.

Strong distributed-systems architecture and cloud infrastructure expertise.

Proven ability to independently build and deploy complex AI systems rather than exclusively managing engineering teams.

Experience leading engineering initiatives and establishing technical standards across multiple AI projects.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building consumer AI platforms operating at significant scale.

Multilingual and multimodal AI engineering experience.

Recommendation systems, ranking algorithms, and personalization.

Real-time AI inference and streaming architectures.

Contributions to open-source AI projects or published AI research.

Compensation

OleOle operates under a deferred-compensation structure while securing funding. This is not free work or a volunteer position. Compensation is accrued and payable following funding, after which it transitions to a regular salary, equity ownership, and OleX token participation in the overall OleOle group of companies. This opportunity is intended for an entrepreneurial engineering leader interested in building and owning a meaningful part of a global technology business.

Solutions not problems .

  • Creative problem solver who can courageously propose and support new ideas to our organization. Not interested in best practices, lets build something better!
  • Ability to adapt. An ideal candidate will welcome the opportunity to solve a broad range of problems using a wide array of technologies.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and general growing pains of an early-stage technology company
  • An exceptional entrepreneurial judgment that fosters independence over micro-management
  • Understanding of football and international sports a huge plus

Deferred compensation

This opportunity is designed for entrepreneurial, startup-minded engineers who want to help build a significant global business. This is not free work. Compensation is agreed upon and deferred until funding is secured, at which point it transitions to a competitive, normalized salary plus equity and OleX token ownership. Our entire team, including the founder, operates under this arrangement. This position is intended for individuals who understand the risks of an early-stage startup, are comfortable with uncertain funding timelines, and are motivated by the opportunity to build something substantial while participating in its long-term ownership and success.

Ole Ole is located in beautiful Austin Texas, however, this role requires some travel we are privately held and rapidly growing!

Company Description

OleOle is building a global social network and messaging platform for football fans. Our mission is to create a single global community where supporters can follow their club and country, connect with other fans, message and call each other, follow live matches, discover content, and ultimately access a broader ecosystem of football products and services.

The OleOle platform combines social networking, encrypted messaging, live scores, video, multilingual content, payments, digital wallets, AI, and Mini Programs designed around the global football community.

OleOle — Where Fans Kick Off.

jobs.description:
About Us

Marble is building an AI-powered tax assistant and preparation platform that transforms how accounting firms and their clients handle taxes. We're targeting the pain points of mid-to-large size accounting firms with intelligent tools designed to streamline complex tax workflows. We're early stage, highly collaborative, and deeply focused on solving real, high-impact problems for our customers.

About the Role

As a Product Manager you will take ownership of the execution and delivery for one of Marble's most important product lines: building the product that enables accounting firms to complete tax workflows with greater speed, accuracy, and automation.

You will be responsible for developing a deep understanding of how tax firms complete their daily workflows and translating the overarching product strategy into an actionable, day-to-day operating plan for your engineering pod.

The role remains highly hands-on. You will work directly with engineering, tax experts, customers, and other stakeholders to turn complex problems into great, working products.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 5-10 years of overall professional experience.

  • At least 3 years of direct experience as a Product Manager.

What You'll Lead

  • Execute on the product strategy and vision set by the Product Lead, finding the best tactical ways to create differentiated value for accounting firms and their clients.

  • Develop a deep understanding of specific segments of the end-to-end tax workflow, from intake and document processing through preparation, review, and delivery.

  • Identify the highest-leverage opportunities for automation within your specific product area.

Strategic Planning & Prioritization

  • Lead tactical, near-term planning for your product area.

  • Translate broader strategic goals into clear sprint and quarterly plans, sequencing initiatives based on customer impact, technical constraints, and available resources.

  • Manage the backlog and make thoughtful tradeoffs across competing features to ensure the engineering team remains focused on the highest-impact work.

  • Create clarity for your pod around what the team is building now, what comes next, and what we are deliberately choosing not to pursue.

Product Execution

  • Lead and continuously evolve the delivery of your features, balancing near-term customer needs with the longer-term product vision.

  • Work closely with engineering and product ops to turn complex tax workflows into intuitive, reliable product experiences.

  • Drive individual products from discovery through launch and iteration, ensuring teams have the context, requirements, and decisions needed to move quickly.

  • Maintain a high bar for product quality while finding ways to learn and ship quickly.

  • Identify execution risks, dependencies, and unclear decisions early and drive them toward resolution.

Customer & Market Understanding

  • Develop deep relationships with accounting firms and tax professionals to understand how returns are prepared, reviewed, and delivered today.

  • Spend significant time with customers observing workflows, testing feature concepts, gathering feedback, and validating product implementation.

  • Ensure customer insight is continuously incorporated into product execution rather than treated as a one-time discovery exercise.

Product Leadership

  • Take deep ownership of your assigned features, ensuring your daily execution ladders perfectly into the cohesive strategy.

  • Grow your independent product judgment by actively seeking context, coaching, and feedback from the Product Lead.

  • Establish effective product operating rhythms for your pod, including sprint planning, prioritization, discovery, and product reviews.

  • Ensure engineering, tax, and other stakeholders understand the priorities, tradeoffs, and intended outcomes for your specific deliverables.

Why Join Us?

  • Own the technical direction of a product solving one of the most complex, high-stakes workflows in a $500B+ industry.

  • Help build Marble's presence from the ground up.

  • Build and lead a team alongside our Founder, Head of Product and Engineering, who values autonomy and trusts you to operate independently.

  • Work on genuinely unsolved problems. Agentic AI applied to tax is a new frontier.

  • Highly competitive compensation, equity, and benefits.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As a Data Center Sr. PLCTechnician, you will be responsible for independent technical leadership for the pre-startup, startup, commissioning, modification, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting of ABB paralleling switchgear and controls in mission-critical power applications. The successful candidate will, among other duties, lead complex on-site activities, guide junior field resources, and serve as a trusted technical interface for customers, contractors, commissioning agents, project teams, and design engineering.

The work model for the role is: Remote in the US

This is a highly travel-intensive position requiring extensive nationwide travel to customer locations across the United States. Success in this role requires the ability and willingness to spend significant time traveling and working at customer sites. Candidates seeking limited travel should carefully consider this requirement before applying. Comprehensive travel accommodations, lodging, and per diem are provided.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Plan, organize, and execute complex field assignments involving Paralleling Switchgear and other PLC/Relay transfer schemes during pre-startup, full startup, commissioning, modifications, preventive maintenance, and emergency troubleshooting.
  • Lead functional and integrated testing of emergency/standby power systems, including open-transition and closed-transition sequences, hard and soft transfers, load add/shed, utility-generator paralleling, import/export, and baseload applications.
  • Configure, verify, and troubleshoot generator controls, generator load-sharing systems, protective relays, switchgear controls, meters, breakers, PLCs, HMIs/ACS platforms, and associated communications.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting and authorized modifications of PLC ladder logic, PLC I/O, communications, sequencing, and ACS parameters using approved engineering documentation and change-control practices.
  • Establish and troubleshoot Modbus, PLC-to-PLC, redundant PLC, remote PLC, PLC-to-ACS, and customer BMS/EPMS/SCADA communications.
  • Interpret one-line diagrams, elementary schematics, interconnection drawings, sequence-of-operations documents, coordination studies, settings files, and commissioning procedures.
  • Lead on-site technical execution, coordinate daily work, communicate status and risks, manage punch-list closure, and support on-time, on-budget completion of complex or high-profile projects.
  • Direct and mentor junior field engineers and technicians, assign work within demonstrated competencies, and provide practical coaching on safe execution, troubleshooting, documentation, and customer communication.
  • Act as a senior escalation resource for high-level remote and on-site troubleshooting, including emergency response where assigned.
  • Complete accurate field service reports, startup checklists, redlines, test documentation, software backups, time entry, expense reporting, and customer-facing status updates.
  • Protect ABB and customer assets, control job costs and expenditures, and identify opportunities to improve quality, productivity, and service delivery.
  • Build effective customer relationships by translating complex technical findings into clear actions, recommendations, risks, and recovery plans.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED with 7+ years of relevant field experience, or an associate or bachelor degree with 5+ years in a related field.
  • Demonstrated independent field capability highly complex assignments.
  • Advanced experience with low- and medium-voltage switchgear, circuit breakers, protective relays, generator controls, PLC-based controls, HMIs/ACS, industrial networking, and mission-critical power systems.
  • Hands-on experience leading startup and commissioning activities, coordinating energization and switching, troubleshooting under schedule pressure, and directing multi-person site teams.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and redline complex electrical and control drawings and to apply approved engineering methods in the field.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, customer communication, technical reporting, and field leadership skills.
  • Ability to travel extensively within the United States and remain at customer sites for extended assignments based on project demand.
  • Ability to meet ABB and customer site access, electrical safety, training, and personal protective equipment requirements.
  • Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States without requiring ABB sponsorship, where applicable to the requisition.

Preferred Technical Experience:

  • ABB Energy Commander or comparable paralleling switchgear and controls.
  • GE/Emerson RX3i PLCs and Proficy Machine Edition; ABB AC500 and Automation Builder; CP600 HMI/Panel Builder; Cimplicity or comparable supervisory platforms.
  • Woodward EasyGen and LS5 generator controls and load-sharing systems.
  • ABB, SEL/Schweitzer, Multilin, Basler, or Woodward protective relays and associated testing or configuration tools.
  • Modbus, industrial Ethernet, fiber-optic networks, redundant control networks, BMS, EPMS, and SCADA integration.
  • Low- and medium-voltage breaker testing, CT/PT verification, relay testing, primary/secondary injection, turns-ratio, winding-resistance, insulation, power-factor, hipot, phase-rotation, and related commissioning test equipment.
  • Utility paralleling, emergency standby generation, complex load management, data center commissioning, and coordination with third-party commissioning agents.

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

The Application and Integration Support Engineer, IT, Support Center supports, maintains, and monitors enterprise applications across Windows and Linux environments, and periodically assists with mobile application deployment. The Application and Integration Support Engineer focuses on troubleshooting complex technical issues, deploying application updates, performing routine upgrades, monitoring system health, and ensuring application availability.

The Application and Integration Support Engineer is required to demonstrate strong technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and effective communication. By providing hands-on application and system support, the Application and Integration Support Engineer helps ensure optimal performance, stability, and reliability across IT systems, while contributing to release management for both enterprise and mobile applications as needed.


***This is a fully remote position that can be home-based anywhere within the United States. Please be advised that selected candidate will be required to be onsite for the 1st day for onboarding activities. ***

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Troubleshoots complex enterprise application issues by analyzing system logs, error reports, and integration traces; performs root cause analysis on performance bottlenecks, application errors, and service disruptions; documents technical resolutions in knowledge repositories. 20%

  • Contributes to IT project teams by assisting in the design, configuration, and rollout of enterprise applications, integration solutions, and system upgrades; provides support for mobile application rollout activities as needed, aligned with broader deployment initiatives. 20%

  • Assists in planning and executing release cycles by coordinating with cross-functional teams, validating build integrity, performing pre- and post-deployment testing, and documenting release activities; provides periodic support for mobile application deployment through enterprise distribution pipelines. 15%

  • Collaborates with Service Desk, Network Operations, and Infrastructure teams to provide Tier 2/3 escalation support for enterprise applications; performs advanced incident triage, contributes to problem management activities, and supports root cause investigations; provides targeted support for mobile-related incidents as-needed. 10%

  • Develops and maintains operational documentation, including runbooks, environment configuration guides, and deployment procedures to ensure consistency in application and integration support; includes steps for mobile deployment support where applicable. 10%

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY:

  • Administers and optimizesWindows and Linux environments, including server provisioning, patch management, and advanced command-line operations; leverage virtualization platforms (Azure, VMware) to deploy, scale, and maintain high-availability application hosting environments.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Sr. Data Migration Engineer will work as part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing enterprise data migration, conversion, transformation, and archival activities in support of the CMM Data Modernization & Governance program. The role develops migration scripts and pipelines, performs data profiling and mapping, executes data migration and transformation activities, and validates migrated data to ensure that data is accurately and securely transitioned between source and target modern cloud data platforms.

The Sr. Data Migration Engineer will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee enterprise data migration, conversion, and archival efforts.
  • Develop migration strategies, schedules, dependencies, and execution procedures.
  • Build and maintain migration scripts, SQL, and ETL/ELT pipelines for legacy-to-cloud data transfers.
  • Execute extraction, transformation, loading, and post-load validation activities.
  • Perform data profiling, cleansing, mapping, and transformation; define source-to-target mappings.
  • Validate migrated data through reconciliation, completeness checks, and QA testing.
  • Manage cutover activities, including pre-checks, execution, validation, and sign-off.
  • Automate data reconciliation and validation processes.
  • Support migration testing, mock runs, rehearsals, cutovers, and rollback procedures.
  • Design and implement data archival processes aligned with retention and governance standards.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues and discrepancies.
  • Document migration procedures, mappings, and runbooks.
  • Work with governance, quality, and business teams to validate data against standards and rules.
  • Tune migration jobs to maximize throughput and minimize downtime.
  • Participate in planning, risk assessments, and rollback strategy development.
  • Maintain migration logs, issue registers, and execution reports.
  • Support archival and retention activities with Data Governance and Records Management.
  • Collaborate with DBAs, platform engineers, architects, app teams, and governance groups.
  • Optimize migration performance for large-scale, high-volume datasets.
  • Ensure compliance with security, privacy, classification, retention, and governance requirements.
  • Maintain migration runbooks and operational procedures.
  • Support production cutovers and post-migration stabilization.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and automation of migration processes.
  • Manage and optimize cloud data platforms, including account setup, configuration, scaling, performance tuning, and warehouse / lakehouse operations.
  • Govern databases, schemas, roles, and RBAC to align with AO security, IAM, & compliance policies.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot pipelines, queries, concurrency, & resource utilization for uptime & cost efficiency.
  • Implement cost‑optimization strategies and support financial reporting, forecasting, and TCO analysis.
  • Automate and document provisioning, access management, data loading, and monitoring using Terraform, dbt, SQL, Python, or similar tools.
  • Partner with data engineers, BI teams, and architects to design efficient data models and optimize ELT workflows.
  • Support security audits, ATO artifacts, incident response, DR/HA testing, and operational runbooks for modern cloud data platform services.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MA/MS degree with 5+ years or BS/BA degree with 7+ years of general experience in information systems and 5+ years of specialized experience.
  • Strong data engineering and architecture background with deep ETL/ELT and migration experience (Informatica, Talend, AWS DMS, ADF).
  • Skilled in Python, Bash, SQL, and automation for migration scripts, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Expertise in AWS data migration services, cloud-native data platforms, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Preferred hands-on experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, and large-scale analytical workloads.
  • Strong SQL performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and execution-plan analysis.
  • Proficient with Terraform, dbt, IaC, and automation frameworks supporting scalable migrations.
  • Experienced with CI/CD, GitOps, DevSecOps, and enterprise build/release pipelines.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex migration issues under tight cutover windows with attention to detail.
  • Experienced with containerized application workflows and cloud platform operations.
  • Familiarity with federal security, compliance, and governance frameworks (FedRAMP, NIST, JISF).
  • Skilled in log/metric analysis and cloud performance tuning; strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Preferred experience supporting Federal Government programs or regulated environments.
  • Collaborator across cross‑functional data, platform, and governance teams.
  • Experience with FinOps, cost modeling, and cloud optimization to support modernization initiatives.
  • Preferred experience with optimizing large-scale analytical workloads.

CERTIFICATIONS (Preferred)

  • Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP)
  • Snowflake SnowPro Advanced
  • Databricks Certified Data Professional
  • AWS Certified Data Analytics - Specialty
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional
  • AWS Certified Data Engineer
  • Docker Certified Associate
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator
  • Certified Professional DevSecOps Certification Course
  • ITIL, AWS SysOps, Google Cloud DevOps Engineer

jobs.excerpt: Aboutthird Third is a modern-commerce growth company helping brands turn new and emerging platforms into real sales channels.
jobs.description:
Aboutthird

Third is a modern-commerce growth company helping brands turn new and emerging platforms into real sales channels.

Our integrated acquisition strategy connects best-in-class teams across TikTok, Whatnot, Meta, Snap, and beyond - eliminating the need to stitch together multiple partners.

Third blends deep niche expertise with modern execution to launch, operate, and scale commerce on new platforms, transforming culture, creators, and content into real product sales.

The Role

The Data & Insights Analyst owns retail client reporting and halo measurement at Third.

You will build and shape client and internal dashboards and reports, and you will analyze raw performance data to understand how TikTok Shop and social activity lift sales at retail, on Amazon, and on brand sites.

You will sit between our Strategy and Client Success teams. Client Success Managers will rely on you for the numbers. Strategy will rely on you for the read on what the numbers mean. You will present findings internally and externally as needed.

What You’ll Do

Client reporting

  • Build and maintain retail client dashboards for TikTok Shop GMV, affiliate performance, sample funnels, content velocity, live shopping, and GMV Max paid media.
  • Own the weekly and monthly reporting cadence. Automate what repeats.
  • Set benchmarks for each client against its own history, its category, and TikTok Shop overall.
  • Turn performance data into a short list of actionable recommendations.
  • As SME for halo, clearly communicate results and be able to respond to data questions.

Retail and social halo measurement

  • Measure how TikTok Shop and social activity lift sales at brick-and-mortar retail, on Amazon, and on DTC sites.
  • Design tests that isolate that lift, such as geo holdouts, matched markets, pre/post analysis, and synthetic controls.
  • Compile retailer point-of-sale data, marketplace data, search trends, and TikTok data into one view.
  • Build a repeatable halo framework that Third can leverage in pitches, quarterly reviews, and retailer conversations.
  • Respond to client measurement frameworks and RFI questions with a clear Third point of view.

Data quality and tooling

  • Reconcile TikTok Shop native data against third-party data tools. Document where they disagree and why.
  • Keep a clean house set of metric definitions so every team reports the same number the same way.
  • Support new business with category sizing and competitive analysis.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in marketing analytics, retail analytics, media analytics, or commerce insights. Agency experience is a plus.
  • Hands-on work experience with retail data. You know POS data, retailer portals, and syndicated sales data.
  • Experience measuring incrementality or lift. You have designed a test, run it, and explained the result to a client.
  • Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills. Python or R for analysis.
  • Dashboard experience in Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
  • Comfort with social platform data. TikTok, Meta, and YouTube analytics should feel familiar.

Nice to Have

  • TikTok Shop experience on the brand, agency, or platform side.
  • Retail media experience with Walmart Connect, Roundel, or Amazon Ads.
  • Marketing mix modeling experience, or experience feeding test results into an MMM.
  • CPG category experience.
  • Experience with AI tools for analysis and report automation.

Tools and Data You’ll Work With

Area

What you'll use

TikTok Shop

Seller Center, Affiliate Center, GMV Max reporting, TikTok Shop APIs

Market and creator data

Third-party TikTok Shop intelligence and creator platforms

Retail and marketplace

Retailer POS portals, syndicated retail sales data, Amazon and Walmart reporting

Social and search

TikTok, Meta, and YouTube analytics, Google Trends, social listening

Analysis and reporting

SQL, Python, Google Sheets, Excel, Looker Studio or Tableau

In-house

Creative Engine, Third's proprietary content analysis tool

Who You Are

  • Digging into the data makes your day. You want to know every client’s reporting, and you’re always looking for ways to improve dashboards and metric definitions.
  • You know what goes into a halo measurement study, and can explain the results to a client.
  • You write and present clearly. A brand VP can understand your slide in under a minute.
  • You can run several client accounts at once and hit reporting deadlines.
  • You are curious and analytical, always looking for the correlations in the data.

Why This Role Matters

Clients renew because they trust us. Success in this role means clients know they can trust our numbers, and our account teams know they can spend less time pulling data and more time acting on it.

You will be a key contributor to Third’s point of view on retail data. Your enthusiasm for connecting the dots will help shape that.

Location

USA Remote

Compensation

  • Base salary: $75K - $85K annually
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible PTO
  • Remote-first work environment with periodic team gatherings

Third is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where all employees feel valued and empowered

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Partner Marketing Manager

Role Summary

As Partner Marketing Manager, you will own the full marketing strategy and growth outcomes for several of Imprint's largest co-branded credit card partnerships. You are the marketing leader for your partners: the person accountable for how we acquire, activate, and retain cardholders across every channel, and the person partners look to as the strategic marketing mind behind their program.

You will operate as the CMO for your assigned partners: leading annual marketing planning in lockstep with General Managers and partner executives, owning full-funnel performance from application through long-term retention, and driving high-impact campaign strategy and execution across paid, owned, and partner channels. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategic planning and hands-on technical execution, who earns credibility with senior partner stakeholders, and who builds marketing programs that compound in quality and impact as Imprint scales its co-branded portfolio.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Built and presented a 12-month marketing plan for each assigned partner with quarterly execution detail, investment priorities, and measurable growth targets, aligned with GMs and partner marketing leadership

  • Completed a diagnostic assessment of each partner's full-funnel performance (application through retention), identified the highest leverage opportunities, and built a prioritized optimization roadmap with clear sequencing

  • Created a partner marketing playbook defining audience segmentation, positioning, messaging architecture, and channel strategy that serves as the strategic foundation for internal creative and campaign teams and holds up in senior partner conversations

  • Launched or meaningfully iterated on campaigns in at least two channels (lifecycle, paid social, direct mail, affiliate) with measurable performance improvements and a clear point of view on what to scale next

  • Established yourself as a trusted strategic partner to GMs, Lifecycle Managers, product, engineering, marketing analytics, and partner marketing leadership

  • Demonstrated technical depth in campaign deployment tools and workflows, with the credibility to make architectural decisions about how campaigns are built and delivered

Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy and Growth Ownership

  • Own marketing strategy, planning, execution, and performance for major co-branded partners, with direct accountability for partner growth outcomes including acquisition volume, activation, spend, and retention

  • Lead the development of 12-month marketing roadmaps in partnership with GMs, including quarterly planning cycles, budget allocation, and investment tradeoff decisions

  • Present marketing strategy and performance to partner marketing leadership and internal executives, owning the growth narrative for your assigned programs

  • Identify and prioritize the highest leverage opportunities across the funnel and make investment recommendations based on performance data, partner dynamics, and competitive landscape

Acquisition and Campaign Strategy

  • Design, lead, and optimize acquisition campaigns across paid channels (paid social, paid search, affiliate, direct mail) and owned channels (lifecycle, in-app, email)

  • Develop and own experimentation frameworks that systematically improve CAC, LTV, and partner-specific KPIs, with a rigorous approach to test design, measurement, and learning

  • Build audience segmentation, positioning, and messaging strategies that sharpen creative execution, strengthen partner channel marketing, and drive measurable lift in conversion

  • Make channel mix and budget allocation decisions based on performance data, and have the judgment to shift resources quickly when the data warrants it

Full-Funnel Optimization

  • Partner with Lifecycle Managers and analytics to own full-funnel performance: application rate, approval rate, activation rate, spend behavior, insurance attach, and retention

  • Diagnose funnel breakdowns and lead cross-functional efforts to resolve them, working across product, engineering, analytics, and lifecycle to ship improvements

  • Build and maintain a clear performance story for each partner: what's working, what's not, where the leverage is, and what the plan is

Partner Relationship and Influence

  • Serve as the senior marketing point of contact for assigned partners, building trust and credibility with partner marketing leadership through strategic depth and consistent delivery

  • Translate partner objectives and commercial goals into actionable marketing strategies that create value for both Imprint and the partner

  • Bring a clear, data-informed point of view into partner conversations and the strategic credibility to shape joint marketing decisions, not just execute on partner requests

  • Set expectations with partners on what's realistic, what's working, and where we should invest next, and have the conviction to push back when needed

Vendor and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Own relationships with external vendors (affiliate platforms, direct mail bureaus, media agencies) and lead vendor performance management, negotiation, and strategic alignment

  • Drive cross-functional alignment with product, engineering, analytics, and creative to ensure marketing programs are executed with speed and quality

  • Identify gaps in marketing infrastructure, tooling, or process and lead initiatives to improve campaign deployment speed, quality, and scalability

Measurement and Reporting

  • Own the measurement framework and reporting cadence for assigned partners, tracking application volume, approval rate, activation rate, insurance attach, partner revenue, retention, and LTV

  • Lead performance reviews with internal stakeholders and partner teams, translating data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations

  • Use performance insights to continuously refine strategy, reallocate investment, and raise the bar on what good looks like across the portfolio

Qualifications

Required

  • 7 to 10+ years of growth marketing or partner marketing experience in financial services or fintech, with a track record of leading (not just supporting) the launch and scaling of products or partnerships

  • Deep technical knowledge of marketing workflows across paid and owned channels, including lifecycle campaign deployment through tools like Braze, with the ability to make architectural and workflow decisions

  • Experience with affiliate platforms (Impact, AWIN) and paid acquisition channels (paid social, paid search), with demonstrated ability to optimize channel mix and manage meaningful media budgets

  • Strong analytical skills with proven experience diagnosing funnel performance, designing experiments, and optimizing CAC, approval rates, activation rates, LTV, and retention at scale

  • Proven ability to build marketing plans, experimentation frameworks, and funnel optimization strategies in close partnership with cross-functional teams, and the leadership skills to drive alignment and accountability

  • Track record of building trust and credibility with senior partner stakeholders, with the ability to represent Imprint's marketing strategy at the executive level

  • Exceptional communicator who can translate complex partner objectives into clear marketing strategies, and who can present confidently to both internal leadership and external partner teams

Nice to Have

  • Growth marketing depth: experience leading performance media campaigns end to end with a strong command of CAC optimization, paid media strategy, and budget management across multiple channels

  • Direct mail expertise: experience deploying pre-screen direct mail or ITA campaigns, including working with data providers (TransUnion, Axiom) and direct mail vendors (DMS)

  • Experience in high-growth startups or scaling marketing programs in resource-constrained environments where you had to build the playbook while shipping at speed

  • Familiarity with product marketing for new product launches, not just management of existing programs, and comfort operating in ambiguity during early-stage go-to-market

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.
