jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Ideal candidate will have current brokerage underwriting experience.



Job Description Summary

Are you a critical thinker who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to hear from you!

Our Excess & Surplus/Specialty (E&S/S) lines allow us to provide insurance that other carriers may not offer. It’s a fast-paced environment in a collaborative, team-oriented culture, working in an always-changing, growing industry.

As an Underwriting Specialist in Brokerage Casualty you determine individual risk acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions, by developing, analyzing and evaluating information and exposures on risks of a complex technical nature for the Primary Casualty line of business. In addition, you’ll achieve production and loss ratio goals with assigned brokers or program managers by reviewing and analyzing claims, loss history and taking appropriate action on accounts. Broker assignments are more complex in terms of coverage and broker relationships. You will work independently with a high level of authority and judgment. Determining appropriate reinsurance placement, if any, on individual accounts is an important element of this role. We will count on you to foster positive business relationships with co-workers, brokers and reinsurers. You will also assist with research, development and presentation of new products, forms and manuals and have opportunities to assist in the training and mentoring of Underwriters and Underwriting Assistants.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • In partnership with Consultant/Manager researches market trends, competition and market viability as well as develops an active working partnership with Actuarial, Finance and Claims as appropriate.

  • Reviews individual risks with assigned brokers and either declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. The underwriter analyzes, with a high level of technical expertise, exposures to loss, develops an adequate premium charge for the exposure, determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract. Within department guidelines, places reinsurance, if any, for the account.

  • Achieves team/individual production and loss ratio goals with assigned brokers through sound management and marketing. Works with more complex issues concerning coverage. The underwriter continually analyzes premium and loss results of assigned brokers by agency, state, major class of business, etc. Continually assess quality of broker submissions and makes corrective action recommendations.

  • Handles policy maintenance items and other mid-term requests. Reviews endorsement requests and processes necessary changes to the policy. Reviews loss control reports and makes recommendations to the broker and/or changes to the policy. Follows up on outstanding information as required. Reviews claim activity and takes appropriate action.

  • Places reinsurance per department guidelines based upon the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty, semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Maintains good working relationship with re-insurers.

  • Fosters positive business relationships with brokers, through frequent contact. Develops and maintains good rapport and resolves broker conflicts. Travels to broker offices as required for training or marketing visits. Entertains brokers visiting the Company as required. Assists with development of marketing ideas and strategies for underwriting events and other marketing campaigns.

  • Proactively develops technical and business knowledge through internal and external venues.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Underwriting Manager. No direct reports. Indirect reports not typically assigned.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

License/Certification/Designation: Completion of general insurance courses such as CPCU, CIC, AU, ARM, CPIW, CWIS, or ASLI is preferred.

Experience: Five years as a CL underwriter, excess & surplus lines experience preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Knowledge of CL underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting marketing principles and techniques. Knowledge of Rating plans and plan concepts. Knowledge of Treaty & Cultivate reinsurance concepts. Knowledge of the wholesale broker system and company operations. Knowledge of regulatory issues, the general agency system, market conditions and company operations. Ability to communicate effectively, verbally, and in writing, inter personally with individuals and groups via telephone, video conference fax, e-mail and in person. Demonstrates negotiation skills. Ability to manage the assigned line or lines of business, which may include monitoring of aggregates. Ability to analyze insurance risks to determine acceptability including policy language, various commercial rating plans and methodologies, reinsurance. Ability to use/learn job related computer software. Ability to devise business solutions to problems, implement the most appropriate, and monitor its effectiveness. Ability to make decisions with minimal supervision.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Overtime Eligibility: Exempt (Not Eligible)

About the Role

Kennedy ABA is looking for a highly detail-oriented Healthcare Quality Assurance & Administrative Coordinator to support its growing healthcare operations.

This individual will be responsible for reviewing, checking and maintaining the accuracy and quality of healthcare-related documentation, administrative records and internal processes.

The role requires someone who genuinely enjoys structured, repetitive and detail-heavy work. You will regularly work with large amounts of information, navigate multiple software systems, identify inconsistencies, flag errors and ensure that information is complete, accurate and properly maintained.

You will work closely with internal teams, helping ensure that documentation, administrative processes and quality standards are consistently maintained.

This is not a traditional administrative role. We need someone who takes ownership of their work, enjoys getting into the finer details and understands that even the smallest oversight can have an impact in a healthcare environment.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Assurance & Documentation Review

  • Review healthcare-related documentation, records and internal files to ensure information is accurate, complete and properly recorded.
  • Conduct detailed quality checks to identify missing information, inconsistencies, errors or incomplete documentation.
  • Verify that records meet internal quality standards and established procedures.
  • Identify discrepancies and flag issues requiring correction or further investigation.
  • Track errors, document findings and follow up to ensure outstanding issues are resolved.
  • Maintain consistency and accuracy across all documentation and administrative records.

2. Healthcare Administration & Records Management

  • Assist with maintaining and organising healthcare-related records and documentation.
  • Review and update patient-related information within internal systems.
  • Ensure records are properly maintained, organised and accessible to relevant team members.
  • Assist with tracking documentation, outstanding requirements and administrative follow-ups.
  • Support the accurate processing and maintenance of healthcare administrative information.
  • Handle confidential patient and family information with discretion and in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

3. Systems & Data Management

  • Work across multiple healthcare platforms, CRM systems and internal databases.
  • Navigate complicated software systems to retrieve, review, update and verify information.
  • Ensure data is entered accurately and consistently across systems.
  • Identify discrepancies between different platforms and investigate or escalate them.
  • Assist with maintaining trackers, spreadsheets, reports and administrative databases.
  • Adapt quickly to new software, systems and internal workflows.

4. Communication & Team Collaboration

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with internal team members regarding documentation errors, missing information and outstanding tasks.
  • Follow up consistently with relevant departments to obtain corrections or missing information.
  • Escalate issues that require further attention or clarification.
  • Provide clear updates on completed quality checks, outstanding items and identified concerns.
  • Work collaboratively with clinical and administrative teams to maintain smooth operational processes.

5. Process Improvement & Operational Support

  • Identify recurring documentation errors, administrative gaps and opportunities to improve internal processes.
  • Assist with maintaining quality checklists, procedures and tracking systems.
  • Ensure tasks are completed accurately and within required timeframes.
  • Manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of attention to detail.
  • Support the team in maintaining efficient and consistent administrative and quality assurance processes.

Essential Requirements

  • Previous experience in healthcare administration, quality assurance, medical administration, healthcare operations or a similar detail-intensive role.
  • Demonstrated experience handling repetitive, tedious and highly detailed tasks.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify even minor discrepancies.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with complex software systems, databases and multiple platforms.
  • Strong computer literacy and confidence working with digital records and spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work independently while remaining an active and collaborative team member.
  • Able to manage a fast-paced workload without compromising accuracy.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to follow structured processes.
  • Proactive attitude with a willingness to take ownership of tasks and follow through until completion.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Previous experience within a US healthcare environment would be advantageous.
  • Exposure to ABA therapy, behavioural healthcare or other allied healthcare services would be beneficial.
  • Experience with medical records, clinical documentation or healthcare quality checks.
  • CRM experience is a significant advantage.
  • Familiarity with healthcare administration, insurance documentation, authorisations or billing processes would be beneficial.
  • Experience using healthcare management platforms, electronic health records (EHR) or practice management systems.

Note: A BCBA or RBT certification is not a requirement for this position. The focus is on administrative accuracy, documentation quality, systems proficiency and operational support rather than providing clinical assessments or making clinical decisions.

Ideal Candidate Personality

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is exceptionally detail-oriented and naturally notices things others might overlook.
  • Genuinely enjoys tedious, repetitive and structured work.
  • Takes pride in accuracy and producing consistently high-quality work.
  • Is eager to work, proactive and willing to get involved.
  • Is a strong communicator who is comfortable following up and asking questions.
  • Can work through complicated systems without becoming overwhelmed.
  • Is organised, methodical and thorough.
  • Can maintain concentration while working through large volumes of information.
  • Is adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Is a dependable team player who takes accountability for their responsibilities.

Red Flags

Someone who becomes easily bored or frustrated with repetitive tasks.

Candidates who rush through work and overlook small details.

Poor written communication or an inability to communicate issues clearly.

Individuals who require constant supervision or reminders to complete tasks.

Candidates who struggle to navigate software or learn new systems.

Someone who avoids tedious administrative work or loses concentration easily.

Candidates who are not proactive about identifying and addressing errors.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.
  • High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.
  • Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

jobs.excerpt: Teach English Online! • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing • Long-term employment only!
jobs.description:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

jobs.description:
Hi there!
We are currently looking for a strong Full-Stack Developer-AI-First SaaS Engineer

About Us:
5Blue Software is an Israeli-Ukrainian software development company specializing in custom software development, staff augmentation, dedicated engineering teams, AI solutions, and CTO-as-a-Service. We help startups and mid-sized companies scale faster with vetted engineering talent across Europe.

About the project:
Join a fast-growing AI-first product company building a B2B SaaS platform that helps organizations simplify security, compliance, and AI governance.
The platform automates processes that traditionally require significant manual work — from evidence collection and monitoring to audit preparation and certification workflows.
You'll join a lean, highly collaborative international engineering team distributed across Europe, Israel, and South Africa.

About the role:
We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Developer who is comfortable working across both frontend and backend and enjoys taking ownership of features from idea to production.
This is an AI-first engineering environment. AI is used both as part of the product and as a standard part of the development workflow. You'll use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring while maintaining strong engineering judgment and the ability to write and understand code independently.
You'll work closely with Engineering and Product on system design, architecture, and feature development, with a particular focus on building high-quality React experiences while contributing confidently to the backend.

What you'll do:

  • Build and deliver full-stack features end to end using React, TypeScript, and Node.js.

  • Develop intuitive, performant, and scalable frontend experiences for a complex B2B SaaS product.

  • Implement backend services, APIs, business logic, and third-party integrations.

  • Develop and integrate AI-powered product features.

  • Participate in system design and architectural decisions.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar as part of your everyday workflow.

  • Review, debug, test, and improve AI-generated code while maintaining ownership of the implementation.

  • Take responsibility for the CI/CD and DevOps aspects of the features you build.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Product to define requirements and technical solutions.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with a distributed international team.

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly and confidently in English.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with roughly 5+ years of experience with Node.js as a guide rather than a hard line. Real depth in a closely related stack can also count.

  • 2+ years of professional experience with React as a guide.

  • Strong experience with TypeScript.

  • Hands-on experience with Express, Fastify, or a similar API framework.

  • Strong full-stack capabilities and the ability to work comfortably across frontend and backend, even with a natural lean toward one side.

  • Production experience with microservices architecture.

  • Working familiarity with AWS or a comparable cloud provider such as GCP or Azure.

  • Hands-on experience with both relational and non-relational databases, such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB or similar.

  • Experience integrating third-party REST APIs into a production system, beyond just building your own API endpoints.

  • Real experience shipping AI-powered features in a live product, not just experimenting with AI on personal projects.

  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude Code or similar as a genuine part of your development workflow, balanced with the ability to write and debug code yourself, unaided, live.

  • Working proficiency in DevOps, QA, and CI/CD at the level expected of a senior engineer, not a dedicated DevOps hire.

  • Strong spoken English, comfortable holding a real-time technical conversation such as a system design discussion.

  • A background from a product or SaaS company rather than a project-based agency. Experience in security, compliance, GRC, or developer-tools SaaS is a natural fit, though not required.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or a comparable agent/AI framework.

  • Python experience alongside your primary stack.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerization more broadly.

  • A CS / Software Engineering academic background.

  • A track record as the front-end "champion" on a full-stack team: someone who can carry that surface area while still holding their own on the backend.

What we offer:
— Flexible Work Environment: Opportunity to work remotely.
— 1:1 English Classes: Individual English language training.
— Premium Medical Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance.
— Great Team: Supportive, collaborative, and dynamic international team.
— Equipment Provided: All necessary equipment supplied.
— Accounting Support: Full accounting assistance in Ukraine and Poland.
— Paid Time Off: 18 days of annual vacation and 7 days of sick leave without a doctor's note.
— Flexible Payment System: Convenient payment solution with multiple withdrawal options.

If you're a strong full-stack engineer who enjoys building real products, taking ownership, and using AI to become a more effective developer — we'd love to hear from you.

Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.
  • Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.
  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.
  • Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.
  • High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.
  • Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

jobs.excerpt: Company :Allegheny Health NetworkJob Description : GENERAL OVERVIEW:The incumbent is responsible for implementation and execution of various post-award and financial management activities for grants, contracts and/or clinical trials within the Sponsored Programs Financial Services (SPFS) supporting Allegheny-Singer Research Institute and Allegheny Health Network.
jobs.description:
Company :

Allegheny Health Network

Job Description :

GENERAL OVERVIEW:

The incumbent is responsible for implementation and execution of various post-award and financial management activities for grants, contracts and/or clinical trials within the Sponsored Programs Financial Services (SPFS) supporting Allegheny-Singer Research Institute and Allegheny Health Network. Responsibilities include award set-up, transaction processing, compliance review, cash management, collections, financial reporting and project close-out. Responsible for material accuracy of financial statements /reports. Analyze financial results and outcomes, trends/projections, performance metrics and provides root cause analysis to help facilitate business decisions while adhering to institutional policies and procedures and Sponsor guidelines.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Compliance Management: Read and develop full understanding of business and financial terms and conditions of grant, contract, and/or clinical trial agreement.Maintain compliance with allowable costs, period of performance, subrecipient monitoring, tracking cost share and program income, effort reporting, reporting, other special test provisions, cash management invoicing, and clinical trial billing compliance.Keep current on compliance with federal, state, local, private sponsors, and other agency regulation including Uniform Guidance. Evaluates and maintains business processes in support of post-award management.

  • Invoicing, Accounting Receivable, and Cash Management: Develop full understanding of payment terms and payment schedule as outline in the grant, contract and/or clinical agreement terms. Promptly invoice and timely follow-up on outstanding payments owed. Ensure proper recording cash against programs. Ability to independently troubleshoot, analyze, and problem solve payment variances and queries with Sponsor ensuring positive cash flow. Ability to setup and work within Sponsor portals to setup payment profiles, submit invoices, and retrieve payment backup as needed.

  • Month-end Close: Maintains processes and prepares journal entries to support the monthly close process and the generation of the monthly financial statements/reports. Ensures all financial transactions/entries are properly documented and completed timely.Ensures all financial transactions/entries agree with GAAP, Uniform Guidance, and with institutional policies and procedures.Possesses expertise with the institution’s financial systems.

  • Reporting: Independently prepares simple to complex financial reports, working collaboratively with management, financial and program staff to address discrepancies and correct errors. Monitors and meets allinternal and Sponsor stipulated deadlines and content requirements. Ensures reports are clear, accurate, and submitted on-time. Ability to translate and accurately report financials on Sponsor required forms as required. Address ad hoc reports and analysis as needed.

  • Project Closeout:Independently complete project closeout documentation that are accurate, properly documented and on time. Ensures cost share requirements have been met, unallowable costs have been removed, subaward/contract expenses are accounted for, and outstanding obligations have been addressed. Communicates clearly with financial and program staff and others as appropriate to gather necessary information and supporting documentation. Ensure all invoices and payments are complete. Close project cost center in all financial systems.

  • Audit: Independently applies compliance with regulations and guidelines and implements/documents internal controls, policies, and procedures. Gather documentation and information for auditors from multiple sources as required.

  • Other duties as assigned or requested.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or related field or relevant experience and/or education as determined by the company in lieu of bachelor's degree.

  • Knowledge of accounting principles, budget planning, and financial analysis with the ability to interpret and apply fiscal regulations (preferred with focus on clinical research or healthcare)

  • Ability to assess, research, and resolve complex financial and compliance issues while applying sound judgment.

  • This position requires a deep understanding of financial management in a clinical trial setting, expertise in research accounting, and a strong background in compliance and auditing

Preferred

  • Prior experience in grant, contract and clinical trial financial administration, knowledge of federal agency regulations, policies, and procedures, Uniform Guidance, laws and federal acquisition regulations applicable to research and sponsored programs

  • Prior experience with clinical trial financial management and/or clinical research billing compliance and regulations

SKILLS:

  • Organizational and mathematical skills with ability to analyze data, formulate conclusions, demonstrate agility and problem-solving techniques.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, ability lead financial meetings with all levels within the organization and with ability to translate and summarize numbers into an understandable narrative to others.

  • Strong attention to detail with high level of accuracy

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize and manage large volumes of work to anticipate and meet tight deadlines.

  • Proficiency in financial software and adaptability to new technologies. Understand financial processes and controls including the reconciliations.

  • Proficiency with MS Excel skills such as sorting, pivot tables, filtering, lookups, subtotals, basic formulas.

  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and implement complex regulations, procedures and/or compliance standards.

  • Attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to process and handle confidential information with discretion.

jobs.description:
The Operations & Offices Manager is responsible for ensuring that BlackStone eIT's people, assets, compliance, and facilities operate reliably and consistently across all company locations (spanning the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, and Morocco, alongside a distributed consultant workforce).

Reporting directly to the Chief Process Officer, the role requires a high degree of autonomy, cross-border coordination capability, independent day-to-day problem-solving, structured upward management, and leadership of a geographically dispersed team of varying skill levels.

Key Responsibilities

1. People Operations — Onboarding & Offboarding

  • End-to-End Onboarding: Manage onboarding for new joiners across all geographies to ensure Day 1 readiness in coordination with HR, IT, and Finance.
  • Asset Management: Procure, prepare, and hand over equipment to new joiners while maintaining accurate asset records.
  • Offboarding & Insurance: Oversee full offboarding (equipment recovery, insurance cancellations, documentation) and handle employee medical insurance enrollment on joining and cancellation on exit.

2. Visa, Immigration & Compliance

  • Visas & Permits: Manage employee visa issuance, renewals, and cancellations across the UAE, KSA, Jordan, and Egypt, coordinating with PROs and government authorities.
  • Tracking & Registrations: Maintain a proactive tracking system for visa, permit, and commercial registration expiry dates, and oversee company commercial licenses across jurisdictions.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure full compliance with regional labor laws in the UAE, KSA, Jordan, Egypt, and the US, maintaining audit readiness at all times.

3. Payroll & Finance Operations Support

  • Payroll Inputs: Review and approve all Operations-originated payroll inputs (expense additions, deductions, reimbursements) submitted by country coordinators before the HR payroll cycle.
  • Accuracy & Timeliness: Ensure country-level payroll and expense submissions are accurate, complete, and delivered on time monthly.
  • Variance Resolution: Coordinate with HR Payroll to resolve variances or exceptions prior to Finance submission.

4. Office & Facilities Management

  • Team Supervision: Supervise country Operations coordinators and support staff across regional offices to maintain consistent operational standards.
  • Facilities & Vendors: Manage office leases, facilities, utilities, maintenance, and vendor contracts across all locations.
  • Logistics & Budgets: Oversee travel, accommodation, and transportation logistics, manage medical insurance renewals and provider relationships, and monitor administrative/facilities budgets for cost savings.

5. Process Improvement & Reporting

  • Standardization: Document, standardize, and continuously improve operational processes across all geographies.
  • Optimization: Identify operational gaps, manual workarounds, and automation opportunities, presenting recommendations with clear rationale to the CPO.
  • Audits: Support company-wide reporting, compliance checks, and operational audits.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • Experience: 7–10 years of experience in multi-country operations, office management, or administrative leadership roles.
  • Distributed Leadership: Proven track record managing a distributed team across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Immigration Expertise: Hands-on experience with visa, immigration, and government liaison processes in KSA, UAE, and/or Jordan.
  • Program Management: Experience managing medical insurance programs and vendor contracts.
  • Process Building: Demonstrated ability to build and enforce operational procedures in environments with inconsistent or absent processes.
  • Compliance Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of regional labor and compliance frameworks across KSA, UAE, Jordan, and Egypt.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in MS Office and experience working with ERP or operational management systems.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Flexible to work across multiple time zones and working week structures (Saturday–Wednesday for KSA; Monday–Friday for Egypt and Jordan).

Skills & Competencies

  • Operational Discipline: Ability to design, document, and enforce processes and hold teams accountable.
  • Cross-Border Coordination: Comfortable managing country-level operations remotely without physical oversight.
  • Diverse Team Leadership: Experienced in managing mixed-capability teams (from qualified coordinators to support staff), adapting communication styles and performance management accordingly.
  • Executive Communication: Structured and concise in managing upward; knows what/when to escalate and maintains composure under pressure.
  • Service Orientation: Approaches colleagues as internal customers to provide efficient, professional, and friction-free support.
  • Problem-Solving: Resolves operational blockers independently and escalates only what genuinely requires senior intervention.
  • Attention to Detail: Rigorous in record-keeping, tracking deadlines, and maintaining compliance documentation.

Preferred (Advantageous) Qualifications

  • Prior experience in an IT staffing, systems integration, managed services, or professional services environment.
  • Experience coordinating payroll inputs across multi-currency, multi-country payroll cycles.
  • Experience managing equipment procurement and asset tracking for a dispersed, consultant-heavy workforce.
  • Very good English language proficiency (for KSA and UAE coordination).

jobs.description:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

About the role
Staff Accountant

We are hiring on behalf of a fast-growing DTC men's apparel brand doing over $10M per month in revenue. Comfort-first, performance-minded basics: shorts, tees, hoodies, pants. California-rooted, 100% bootstrapped, running on Shopify with paid Meta as the growth engine.

The Role

This is not a back-office job. This is the financial nerve center of a fast-moving DTC operation.

You will own the daily accounting engine covering AP, receiving reconciliation, vendor accounts, and COGS accuracy. Then you will do what most accountants cannot: turn those numbers into answers. Which SKUs are printing money and which are dead weight? Which vendors are quietly bleeding the company on variances?

You will work directly with ownership. No layers, no bureaucracy. Ownership handles month-end close and the big strategic calls. You run the daily operation, surface what matters, and bring analysis sharp enough to change decisions. When you find something, it gets acted on that day.

If you have ever caught a six-figure error nobody else saw, or built the analysis that killed a bad product line, this is your room.

What You'll Own

Accounts Payable, full cycle

  • Process, code, and schedule vendor invoices across the full supplier base
  • Execute 3-way matching (PO, receiving report, invoice) on every inbound shipment
  • Run payment cycles, track terms, and capture early-pay discounts
  • Resolve discrepancies directly with vendors

Receiving and Inventory Accuracy

  • Daily reconciliation of invoiced quantities against goods actually received
  • Catch short ships, production variances, and pricing errors before they become write-offs
  • Partner with fulfillment leadership to keep receiving documentation airtight

COGS and Unit Economics

  • Maintain weighted average cost accuracy across roughly 1,300 SKUs
  • Reconcile landed costs including freight, duties, and inbound charges into true unit economics
  • Support monthly COGS true-ups and inventory valuation reviews

Vendor Management

  • Own vendor account reconciliations, statement reviews, and terms compliance
  • First line on anything billing-related with the supplier network
  • Track vendor performance: variance rates, pricing drift, chargeback recovery

Analysis

  • Blended and category-level gross margin tracking
  • SKU contribution, velocity, and markdown exposure across 1,300 SKUs
  • Vendor scorecards on cost, accuracy, and reliability
  • Ad hoc deep-dives for ownership: spend reviews, pricing scenarios, whatever needs answering that week

Requirements

Requirements

  • 3 to 6 years in accounting or accounting plus FP&A, with real inventory, AP, or cost accounting exposure. Apparel, CPG, or DTC ecommerce strongly preferred
  • Fluent in 3-way matching and comfortable pushing back on vendors when the numbers do not add up
  • Excel killer: pivots, lookups, and models built from scratch
  • You think in unit economics, not just journal entries
  • ERP experience such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, or similar. Shopify ecosystem familiarity is a plus
  • Self-directed and fast

Benefits

  • Work From Anywhere
  • Competitive salary paid in US$

what you’ll get

  • 35 days of holidays of your choosing including annual leave and public holidays

  • Ambitious and projects in growing markets.

who you are

  • Pragmatic Problem-Solver: You are driven by results, not by ego. You focus on effective execution, using the right tool for the job to solve the problem at hand.

interview process

jobs.excerpt: As the Events Manager, you make every Quorum event run well-executed, on budget, and fully staffed.
jobs.description:
As the Events Manager, you make every Quorum event run well-executed, on budget, and fully staffed. You own execution for our corporate and customer-facing events: trade shows, sponsored conferences, booths, VIP receptions, and customer events. Your work runs from the signed contract to the last lead in Salesforce.

You report to the Senior Manager of Events and Engagement, who sets the event calendar and strategy. You turn that plan into events that run without surprises. You work every day with Sales, the BDR team, Marketing Operations, and the Quorum executives who represent us onsite. The role comes with direct exposure to executives and a path for growth within the Events and Engagement team.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You own four things above all: logistics, budgets, staffing, and pre-event briefings.

  • Event logistics: Run each event from contract signing through teardown, including venues, booth builds, AV, catering, travel, hotels, registration, and shipping. Build the timeline and run-of-show, and confirm every item ships or arrives on time.

  • Event budgets: Build and track the budget for each event, from first quote to final invoice. Keep each event within its approved budget, flag overruns before they happen, and close out the books within 30 days.

  • Event staffing: Build the staffing plan for each event, including who attends from Sales, the BDR team, executives, and Product, and what each person does on-site.

  • Pre-event briefings: Own keeping everyone in the loop about the event goals and logistics. Cover the target accounts and customers attending, meetings booked, booth roles and shifts, talking points, and lead capture. Coach the team on how to be successful on site and how to follow up post-event.

  • Venues, vendors, and contracts: Source venues and negotiate contracts within the approved budget. Manage venues, agencies, contractors, and third-party organizers on a day-to-day basis. Confirm Quorum receives every sponsorship deliverable it paid for, from booth space to attendee lists.

  • Events as campaigns: Treat each event as one part of a campaign, not a one-off. Work with Marketing Operations and the BDR team so that pre-event outreach and post-event follow-up reach the same target accounts.

  • Lead follow-up: Work with the marketing operations team for routing and follow-up to drive pipeline development.

  • Post-event reporting: Report attendance, leads, pipeline, and ROI for each event. Run a retro with the team and write down what changes next time.

  • Event playbooks: Build a repeatable playbook for each event type, with checklists, timelines, vendor lists, and brief templates. Each event run should be better coordinated than the last.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • High-quality bar: Hold every detail to a high standard, from the booth and signage to the guest list and the follow-up email. Attendees should remember a Quorum event for the right reasons.

  • Interpersonal skills and proactive communication: Build strong working relationships with Sales, BDRs, executives, vendors, and venue staff. Speak up early: flag risks, send updates before anyone asks, and follow up until every open item is closed. When something needs doing, you do it without waiting to be told.

  • Audience & account-driven: Know which target accounts and customers will be at each event, and make sure the right Quorum people meet them.

  • AI user, with judgment: Use AI to speed up event busywork, from invite lists to follow-up drafts, and check everything it produces before it goes out.

  • Sets & hits goals: Own the operating goals for every event: on budget, staffed on time, briefs sent, and leads loaded fast. Use each event's results to decide which vendors, line items, and processes to keep, cut, or scale.

  • Team orchestrator: Know what to handle yourself, what to hand to vendors, contractors, or AI, and who to keep updated. Drive coordination across Sales, BDRs, executives, product, and Marketing Operations without waiting to be asked.

  • Velocity: Make fast, sound calls on-site when plans change. Bring what you learn into the next event's playbook, and keep up with new events and AI tools.

EXPERIENCE

  • 1–3 years running events, with direct ownership of logistics and budgets for trade shows, conferences, booths, and VIP events.

  • Experience working alongside sales teams at a B2B company. B2B software or Washington, DC association and public affairs events preferred.

  • Experience managing projects with day-to-day use of , Asana, or a similar tool to run event timelines and tasks.

COMPENSATION

  • On Target Earnings (OTE): $75,000-$90,000 per year (OTE is calculated based on bonus and salary.)

  • Base Salary: $70,000-$85,000 per year USD

  • This is a full-time role with up to 40 hours per week

We comply with all requirements for US government federal contractors issued by the OFCCP, IFR, and the terms of our government contracts.

EEO/AA/F/M/Vet/Disabled

We are currently hiring for this position in the following states: DC, FL, GA, IL, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NE, NJ, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VT, VA, WV.

At Quorum, we utilize modern talent acquisition tools, including our Applicant Tracking System, Ashby, to assist our recruiting team. We use AI-assisted features solely to help us search our database, sort information, personalize our email outreach, and support interview note-taking (candidates have the option to opt out). We do not use automated tools or algorithms to screen out, rank, or make final selection or rejection decisions regarding your application. All hiring decisions are made entirely by human recruiters and hiring managers.

jobs.title: Pediatrician - TX License
jobs.excerpt: Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD.
jobs.description:
Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. Nearly 10% of people in the US are diagnosed with ADHD, and for parents, it can feel impossible to find the right care. We are building a virtual pediatric ADHD clinic that delivers trusted care to all families. Our new clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and has the potential to deliver exceptional health outcomes to transform a child’s trajectory. In the future, our pediatric care platform will expand rapidly to other common chronic conditions like asthma, allergies, and obesity.

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer, Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

What makes this role unique:

Opportunity to join a multi-disciplinary clinical team dedicated to providing integrated care to patients and families. We aim to give our providers the tools they need to provide excellent care including collaboration with peers, guidance from ADHD experts and researchers, and opportunities to pursue ongoing professional development.

Contribute to the development of a better pediatric healthcare system for patients and providers. Our team is dedicated to setting clinicians up for success, and you’ll be encouraged to help us make improvements to our care models, workflows, and clinical tools in order to make your work easier and more enjoyable.

Focus on your strengths. We appreciate how different clinical backgrounds help us learn from each other and take better care of patients. We encourage our clinicians to develop special areas of interest and expertise to become leaders within the team. We provide ongoing training opportunities to gain new skills as well as stipends for additional learning and development.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide comprehensive clinical services for children and teens with ADHD and their families, with a focus on diagnostic and medication management.

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team that includes MD’s, nurse practitioners, psychologists and other clinicians to provide excellent care.

  • Complete administrative work and clinical documentation in a timely and accurate manner.

  • Contribute to implementation, evaluation and program development iteration to ensure optimal delivery of care.

  • This is a clinical position, but there may be opportunities to expand and grow into program development, and other leadership activities, depending on employee interest and company needs.

Qualifications:

  • Licensed to practice medicine in Texas

  • Board certified by the American Board of Pediatrics

  • Prescribing treatment plans including administering and managing ADHD stimulant medication

  • At least 5 years of patient care experience

  • Experience working with families from different cultural backgrounds and willingness to receive ongoing training and support in advancing your skills in delivering culturally responsive treatment

  • Interest or experience in Lifestyle Medicine. We emphasize evidence-based interventions that support children and families such as sleep hygiene, nutritional coaching and physical activity

  • Confidence in using an electronic medical record and telemedicine tools to deliver virtual care and support to families

  • Excitement about joining a startup and interest in learning new technologies and tools

Nice to have:

  • Licensed in additional states or open to obtaining additional licenses through support from Clarity Pediatrics Medical Group

  • Spanish-speaking

Job Type: Full-time (30+ hours) or Part-time (16+ hours); some evenings or weekend hours required

Location: Remote

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Pay: The target salary for this role will be $220,000-$245,000/year (full-time)

  • Competitive salary with medical and ancillary benefits, including 401(K)

  • Remote-friendly culture

  • Flexible time off

Schedule:

  • Monday through Friday (Pacific) 8am - 8pm PT, Saturdays 8am-2pm PT

Compensation Range: $220K - $245K

jobs.excerpt: Technology Director — Global Health ICF's Global Health and Development (GHD) line of business, part of the Health, People, and Human Services (HPHS) Group, is seeking a Technology Director to lead technology modernization efforts across various global health and survey programs.
jobs.description:
Technology Director — Global Health


ICF's Global Health and Development (GHD) line of business, part of the Health, People, and Human Services (HPHS) Group, is seeking a Technology Director to lead technology modernization efforts across various global health and survey programs. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will own delivery of the program's technology work from end to end. You will also serve as one of its technical leads and architects, designing systems yourself as well as directing the team that builds them. You will bridge ICF's applied AI and software engineers with its survey methodologists, statisticians, field operations staff, and country partners. You will be accountable to the funder for results, including the decision to redirect work that isn't performing and move the funding to work that is.


This position can be remote within the United States, with occasional international travel.


It is contingent upon award of program funding.


Key Responsibilities


Technology Modernization Delivery Leadership

  • Own delivery of the program's AI innovation portfolio. The workstreams cover automated data-to-report production, natural-language data access, multilingual questionnaire design, field data quality, and new measurement approaches.
  • Run the stage-gate process. Lead go/no-go reviews, and make and defend decisions to stop workstreams, publish what they learned, and reallocate their funding.
  • Serve as the principal technical counterpart to the funder. Lead progress reporting and learning reviews. Communicate results candidly, including negative ones.
  • Manage the innovation portfolio, schedule, and risks with the project manager, including inference and cloud operating costs.
  • Coordinate across global development programs. Share successes, failures, and methods with technology partners to avoid duplicating work.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Act as technical lead and architect for a cluster of workstreams. Own their system design, write the design documents, and stay hands-on through prototyping and production.
  • Define acceptance criteria before the work is judged. With survey experts, set the quantitative quality thresholds each tool must meet, and hold the team (and yourself) to them.
  • Set architecture and standards across the portfolio: model selection and routing, privacy-preserving design, offline and low-connectivity deployment, and security.
  • Set engineering practice for the team, including specification-driven development with agentic coding tools, evaluation-first delivery, code review, and testing.
  • Protect data quality and comparability. Work with survey methodologists so that no innovation breaks the comparability of data across countries and over time.
  • Oversee responsible AI, data governance, and ethics. Make sure the program meets ICF security standards, IRB requirements, and partner-country data sovereignty expectations.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and mentor the program's technology team, including applied AI, software, ML, and platform engineers.
  • Bridge technology and survey expertise. Make sure survey methodologists, statisticians, and field teams shape what gets built, and that engineers understand how surveys work.
  • Work with national statistical offices and ministries of health, together with ICF's country engagement leads, to design tools that countries want and can run on their own.
  • Share the program's results openly through public documentation, publications, and presentations at technical and global health conferences.
  • Contribute to business growth efforts including proactive engagement with potential clients, preparation of white papers, and proposal development.

Minimum Required Experience

  • Bachelors degree in IT, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum 10 years of professional experience designing and delivering technology solutions, including hands-on architecture of multiple complex systems taken into production
  • Minimum 5 years leading and mentoring software or data engineering teams to build products or deploy systems

Additional Required Skills and Experience

  • A track record of architecting and delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered systems in production, and the ability to explain how their quality was measured and where they failed
  • Experience leading a multi-workstream technology program for a foundation, donor, or government client, with accountability for budget and results
  • Deep knowledge of system architecture, data pipelines, software development methods, and at least one major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
  • Hands-on familiarity with agentic coding tools and specification-driven development, and experience setting how a team uses them
  • U.S. citizenship is required by federal government contract

Preferred Skills

  • Working proficiency in French or Portuguese
  • Background in survey operations or data collection, such as work on or with the Demographic & Health Surveys (DHS) Program, Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS), Living Standards Measurement Study (LSMS), a national census, or other population-based household surveys
  • Experience delivering technology for global health or international development programs in low- and middle-income countries
  • Experience with field data-collection systems for low-connectivity settings (e.g., e, c, ODK), or with offline or edge deployment
  • Experience working with national statistical offices or ministries of health
  • Experience leading a stage-gated R&D or innovation portfolio, including a decision to stop a workstream
  • Experience setting and being held to quantitative acceptance thresholds for an AI or data system
  • Experience with multi-country deployments where data cannot leave a jurisdiction, and with data privacy and governance for human data, including IRB processes
  • Experience with cybersecurity practices, security controls, and authorization processes
  • Publications or conference presentations in AI, survey methods, or global health
  • Advanced degree in computer science, statistics, demography, public health, or a related field

Professional Skills

  • Credible with both engineers and executives. Can lead a technical design review in the morning and brief a funder's leadership in the afternoon
  • Sound judgment under uncertainty. Can tell a workstream that is late from one that isn't going to work, and acts on it
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders, including survey experts and government partners
  • Strong presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for business, funder, and program audiences
  • Works productively and builds relationships at all levels and across cultures, from senior leadership to entry level
  • Self-motivated. Finds ways to add value without a lot of direct supervision

  • Leverage AI-powered tools to improve project management workflows, including requirements documentation, meeting summaries, backlog refinement, reporting, and project analysis.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to identify opportunities for AI-assisted delivery while maintaining appropriate quality, accuracy, security, and human oversight.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of SmartLogic's project management practices, delivery processes, and operational efficiency.

Requirements

We are seeking a resourceful, organized, and proactive team player with strong interpersonal skills and a demonstrated ability to lead software projects independently. The successful candidate will be comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Additionally, the successful candidate will have:

  • 5+ years of professional software project management experience, preferably within a custom software development consultancy or agency.
  • Demonstrated success managing six-figure software development projects with varying team sizes, technical complexity, and client requirements.
  • Strong understanding of agile software development methodologies and experience managing projects from discovery and planning through development, testing, and launch.

  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, documentation, communication, or project management workflows, with an understanding of their limitations and the importance of validating AI-generated outputs.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently in a remote, collaborative environment.

Benefits

This is a fully remote contract position open to candidates based in the United States.

Compensation range for this position is $70-$85 per hour. Compensation is based on the applicant's experience and qualifications.

This position has flexible weekly hours based on project needs and your availability, which is currently estimated at 10-25 per week. You must be available during SmartLogic's core working hours of 10:00 AM–3:30 PM ET on weekdays, as some client and internal meetings occur during this window and your attendance may be required.

As a remote-first organization, SmartLogic works intentionally to build a supportive, collaborative culture. Contractors are encouraged to participate in relevant team meetings, knowledge-sharing opportunities, and professional development activities.

We value continuous learning, thoughtful experimentation, and the responsible use of emerging technologies, including AI, to strengthen how we work and deliver value to our clients.
