jobs.excerpt: Our client is seeking a remote Senior AWS DevSecOps / Platform Engineer to help build, secure, and operate a mission-critical cloud platform supporting high-availability scientific and operational workloads.
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a remote Senior AWS DevSecOps / Platform Engineer to help build, secure, and operate a mission-critical cloud platform supporting high-availability scientific and operational workloads.

This is a remote position for a senior, hands-on engineer who is comfortable owning production AWS infrastructure from Infrastructure as Code through deployment, validation, monitoring, and ongoing operations.

The environment is built around AWS, Amazon EKS, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, and GitOps, with a strong emphasis on automation, security, reliability, and federal compliance. Infrastructure changes are managed through code and automated pipelines rather than manual configuration.

The ideal candidate has deep hands-on experience with Terraform and AWS, has operated Kubernetes/EKS in production, and understands how to build secure delivery pipelines that can withstand both operational scrutiny and formal security reviews.

This is an opportunity to join a small, experienced engineering team where senior engineers have meaningful ownership and influence over platform architecture, security, automation, and engineering standards.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, maintain, and improve production AWS infrastructure across multiple environments.

  • Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules and Infrastructure as Code used to provision and manage cloud infrastructure.

  • Manage Terraform remote state and safely reconcile differences between deployed infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Operate and maintain production Amazon EKS environments, including cluster networking, autoscaling, add-ons, upgrades, workload identity, ingress, and load balancing.

  • Design and support Kubernetes workloads using Helm and modern container orchestration practices.

  • Build and maintain GitOps-based deployment workflows using Argo CD, Flux, or comparable technologies.

  • Develop and harden GitLab CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure and application delivery.

  • Integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, Infrastructure as Code scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, policy enforcement, and artifact validation.

  • Implement policy-as-code technologies such as OPA, Conftest, or comparable tools.

  • Support container supply-chain security, including image scanning, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), image signing, and deployment validation.

  • Design and maintain secure AWS identity and access patterns using IAM and workload identity technologies such as IRSA or EKS Pod Identity.

  • Design and support AWS networking, including VPCs, routing, load balancing, security boundaries, and cross-account connectivity.

  • Work with AWS services including EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, and related cloud technologies.

  • Support the development and evolution of multi-account AWS environments and federal landing-zone architectures.

  • Implement least-privilege access, network isolation, continuous monitoring, security controls, and other cloud-hardening practices.

  • Support federal cybersecurity requirements including NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, RMF, and Authority to Operate activities.

  • Develop and maintain technical evidence and documentation supporting security controls and compliance reviews.

  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability using technologies such as Amazon CloudWatch, Grafana, or comparable platforms.

  • Troubleshoot complex AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, networking, pipeline, security, and production infrastructure issues.

  • Mentor other engineers and help establish strong engineering practices around code review, change management, automation, testing, and technical documentation.

  • Collaborate with application developers, security teams, architects, and other technical stakeholders to deliver secure and reliable production services.

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, or a related discipline, including senior-level ownership of production environments.

  • Deep hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, infrastructure lifecycle management, and remediation of configuration drift.

  • Strong hands-on AWS engineering experience supporting production workloads.

  • Experience with AWS networking, IAM, EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, and related cloud services.

  • Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes and Amazon EKS in production, not simply deploying applications to an existing cluster.

  • Experience with Kubernetes networking, autoscaling, workload identity, Helm, ingress, load balancing, and cluster lifecycle management.

  • Hands-on experience implementing GitOps using Argo CD, Flux, or a comparable platform.

  • Experience engineering CI/CD pipelines, with GitLab CI/CD strongly preferred.

  • Experience implementing DevSecOps controls such as SAST, container scanning, Infrastructure as Code scanning, secrets detection, or policy-as-code.

  • Strong experience with Git-based development and infrastructure workflows, including merge requests, peer review, and controlled production changes.

  • Experience supporting secure, highly available cloud infrastructure.

  • Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity frameworks such as FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and RMF, including familiarity with requirements supporting an Authority to Operate.

  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

  • Ability to mentor engineers and provide senior technical leadership.

  • U.S. Person with the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating multi-account AWS environments, AWS Organizations, Control Tower, or federal cloud landing zones.

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or FedRAMP environments.

  • Experience implementing container supply-chain security, including SBOMs, image signing, admission controls, or AWS Signer.

  • Experience with CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, or comparable observability technologies.

  • Experience with Docker and secure container build practices.

  • Experience with serverless AWS technologies such as Lambda.

  • Experience with real-time or event-driven data-processing architectures.

  • AWS certification such as Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Developer.

  • Experience supporting scientific, environmental, geospatial, weather, or other data-intensive mission systems.

  • Familiarity with scientific data formats such as NetCDF or GRIB.

Work Environment

  • This position is remote.

  • No routine on-site requirement is expected.

Security / Eligibility Requirements

  • U.S. Person.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.
  • Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.
  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.
  • Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.
  • High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.
  • Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

jobs.excerpt: The Lawyering Project is excited to launch our search for an experienced strategic planning partner to facilitate the development of our 2028-2033 strategic plan.
jobs.description:
The Lawyering Project is excited to launch our search for an experienced strategic planning partner to facilitate the development of our 2028-2033 strategic plan. This engagement will take place during February – July 2027 and the consultant will report to the Lawyering Project’s Executive Team.

Organizational Background

Founded in 2017, the Lawyering Project is a legal advocacy organization that blends traditional impact litigation with movement lawyering to promote reproductive health, rights, and justice throughout the United States. We have an all-remote staff that includes 24 full-time employees spread across the United States.

Laws that undermine reproductive health, rights, and justice deprive people of moral agency, rob us of control over our bodies, and compound other forms of oppression like racism, sexism, and poverty. Our mission is to eliminate these laws and the harmful impacts they have on people’s lives. We are especially focused on laws that limit the availability or affordability of abortion care; contribute to disparities in reproductive health outcomes; embody gender-based stereotypes; or discriminate against people based on their reproductive decisions.

We envision a society with laws that enable each of us to make decisions about intensely personal matters like sex, pregnancy, family, and healthcare based on our own beliefs and values, and ensure that we all have access to safe pregnancy care, safe abortion care, and safe communities for our families.

More information about the Lawyering Project is available on our website.

Project Background

Since its inception nearly a decade ago, the Lawyering Project has undergone significant growth in its staff size, programming, and overall organizational capacity, all while operating in a volatile political and legal landscape. We understand that, to realize our long-term vision for reproductive health, rights, and justice, we must continually assess our organizational strategy and impact. Energized by the organization’s growth, the exciting work being done by our clients and partners, and the growing need for legal services by those seeking, providing, and supporting abortion care, we are embarking on a strategic planning process to coincide with our tenth anniversary. Our goal for this process is to bring our creative, partner-driven approach to lawyering to bear on the challenges facing the repro movement nearly five years after the fall of Roe.

Project Scope of Work

  1. Design a process for the development of a five-year strategic plan that includes the following:
    • Robustly engaging with the Lawyering Project’s Board of Directors and staff;
    • Gathering input from key external stakeholders including clients, partners, and funders;
    • Evaluating the impact of the Lawyering Project’s current programs;
    • Assessing the strengths and weaknesses of the Lawyering Project's current operations; and
    • Providing the Lawyering Project’s Executive Team with periodic opportunities to review progress and offer feedback.
  2. Guide the Lawyering Project through the strategic planning process, taking the lead on meeting facilitation and data collection.
  3. Use the information and insights gathered to create a five-year strategic plan.
  4. Assist the Executive Team in creating metrics to assess progress under the strategic plan.

Requirements

Desired Consultant Expertise and Qualifications

  • Proven expertise in strategic planning for nonprofit organizations. Experience working with legal advocacy organizations is a plus.
  • Proven knowledge of the U.S. reproductive health, rights, and justice movement.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate group discussions and build alignment among stakeholders with differing perspectives.
  • Strong project management skills, especially the ability to complete deliverables on time and according to specifications.
  • Demonstrated commitment to JEDI (Justice, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion) and social justice.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills and readiness to work with a group of committed, talented, and enthusiastic individuals.

Budget

We are seeking bids of up to $40,000 for the entire project.

Submission Requirements

To apply, please submit the following materials by December 18, 2026:

  • A concise proposal detailing your approach to the project
  • An updated CV or resume
  • At least two client references from strategic planning projects
  • Any additional supporting materials that you would like us to consider

Our goal is to engage a consultant by January 31, 2027, and begin work on the project in early February.

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic

  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent

jobs.description:
YOUR MISSION

Nulogy is seeking an energetic, coachable, and curious individual to join our growing marketing team as a Business Development Representative. This role provides an exciting entry point into the world of sales and marketing within a leading software company. You'll gain hands-on experience in identifying potential leads, initiating early-stage outreach, and contributing to the success of demand generation campaigns. This position is ideal for someone early in their career who is eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support outbound outreach efforts through email, phone, and social media to identify and engage potential prospects.
  • Assist in researching target accounts, industry trends, and key decision-makers.
    Help qualify inbound leads from web inquiries, events, and campaigns.
  • Work with the BDR to prepare outreach materials and follow-up messages.
  • Support logistics and follow-ups for virtual and in-person events.
  • Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions and lead status in Salesforce.
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales to refine messaging and lead generation strategies.

EXPERIENCE & SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • 0–1 years of experience in a sales, marketing, or customer-facing role (internship or part-time experience welcome).
  • Familiarity with or interest in CRM and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated, with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
  • Interest in the SaaS, tech, supply chain, or logistics industries.
  • Comfortable making phone calls and engaging with new people.
  • Team-oriented and open to feedback.
  • Ability to multitask and manage time efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Nulogy is a manufacturing technology company driven by a vision to make life better for the people who plan, produce, and deliver the products we use every day.
Nulogy’s Manufacturing Operating System helps manufacturers and packagers automate every stage of the production process—from inventory to quality—which reduces operating costs, increases efficiency, and boosts customer satisfaction. Hundreds of manufacturing sites around the world are powered by Nulogy, and our software also runs in the networks of world-leading brands such as Colgate-Palmolive, L’Oréal, and Procter & Gamble.

Nulogy has grown rapidly over the last decade, and we are proud to be recognized with a number of awards including: Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers, Food Logistics Top 100 Software Provider, and Canada's Most Admired Corporate Culture. Nulogy has also received multiple awards for company culture, the most recent being one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for 2024, Great Place to Work 2025 & Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2025.

By joining Nulogy, you’ll become part of a fantastic culture of capable and motivated individuals. You’ll also join a team that is solving challenging problems every day with the potential to make a global impact.

OUR VALUES
1. We put people first
We lead with genuine care, build strong relationships, and create space for people to grow.
2. We rewrite the playbook
We don’t wait for perfect conditions. We move, deliver, and refine, solving problems creatively as we go.
3. We learn up
We stay curious, learn from the people and experiences around us, and keep looking ahead.
4. We take the hot potato!
When something goes wrong, we don’t pass the problem along. We take ownership and work together to solve it.
5. We ring the bell together
We celebrate success as a team and recognize the people who helped make it happen.

WHY NULOGY
We’re solving problems that no one has been able to solve before. This is an opportunity to join a team that is transforming the way that supply chains are structured.

Competitive benefits package: Group benefit plans including health, dental, and vision that start on day one—benefit premiums are fully paid by the employer; Parental leave: 100% top-up for 15 weeks for any parent of biological or adopted children; Flexible paid vacation policy; RRSP Matching Program, 401K program.


FULLY REMOTE
Everyone is set up with the tools and resources required to stay connected and help employees do their best work.

Nulogy embraces diversity, and we recognize the need for teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We encourage everyone to apply.

This engagement encompasses two major initiatives: improving our cloud and application security infrastructure and migrating business-critical legacy systems into AWS.

You'll work closely with our engineering and technology leadership teams, with significant autonomy to recommend solutions, make technical decisions, and implement improvements.

This is not a purely advisory or architectural role. We want an engineer who enjoys designing solutions, writing code, automating infrastructure, and delivering working systems.

Cloud & Application Security

AWS Infrastructure & Migration

  • Lead the technical migration of legacy production workloads into WorldVia-managed AWS environments.
  • Design secure, reliable, cost-effective AWS infrastructure supporting modern applications and traditional business systems.
  • Implement infrastructure as code, backup and recovery, monitoring, and operational automation.
  • Coordinate migration testing, validation, cutover, and stabilization with internal stakeholders.

DevOps & Platform Engineering

  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and environment management.
  • Integrate security scanning and automated safeguards into development workflows.
  • Establish practical infrastructure standards and reusable deployment patterns.
  • Support cloud infrastructure needs for applications incorporating generative AI and agentic workflows.
  • Document architecture, operating procedures, and technical decisions so our internal team can maintain and evolve the environment.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or related disciplines.
  • Strong AWS expertise, including networking, compute, databases, IAM, security, monitoring, and infrastructure architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience migrating production workloads from legacy or third-party environments into AWS, preferably including Windows-based applications.
  • Practical experience implementing application and cloud security controls.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform or AWS CDK.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD systems, automated security scanning, and deployment automation.
  • Strong understanding of backup, disaster recovery, production monitoring, and incident response.
  • Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and collaborate with a small, fast-moving engineering team.

Especially Valuable, Preferred:

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, or other AI infrastructure.
  • Secure development practices involving AI coding tools.
  • Financial application or legacy enterprise system migrations.
  • PCI DSS or SOC 2 readiness experience.
  • Experience balancing security, reliability, infrastructure costs, and rapid product delivery.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

We're a product-driven company making a substantial investment in technology. Our engineering team is small, entrepreneurial, and actively embracing AI-assisted development.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Own meaningful technical initiatives from design through production.
  • Work directly with decision-makers with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Influence the architecture and operational foundations of a growing technology platform.
  • Build automated systems and guardrails that make engineers more productive.
  • Potentially grow into a permanent role as our technology organization expands.

We value practical problem-solvers who favor thoughtful, maintainable solutions over unnecessary complexity.

What Success Looks Like

At the end of the initial engagement, we expect to have materially improved our security posture, modernized important AWS infrastructure, advanced or completed our priority migrations, and established more consistent and efficient deployment and operating practices.

Just as importantly, the systems and processes you build should be well-documented, maintainable, and ready for our internal team to operate.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief description of one or two relevant projects you've personally led, particularly involving AWS migration, cloud security, or DevOps automation.

We're especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate hands-on ownership of complex production environments and sound engineering judgment.

About WorldVia

WorldVia Travel Group is a growing travel technology and services company serving thousands of independent travel advisors, travel entrepreneurs, and corporate travel clients.

We're investing heavily in our next generation of technology, including an integrated advisor operating platform, consumer travel applications, and AIVIA, our AI-powered workspace.

Our technology strategy centers on AWS, modern software development, automation, and AI. We're building a platform designed to transform how travel professionals operate their businesses.

jobs.title: Outsourced Tier-1 IT Help Desk Services — Microsoft 365 & RMM
jobs.excerpt: Request for qualifications from IT services firms and independent IT businesses.
jobs.description:
Request for qualifications from IT services firms and independent IT businesses.

About goCloudOffice®

goCloudOffice® is a modern, AI-driven IT consulting company. Founded in 2003 and based in Silicon Valley, we serve customers nationwide across the United States. Our customers are small businesses of 5 to 50 people, in industries that include biotechnology, law and professional services. They own their business applications, and we run their IT with senior engineering judgment and AI-augmented support that has been in daily production since summer 2024.

The engagement

Request for qualifications: first-line IT support services (remote) for goCloudOffice®'s Helpdesk customers — Tier-1 end-user support, RMM operations tasks and Tier-1 administration at goCloudOffice®'s Tier-1 service level. Budgeted rate USD 65 per hour; providers propose coverage windows, a block fee and terms.

goCloudOffice® welcomes responses from IT services firms, including helpdesk firms whose own W-2 personnel provide first-line support, and from independent IT practitioners who operate an established business.

This is a business-to-business engagement under a master services agreement and a statement of work between goCloudOffice® and your business, which invoices for the services it delivers.

Engagement contact: the goCloudOffice® account lead. The provider directs its own work and personnel.

Scope of services

The services are first-line IT support at goCloudOffice®'s Tier-1 service level: requests that follow a clear, documented runbook, delivered remotely, with anything beyond a runbook handed off to goCloudOffice®'s senior providers.

  • Tier-1 end-user support. Remote help for business users through the Helpdesk ticketing system: Windows 10 and 11 and macOS troubleshooting; Microsoft 365 apps such as Outlook, Teams and OneDrive; printers and peripherals; Microsoft 365 and authenticator apps on users' phones; and the Tier-1 steps of user onboarding and offboarding.
  • RMM operations. RMM operations deliverables in goCloudOffice®'s NinjaOne environment (patch-policy roll-outs, scripted remediations, alert triage) under named, scoped access.
  • Tier-1 administration. In each customer's Microsoft 365 tenant: user additions and changes, password resets and multi-factor re-registration after identity verification, and group, distribution-list and license changes, each under the customer's change rules and a documented runbook.
  • Escalation.Security events, tenant-wide settings, new policies and scripts, network changes and multi-system work are handed off to goCloudOffice®'s senior providers, with a hand-off note that records what was seen, what was tried and what the user was told.
  • Documentation.Clear ticket notes, knowledge-base articles and runbook updates, so every customer stays easy to support.
  • AI-assisted delivery. AI tools used as a daily part of the work, including AI-assisted troubleshooting, knowledge-base drafting and ticket summarization, with every output verified before it reaches a customer or a customer system.

First-line tickets are triaged by the Helpdesk's AI assistant; the provider handles the tickets it accepts under the statement of work and hands off to goCloudOffice®'s senior providers on escalation.

Services must meet each customer's security, access and confidentiality policies and the service levels in the statement of work.

The provider uses its own equipment and business identity; goCloudOffice® grants only the proprietary system access the services require.

The provider presents under its own business name on every surface a customer sees: a Helpdesk alias of the form "[Name] — [Business]", public replies signed "Thanks, [Name], [Business] — for the Helpdesk", and RMM and customer-tenant accounts labelled with the business.

The services are delivered remotely, and providers in any US state may respond. On-site work at customer premises is arranged separately and sits outside this scope.

What your business brings (required qualifications)

1. An independently established IT services business. Your business:

  • operates under its own business name, including in the ticketing and management systems it works in;
  • regularly contracts with other businesses and advertises its services to the public;
  • holds the business licenses and registrations its work requires (for example, in its home city and state);
  • carries general liability insurance (USD 1M per occurrence, USD 2M aggregate), technology errors-and-omissions and network security and privacy liability insurance (USD 1M per claim) with breach-response cover, and workers' compensation where the business has W-2 personnel;
  • provides its own equipment.

Preferred structure:A corporation, or an LLC taxed as an S-corporation, whose own W-2 personnel perform the services is preferred; helpdesk firms that staff first-line support this way are welcome. Sole proprietorships and single-member LLCs are also considered.

2. Typically three or more years of hands-on Tier-1 and Tier-2 IT support experience for business users across Windows, macOS and Microsoft 365.

3. Remote Tier-1 troubleshooting: Windows 10 and 11, macOS, Microsoft 365 apps, printers and peripherals, and Microsoft 365 and authenticator apps on users' phones, resolved through tickets and remote sessions.

4. Microsoft 365 Tier-1 administration: user additions and changes, password resets and multi-factor re-registration, and group, distribution-list and license changes, carried out from documented runbooks, with identity verification before every account change.

5. RMM operations:hands-on delivery of RMM operations tasks on a remote monitoring and management platform (patch-policy roll-outs, scripted remediations and alert triage), with every action documented in the ticket.

6. AI-assisted service delivery. Providers should demonstrate at least one year of AI-assisted service delivery in their practice (for example, AI-assisted troubleshooting, knowledge-base drafting or ticket summarization). We look for:

  • Tools:any mainstream assistant, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or GitHub Copilot.
  • A clear method for checking AI output: confirming answers against vendor documentation such as Microsoft Learn or Apple Support, trying a fix on one device before wider use, reading every line of a script before running it, checking every AI-drafted reply for accuracy before a customer sees it, and keeping customer data inside tools approved for it.
  • Experience with AI-triaged ticket queues: reading an AI assistant's triage critically before acting on it.

7. Security judgment:identity verification before any account or device change, immediate escalation of security events such as a phishing report or an unusual sign-in, and careful handling of credentials, recovery keys and customer data.

8. Clear written communication with end users: patient, plain-language replies, accurate ticket notes, and hand-offs complete enough for the next engineer to continue from the last step.

9. Remote service capability: able to deliver the services remotely from any US state (customer data is handled under the customer's terms and within the United States), within the coverage windows the provider proposes and commits to, and at the service levels in the statement of work.

Where a qualification names years, equivalent depth gained in fewer years counts; tell us how.

Also valuable (preferred qualifications)

  • A.Hands-on NinjaOne experience: device management, patch management, alerts and conditions, the script library and remote access.
  • B.Relevant certifications, such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (exam MD-102) or Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals (exam MS-900).
  • C.Experience with a Zendesk-class ticketing desk: views, macros, internal notes and service-level targets.
  • D.More than one qualified person in your business who can perform the services, for coverage continuity.

Rate, fee and term

  • Budgeted rate: USD 65 per hour. Providers propose their own rates and commercial terms.
  • Fee structure: a fixed fee per coverage block, sized from the budgeted rate, plus hourly or per-ticket overage for work outside the block, itemized on the provider's invoice.
  • Coverage:Customer demand is concentrated in US Pacific business hours; providers propose the coverage windows they will commit to.
  • Service levels: acknowledgment and first-response targets, measured over each month and set in the statement of work.
  • Volume:the coverage windows the provider proposes set the volume; scope may expand by statement of work.
  • Term:a 12-month statement of work, renewable.

How to respond

Submit your business's qualifications: a capability statement, résumés of the personnel who would perform the services, and answers to the response questions. The questions cover business details, licenses and insurance in force, who performs the services, current clients (count and industries, including those your business serves remotely; no names), equipment, the ticketing and RMM platforms your personnel use for other clients, the coverage windows you offer, your proposed fee and terms, and one example of AI-assisted service delivery. Please send résumés without photographs, dates of birth, government identification numbers or home addresses, and share the notice below with the personnel whose résumés you submit. The qualification process is clear and quick:

1. A review of your response against the posted qualifications.
2. A 25-minute introductory qualification call about how your business runs.
3. A technical qualification call with live Tier-1 scenarios and a practical AI exercise, using the AI assistant of your choice or one we provide.
4. A walk-through of the Helpdesk workflow, using sample tickets.

5. Two references from current clients.

6. A final decision by goCloudOffice®'s founder.

Every respondent receives an answer. Reasonable accommodations and other adjustments to any step are available on request; the notice below explains how to reach us.

AI-assistance and privacy notice

This notice covers the businesses that respond to this request for qualifications and the personnel they name. goCloudOffice, Inc. may use AI-assisted tools — Manatal, the platform that hosts our request page, and AI models from Anthropic — to organize and summarize responses against the qualifications posted here and to draft our replies. People, not tools, make every selection decision, and a person reads every response before any decision is made. We keep response records for four years and never sell or share them. You may decline AI assistance, ask for human re-review of any step, or request an accommodation for a qualification call through our contact form at ; doing so will not affect how we evaluate your response. Our full privacy notice for respondents, including California privacy rights, is at .

Equal opportunity

goCloudOffice® selects providers on the posted qualifications alone. It welcomes responses from every qualified business, and considers them without regard to the race, color, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or reproductive health decision-making of the business's owners or personnel, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Work Location: Rushdown Studios is based in Saratoga Springs, NY and we have a strong preference for local candidates willing to work from our office on a hybrid basis (i.e., Tuesday-Thursday) or fully remote candidates in the Eastern United States. However, we're always open to expanding our list of remote-eligible states for the right candidate, as well.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure for game development and live-service games using one or more cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Deploy infrastructure-as-code for cloud resources using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, Azure Bicep, or Azure Resource Manager templates.
  • Promote cloud security best practices and compliance requirements for gaming infrastructure.
  • Design and develop CI/CD pipelines for builds and deployments.
  • Respond to live support issues for a live-service game.
  • Empower multiple teams through development environment automation.

  • Four (4) years of professional experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience scripting with languages like Python, PowerShell, or Groovy.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Understanding of game packaging and deployment requirements for different platforms.
  • Experience compiling code and/or managing pipelines that compile code.
  • Experience monitoring and profiling applications (DataDog, CloudWatch, Prometheus)
  • Ability to debug unexpected issues that arise during development.
  • Willingness to selflessly put player experiences first before even your own code and ego.
  • Proactive approach to communication, particularly when it comes to unblocking yourself and navigating obstacles as part of a team.

  • Knowledge of game development workflows and asset management.
  • Experience with the Go programming language.
  • Experience running multi-cloud applications.
  • Previous work using version control for game development (e.g., Perforce, Git LFS).

Benefits:

  • Annual Video Game Budget
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan

About Current AI

Current AI
is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale. Launched at the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025, the organisation has already raised hundreds of millions through partnerships with the French government, AI Collaborative, and other leading governments, philanthropic, and industry partners.

If AI is the transformative revolution we perceive it to be, it needs to serve the public interest today and tomorrow. At Current AI, our goal is to help build a collaborative, collective, and global vision for AI, not one governed by a specific country or a company.

Today, there are builders and researchers around the world developing public interest AI building blocks (datasets, models, compute, audits and applications), but efforts are not always co-ordinated or additive. To have a genuine shot at being an alternative, we must harness the full breadth of work happening across open source and public interest AI. That means leveraging government influence and resources, philanthropic funding, and private sector expertise and scale towards building the alternative.

Role Overview

Our main product umbrella at Current AI is AI Potluck:, an open source project to build a vertically integrated and easy to use AI product assembled entirely out of open source components and built collaboratively with the open source ecosystem.

As VP Product and reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the overall product strategy and product management organization for Current AI. You will own AI Potluck end to end: Alpha, our open source alternative to the closed AI assistants most people use today, the Gap Map, our insights product that shows the open source ecosystem where attention is needed, and the products that come after. You will partner with the Head of engineering and executive leadership to translate vision into scalable roadmaps and PRDs, running the product lifecycle from inception to launch. The goal is movement building through product, so the technology is the means and the measure is whether people and organizations adopt what we ship and contribute back to it. You will define what makes AI Potluck unique and why people should join the movement.

What you will be working on

AI Potluck has three parts today, and you will own all of them:

  • Alpha, at , an assistant assembled entirely from open source components, launched in July 2026 at AI for Good in Geneva and in open testing since.
  • The Gap Map, at , which shows where the open source AI ecosystem has gaps and where funding and contribution should go.
  • The Alpha Public Router, a single endpoint serving models from public and mission aligned suppliers. It powers Alpha today and becomes a product for developers next.

Your first six months

  • Take Alpha from testing to real everyday use inside a small number of partner organisations.
  • Decide what the Public Router becomes as a product, and what we ask developers to do with it.
  • Set the 2027 roadmap with partners and grantees.
  • Increase our partners’ contributions on Alpha

How we will measure success

  • Products shipped on the dates we announce publicly.
  • Organisations actively using Alpha and the Router, not only registered.
  • Open source projects integrated into the stack, and contributions we send back to them.
  • Partners who move from a conversation to a shipped integration.
  • A roadmap that partners can read without needing a meeting to understand it.

What you’ll do

The VP Product will be responsible for the following:

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Lead the overall product vision and strategy, translating organizational mission into compelling product designs while prioritizing interoperability and completeness of the broader ecosystem stack over in-house build.
  • Own the global product roadmap, bringing technical options, trade-offs, and strategic recommendations directly to the CEO and Board before roadmaps are finalized.
  • Set the product policies, including the content policy for our products, the criteria for the models and suppliers we serve, and how we measure quality in each language.
  • Drive the full product lifecycle, including PRD development, user story creation, and managing the roadmap from inception to launch.
  • Structure work streams and maintain documentation for the roadmap, the release notes and partner communications, in line with company-wide guidelines on workspace tool.
  • Drive high-impact product / feature launches ensuring they are delivered on time and effectively communicated to the ecosystem.
  • Run the Product Sprint process, including the backlog, sprint planning & Weekly update, being ready to do some hands-on building when needed

Internal & External Alignment

  • Work closely with the Engineering team to translate technical platform capabilities into tangible product features.
  • Align internal engineering teams and external partners around a common product roadmap, working with leaders of funding projects, partner institutions and internal teams to facilitate collaboration and ensure that individual initiatives contribute to broader ecosystem products.
  • Partner with leadership to identify and engage the right partners, ensuring external contributions (developers, organizations) are additive.
  • Federate around the mission of Current AI, engaging with partners, grantees and the broader technical community to advance the ecosystem strategy and position Current AI as a trusted product coordination hub.

Team & Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and empower product team and engineering leadership, directly overseeing the Head of Engineering and product teams to foster a high-performing, accountable builder culture.
  • Plan resourcing and hiring collaboratively, proposing product and engineering resource plans and budgets for regular review with executive leadership.

Exploratory & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate with the Engineering Team and the CEO and broader leadership to identify and incubate new projects, prototypes, or product lines that address critical gaps in the public-interest AI stack.
  • Engage with partners, grantees, and the community to advance the product strategy and position Current AI as a trusted hub for public-interest AI.

Balancing AI-assisted development and human judgment

  • Set the vision for how we use AI coding tools while also keeping the most critical aspects of product human.
  • Help the engineering team decide what we're building and for whom from first principles. Architecture is hard to reverse, and anything requiring quality, security or human judgment has to be designed that way.

What we’re looking for

Essential Qualifications

  • 12-15+ years of experience in product leadership roles, including AI systems and managing cross-functional product and engineering organizations
  • Experience designing and driving complex technical product roadmaps across distributed teams
  • Collaborative and cross-functional working style; experienced in partnering with Engineering and Programme teams to surface and amplify impact.
  • Strategic thinker about product ecosystems and platforms
  • Builder mindset with a bias toward experimentation and shipping
  • Fluent English with strong public speaking skills and capacity to adapt written communication for different audiences
  • Executive maturity: proactive communicator to the CEO, skilled in executive coordination, and comfortable navigating complex public-private stakeholder environments
  • Hands-on knowledge of LLM systems (evaluation, serving, safety)

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in open-source ecosystems, research-product organizations or public-interest technology initiatives
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute product strategies that shift narrative and build movements
  • French proficiency is a strong plus
  • Experience in international organisations, foundations, or global advocacy movements.

Character traits

We’re looking for people who:

  1. Put the mission before personal credit and work well in low-ego, highly collaborative teams
  2. Exercise good judgment and integrity, including knowing when to push back or say no
  3. Enjoy building from scratch and making progress with imperfect information
  4. Have a bias to action, shipping useful things and helping others do the same
  5. Are comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution as needed
  6. Work effectively across cultures, time zones, and disciplines
  7. Believe AI can serve the public interest - and are willing to do the practical, unglamorous work to make that true.

Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.
  • Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.
  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.
  • Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.
  • High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.
  • Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Core Responsibilities

  • Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

  • Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

  • Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

  • Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

  • Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

  • Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go.

  • Data & APIs: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, gRPC/Protobuf contract design, and schema evolution.

  • Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.

  • Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).

  • DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).

  • High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.

  • Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).

About the role

Rubrik Professional Services is hiring a Global Solutions Architect to serve as our most senior technical authority for public cloud. This is a global, individual-contributor role at Technical Director level. You will set the architectural direction for how Rubrik is designed, deployed, and operated in the world’s most demanding cloud environments — and you will carry that direction personally into our most strategic customer engagements.

You will be deployed where technical risk is highest: flagship accounts, first-of-a-kind architectures, and the engagements whose outcome sets the pattern everyone else follows. Between those engagements, you will convert what you learned into the reference architectures, service offerings, and enablement that raise the capability of every architect and consultant in the field. Your impact is measured by the quality of the practice you leave behind, not the hours you personally bill.

We are looking for depth in public cloud architecture first. Deep Rubrik product expertise is expected to be built on the job. If you have architected large-scale data, storage, or security platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and you can learn a new platform quickly and completely, we want to talk.

Set technical direction

Lead the hardest engagements

Serve as trusted advisor to customer CIO, CTO, Chief Architect, and CISO stakeholders, and defend design decisions in front of customer architecture review boards

Scale yourself through the practice

Influence the product

  • Act as the field’s most credible voice into Product Management and Engineering, backed by evidence from our largest deployments
  • Shape roadmap priorities, supportability, and cloud-native feature direction
  • Partner with Support and Customer Success on systemic technical issues before they become patterns
  • Work with PS Operations and leadership to turn field learning into better scoping models, estimates, and delivery methodology

What you bring

  • 15+ years overall experience, including 8+ years as a hands-on cloud architect at enterprise scale
  • Demonstrated ownership of architecture for multi-region, multi-account or multi-subscription cloud estates, in a large enterprise or a consulting / professional services organization
  • Expert-level AWS and Azure; GCP strongly preferred. Genuine depth across compute, storage, networking, identity, and encryption / key management
  • Deep understanding of enterprise data protection and cyber resilience — RTO and RPO modelling, immutability, backup and recovery design, isolated and air-gapped recovery
  • Working fluency in cloud security and compliance frameworks and how they constrain design in regulated industries
  • Strong automation background — infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep), scripting (Python, PowerShell), API-first integration, and CI/CD (Strong Automation Background)
  • A track record of influence without authority across a global, matrixed organization and multiple time zones
  • Executive-grade communication — credible with a customer’s CIO and their principal engineer on the same day
  • Evidence of building reusable technical IP, not only delivering successful projects
  • The ability to learn a complex new platform to expert depth, quickly. Prior Rubrik experience is not required
  • Occasional travel

Nice to have

  • Kubernetes and containerized workload architecture; cloud-native and managed database platforms
  • SaaS data protection experience (Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and similar)
  • Prior Principal, Distinguished, or Technical Director title within a vendor professional services organization or a major systems integrator
  • Professional or expert-level certifications (AWS Solutions Architect – Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent)
  • An established public technical presence — talks, writing, open source, or community leadership

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: Rubrik platform depth established, current cloud reference architectures assessed, and the top three gaps in our cloud delivery capability identified and evidenced
  • First 6 months: Leading architecture on at least two strategic global engagements; first published reference architecture or accelerator in field use
  • First 12 months: Recognized as the escalation point for cloud architecture across all theatres; measurable improvement in scoping accuracy and delivery consistency on cloud engagements; a named group of architects visibly stronger for your mentorship

About the Role

Xsolla is looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to help bring greater clarity, coordination, and operational discipline across our product development teams.

This role sits at the center of product execution, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, and other Delivery Managers to ensure teams are aligned on priorities, dependencies, timelines, and changes.

The Senior Delivery Manager will own the operating rhythm of the team: maintaining the backlog and roadmap, running engineering ceremonies, surfacing risks and blockers, and ensuring that changes are communicated clearly—not just what is changing, but why.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, this person will also play an important role in identifying broader operational challenges and working with leadership to improve how the team plans, communicates, prioritizes, and executes.

Key Responsibilities

    Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment across initiatives.

  • Maintain visibility into dependencies, timelines, priorities, and risks across teams.

  • Proactively identify areas where teams are becoming misaligned and drive the conversations necessary to resolve them.

  • Ensure stakeholders understand both what the team is doing and how individual activities connect to broader product and business priorities.

    • Team Execution & Scrum

  • Run and facilitate engineering scrum ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives, and other working sessions as needed.

  • Ensure teams leave meetings with clear decisions, owners, and next steps.

  • Track blockers and risks through resolution rather than simply documenting them.

  • Identify dependencies, sequencing challenges, and resource conflicts before they become delivery issues.

  • Encourage accountability across teams and help ensure problems are driven toward resolution rather than passed between functions.

What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means teams have greater clarity and predictability in how they operate.

    The right candidate will help create an environment where:

  • Teams understand what the highest priorities are and why.

  • Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Marketing remain aligned as plans evolve.

  • Risks and dependencies are surfaced early rather than discovered late.

  • Able to distinguish between isolated execution problems and broader systemic challenges.
