About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We're looking for a Senior MarTech Manager to set the technology and operational strategy behind our marketing programs. This person will define how marketing strategy, data, systems, and execution connect, ensuring our tools work together, data is trustworthy, and teams can scale their use of technology to acquire, engage, and retain customers.

The ideal candidate operates at both altitudes: setting a multi-year MarTech strategy and architecture direction, while staying close enough to the stack to make sound build-vs-buy and integration calls. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence over cross-functional priorities, vendor spend, and technical direction, partnering closely with Marketing, Data, Product, and Engineering leadership.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Set strategy and own architecture decisions for the MarTech stack, including build-vs-buy calls and vendor relationships.
  • Define and drive a multi-year roadmap for marketing technology, automation, analytics, and personalization.
  • Direct the platform strategy for CRM, marketing automation, CDP, analytics, attribution, experimentation, and customer engagement tools.
  • Architect data flows between marketing systems, product systems, CRM, and the data warehouse, and set the standards other teams build against.
  • Establish and enforce governance standards for tracking, campaign setup, lifecycle management, and data quality across the org.
  • Partner with Marketing, Growth, Data, Product and Engineering leadership (Director/VP level) to translate business strategy into scalable technical solutions.
  • Identify and lead automation initiatives that materially reduce manual campaign operations.
  • Own the technical foundation for segmentation, lifecycle marketing, personalization, and reporting.
  • Lead vendor evaluation, selection, and contract negotiation; own implementation and adoption outcomes.
  • Build documentation, governance frameworks, and processes that make the MarTech ecosystem scalable and auditable.
  • Monitor system performance, data quality, and operational risk, and escalate/resolve complex issues before they become team-wide blockers.
  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to marketing ops or MarTech staff, even without formal reporting lines.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8-12 years of experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, growth operations, or a related field, with a track record of owning strategy, not just execution.
  • Demonstrated experience setting technical direction and influencing decisions at the Director/VP level.
  • Deep expertise across CRM, marketing automation, customer data platforms, analytics, and integrations.

  • Track record managing cross-functional projects, external vendors, and budget/spend decisions.
  • Executive-level communication skills, able to translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical leadership.
  • Comfortable setting direction in ambiguity, without waiting for complete information.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience building or modernizing a MarTech stack from the ground up, ideally at more than one company.
  • Experience in healthcare, consumer technology, subscription, or other data-rich, regulated environments.
  • Deep expertise in experimentation, attribution, lifecycle marketing, or personalization strategy.
  • Strong grasp of privacy, consent, and data governance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA if healthcare).

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize

  • We now offer the Prenuvo’s Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we’ve got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable!

MGID is a global advertising technology company and pioneer in native advertising, operating a programmatic platform that connects advertisers and publishers across 200+ countries. MGID is seeking a Strategy Manager to help define and execute the company’s multi-year strategic direction, with a strong focus on shifting from a product-led to a customer-value-led mindset, evaluating strategic product and investment opportunities, and cascading strategy into prioritized, cross-functional initiatives.

This role sits within a fast-moving, data-driven ad-tech environment and reports to the COO.

Role Purpose

The Strategy Manager will act as a key strategic partner to the COO and leadership team, responsible for shaping MGID’s medium- to long-term strategy, evaluating strategic options for products and markets, and ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into concrete, prioritized projects with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

Requirements

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of experience in strategy, corporate development, or related roles within international tech scale-ups or high-growth environments; ad-tech or programmatic advertising experience is a strong plus.

  • Proven track record in a top-tier consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Big Four strategy practices) or equivalent strategic role in a tech company.

  • Hands-on experience preparing and presenting successful strategic cases with visible internal impact, such as new market entry, product portfolio optimization, or major investment decisions.

  • Strong financial modeling skills, including practical experience with valuation methods such as DCF, NPV, and IRR, and the ability to build and maintain investment models in Excel.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, commercial, data/BI, and operations leaders in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills; able to influence senior audiences and drive alignment across geographies.

  • Self-starter mindset: ready to operate as an individual contributor who can both design strategy and execute hands-on.

What You’ll Do:

Corporate & Product Strategy

  • Lead the identification and articulation of MGID’s overall strategy and strategic direction for the next 3–5 years, aligning with business focus and growth trajectory.

  • Evaluate strategic perspectives for specific products and portfolios, assessing market exposure, competitive dynamics, and growth potential.

  • Support the shift from a product-led to a customer-value-led company by embedding customer-centric frameworks into strategic planning, prioritization, and roadmap decisions.

Investment & Business Evaluation

  • Lead evaluations of stand-alone investment opportunities, including new products, markets, partnerships, and M&A, and prepare robust business cases with clear financial impact assessments.

Strategic Analysis & Advisory

  • Conduct market, competitor, and customer analysis to inform strategic choices and identify opportunities and risks.

  • Present strategic recommendations and status updates to senior leadership, influencing decision-making with clear, evidence-based insights.

jobs.excerpt: This is not a traditional business development role focused solely on generating and closing opportunities.
jobs.description:
This is not a traditional business development role focused solely on generating and closing opportunities.

We are looking for someone with 5–10 years of experience in the renewable energy industry who combines strong commercial acumen with a solid understanding of the technical and operational realities of managing renewable energy assets.

You will act as the bridge between the UK market and Streem's pan-European product and commercial strategy.

Your role will be to understand how UK renewable energy players operate, identify where their challenges intersect with Streem's capabilities, and help us adapt and localise our value proposition accordingly. You will then translate that understanding into commercial opportunities and long-term customer relationships.

Working closely with Sales, Product and Streem's leadership team, you will play a central role in defining how Streem enters, positions itself and grows in the UK market.

This is a high-impact role suited to someone who enjoys combining market strategy, customer engagement, technical problem-solving and commercial execution.

In this role, you will:

  • Map and develop a deep understanding of the UK renewable energy ecosystem, identifying the key players across IPPs, operators, asset managers, fund managers and investors, understanding how they operate and interact with one another, and mapping the relevant stakeholders within these organisations. This includes developing a detailed understanding of how prospective customers manage their renewable portfolios, commercial contracts, revenues, invoicing, reporting, data and operational workflows.

  • Build Streem's market knowledge, network and early customer relationships, developing relationships with key stakeholders across the UK renewable energy ecosystem and leading consultative discovery with prospective customers. You will identify their commercial, technical and operational challenges, understand where existing solutions fall short, and translate these insights into relevant Streem use cases and commercial opportunities.

  • Shape and localise Streem's product and value proposition for the UK, working closely with Product to translate market requirements and customer feedback into actionable insights. You will help distinguish individual customer requests from broader market needs, identify gaps and opportunities in Streem's existing offering, and contribute to decisions around localisation, integrations, workflows and capabilities required to succeed in the UK.

  • Build and develop Streem's UK commercial pipeline, initially identifying and working closely with early adopters and beta-friendly customers to validate our proposition and develop strong UK reference cases. Working closely with the Head of Sales, you will progressively turn these early relationships into strategic commercial opportunities and help establish a robust, repeatable medium-term go-to-market approach for the UK.

  • Establish Streem within the wider UK renewable energy ecosystem, representing the company at industry events, conferences, customer meetings and relevant forums, while developing strategic partnerships with technology providers, consultants, service providers and other industry participants that can strengthen Streem's proposition and accelerate our UK market development.

Must-have:

  • 5–10 years of experience in the renewable energy or wider energy industry, with knowledge of the UK market and its ecosystem.

  • Good understanding of renewable energy commercial and operational processes, with exposure to some areas such as asset management, PPAs and route-to-market structures, energy trading, revenue management, metering and energy data, invoicing, portfolio reporting or financial processes.

  • Strong commercial acumen and business development experience, with the ability to identify and develop strategic accounts, build relationships with senior decision-makers, navigate complex B2B buying processes and contribute to proposals and commercial negotiations.

  • A consultative and analytical approach to customers, with the ability to understand how a renewable energy business operates, identify underlying operational and commercial challenges, and translate them into compelling business cases and technology-driven value propositions.

  • Strong technical curiosity and understanding of technology, with the ability to quickly grasp SaaS products, energy software, data flows, integrations and APIs. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable bridging the gap between technical, operational and commercial stakeholders.

  • An entrepreneurial and autonomous mindset, comfortable building a market where the playbook is still being defined, balancing short-term opportunities with long-term market development, and working collaboratively across Product, Commercial and Leadership teams in an international environment.

You do not need to be an expert in every aspect of the renewable energy value chain. What matters is your ability to understand complex energy workflows, connect them to technology and translate that understanding into tangible customer and commercial value.

Disclaimer:

Don't meet every single requirement but believe your experience gives you the ability to understand the UK renewable energy market and build something from the ground up? We encourage you to apply.

Streem Energy offers ...

  • A dynamic entrepreneurial environment.

  • A senior role with significant autonomy and direct influence on Streem's UK strategy.

  • The opportunity to help build a new market rather than inherit an established commercial playbook.

  • An international team with colleagues from many different nationalities.

  • Exposure to multiple European renewable energy markets.

  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of renewable energy, technology and commercial strategy in one of Europe's fastest-growing industries.

Perks & Benefits

At Streem, we believe our employees should be fairly rewarded, share in the company’s success, and enjoy an open, flexible work environment that adapts to their individual needs.

In practice, this includes:

  • Flexible remote working to accommodate your schedule and personal requirements.

  • State-of-the-art tools and equipment, tailored to your working style and habits, so you can perform at your best.

Please submit your CV in English.

Streem Energy is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

At Streem, we are building the next generation SaaS platform to empower the commercial management of renewable energy assets. Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition by enabling asset managers, investors, and operators to extract more value from their renewable portfolios.

As we continue our European expansion, the UK represents a strategic growth market for Streem. While renewable energy is increasingly international, the commercial, regulatory and operational dynamics of each market remain highly local.

We are therefore looking for an experienced Business Development Manager – UK to help us establish and scale Streem's presence in the UK market.

You are a tenacious, sharp dermatology biller who knows ModMed inside and out. You treat unresolved claims as personal challenges, spot coding discrepancies before submission, and keep practice revenue flowing smoothly.

Job Title: Operational Excellence Leader

Job Description Summary

The Operational Excellence Leader is responsible for leading the Canadian Service Tools and Operational Supplies programs, ensuring Field Service teams have access to the tools, equipment, and support required to deliver safe, effective, and efficient customer service. This includes leadership of tool strategy, procurement, calibration and repair, supplier management, inventory and lifecycle management, field support, and financial stewardship of the Service Tools program.

In addition, the role drives operational excellence across the Canadian Service organization through improved operational rigor, performance metrics, quality and compliance, process improvement, and readiness for evolving service processes and technologies. Key accountabilities include Daily Management System (DMS) preparedness and dashboard alignment, Service Request cleanup and ServiceMax preparedness, quality initiatives including Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), and the implementation of sustainable operating mechanisms that improve service performance.

The role works cross-functionally with Service leadership, Field Service, Quality, Engineering, Sourcing, operational support teams, suppliers, and regional and global partners to translate business and field requirements into effective solutions and continuous improvement.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities


Service Tools, Operational Supplies & Financial Management

  • Provide overall leadership for the Canadian Service Tools and Operational Supplies programs, including tool availability, procurement, calibration, repair, field support, inventory, catalog management, and lifecycle requirements.
  • Manage the $1.25M+ annual Service Tools budget, including annual planning, prioritization of investments, and alignment with Regional and National Service leadership.
  • Manage calibration and repair suppliers, including work-in-progress reviews, prioritization of high-demand tools, cost management, and resolution of supplier performance issues.
  • Partner with Engineering, Sourcing, Supplier Quality, operational support teams, and other stakeholders to resolve tool availability, obsolescence, validation, quality, and procurement issues.
  • Provide governance for the Operational Supplies catalog, inventory requirements, associated workflows, and supporting data.
  • Serve as an escalation point for Field Service tool requirements, identifying solutions and alternatives that support field productivity and customer service.

Systems & Performance

  • Drive operational rigor across the Service organization through effective performance metrics, operating mechanisms, action management, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead Daily Management System (DMS) preparedness and dashboard alignment, ensuring operational processes, metrics, data, and ownership support business requirements.
  • Lead and support Service Request cleanup and ServiceMax preparedness, including process readiness, testing, data quality, and resolution of workflow gaps.
  • Identify operational performance gaps and partner with Service leaders and cross-functional teams to establish actions, ownership, and sustainable solutions.
  • Support implementation of new processes, systems, metrics, and operational initiatives that improve Service effectiveness.

Quality, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with Quality and Service stakeholders to support Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) activities, new quality metrics, investigations, corrective actions, and effectiveness checks.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure assigned operational processes align with applicable Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
  • Lead or support investigations and corrective actions related to Service Tools processes, including out-of-tolerance assessments and field escalations.
  • Identify recurring process issues and lead cross-functional improvement initiatives that strengthen quality, compliance, safety, and operational performance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years of operational or field experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in service operations, operational excellence, field service, supply chain, asset or tool management, or a related operational function.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving actions through completion in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience with operational performance management, including metrics, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience working with quality, compliance, audit, or corrective-action processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, suppliers, competing priorities, and operational escalations.
  • Strong analytical, project-management, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions and levels of an organization.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience in healthcare technology, medical devices, Field Service, or another regulated environment.
  • Strong understanding of Field Service operations and the relationship between operational processes, field productivity, quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Experience supporting major system implementations, operational transformations, or process changes.
  • Experience with dashboards, operational metrics, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), supplier management, calibration, or asset management.
  • Familiarity with enterprise service management, asset management, quality, and field-service systems.

  • Ability to balance strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational execution and escalations.

    • Incoming quality inspections
    • In-process inspections
    • Final goods inspections
    • Vendor quality management
    • Batch quality management
    • Stability studies
    • CAPA processes
    • Non-conformance management

  • Configure and optimize SAP QM functionalities including:
    • Inspection Types
    • Inspection Plans
    • Sampling Procedures
    • Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs)
    • Catalogs & Code Groups
    • Quality Notifications
    • Usage Decisions
    • Quality Certificates
    • Dynamic Modification Rules
    • Defect Recording
  • Design and manage:
    • Quality info records
    • Vendor evaluation processes
    • Batch management integration
    • Audit management support processes

SAP S/4HANA QM Implementation

  • Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA QM implementations including:
    • Requirement gathering
    • Fit-gap analysis
    • Solution design
    • Configuration
    • Testing
    • Deployment
    • Hypercare support
  • Participate in SAP ECC to S/4HANA transformation initiatives
  • Drive SAP QM process harmonization and digital quality transformation

Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences Expertise

  • Work within GxP-regulated environments and support:
    • FDA compliance
    • GMP requirements
    • Validation processes
    • Electronic records compliance
    • Audit readiness
  • Collaborate with QA/QC, manufacturing, regulatory, and validation teams

Integration Responsibilities

  • Integrate SAP QM with:
    • SAP MM (Materials Management)
    • SAP PP (Production Planning)
    • SAP EWM
    • SAP PM
    • SAP SD
    • SAP Batch Management
    • SAP MES systems
    • LIMS systems
    • Third-party manufacturing and laboratory applications
  • Support automated quality workflows and shop-floor integrations

SAP QM Data & Reporting

  • Design quality analytics and KPI dashboards
  • Support reporting using:
    • SAP Embedded Analytics
    • CDS Views
    • SAP Fiori Applications
    • SAP Analytics Cloud (preferred)
  • Analyze quality trends, defects, and compliance metrics

SAP Fiori & User Experience

  • Support SAP Fiori-enabled QM applications
  • Enhance user experience through:
    • Mobile inspection applications
    • Workflow automation
    • Simplified approval processes
    • Real-time quality monitoring dashboards

Testing, Validation & Documentation

  • Prepare:
    • Functional specifications
    • Configuration documents
    • Test scripts
    • Validation documents
    • SOP-related documentation
  • Support:
    • SIT
    • UAT
    • Regression testing
    • Cutover planning
    • Production support

Required Skills & Experience

Who we are

We’re Ethena, an AI platform that’s revolutionizing the Compliance space. Our team of agents helps Compliance leaders run proactive Compliance programs that drive meaningful behavior change.

From Policies and Disclosures to Training, Hotline, and Analytics, our agents work together to drive smarter, faster, human-led decision-making. Hotline and training data rolls up into fully customizable, board-ready risk reports. Phishing clicks trigger bite-sized, targeted follow-up courses that drive behavior change without taking up a ton of training time. Our AI call taker synthesizes data to recommend improvements to company policies and training. Every signal lands in one place, so Compliance leaders can spot risk early and fix it before it becomes a problem. The agents do the legwork, and people make every judgment call.

More than 2,000 organizations, from Pinterest and Zendesk to the Salvation Army, run their programs on Ethena. That covers millions of employees, from the warehouse floor to the trading desk. Our learning paths drop seat time by 60%, learners give our training a 93% approval rating, and 96% of customers renew.

Lots of companies call themselves AI-forward. We’ve actually built the tools to prove it. Come help us build what’s next.

How we work

We’re a team that values diversity in all its forms and loves adding new perspectives. We ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and build with empathy — for customers and each other. We're passionate about the work we do, love feedback, and lead with high agency and accountability. When we see something that could be better, we step up to the plate and do something about it. We take our work seriously, but are careful not to take ourselves too seriously. Because doing great work should be fun.
Our workforce is fully remote, and your personal working hours can be based on your own timezone. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of all North American time zones.

Who we're looking for

Ethena is growing fast, and we need a finance leader who’s excited to build what comes next. As our Head of Finance, you’ll own the full finance function, from accounting and close to forecasting, planning, and board reporting. You’ll report to our COO and work closely with her to give our leadership team the data and insight behind our biggest decisions. You’ll also give every department head a clear line of sight into their budget. We’re looking for someone with a real point of view. You’ll spot the risks and opportunities in the numbers before anyone asks and turn complex data into clear and actionable takeaways. You’ll be hands-on in the details one day and zoomed out on strategy the next. Along the way, you’ll build a high-performing finance team that holds itself to a high bar.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with the COO to drive smart decisions. You’ll keep leadership equipped with a clear, current view of financials, forecasts, and runway. You’ll also pull together and synthesize the data behind our biggest calls. You’ll flag risks and opportunities early, lay out the levers we can pull, and bring a recommendation on things like a smarter way to deploy spend or a cost that’s growing faster than its value. Then you’ll turn it into takeaways the exec team can act on.
  • Partner with RevOps on revenue and comp plans. You’ll work with our Head of RevOps to turn pipeline and attainment data into financial insight on unit economics, retention, and sales efficiency. You’ll oversee commission and comp plans.
  • Give every department head line of sight. You’ll work with each leader so they always know where their budget stands, what’s changed, and what tradeoffs they’re facing.
  • Own planning and forecasting. That covers the annual plan, quarterly reforecasts, the operating model, the cash forecast, and scenario planning for pricing, hiring, and growth.
  • Oversee accounting end to end. You’ll oversee month-end and year-end close, AR/AP, revenue recognition, and tax, and build a faster, cleaner close as we scale.
  • Lead the audit and keep us compliant. You’ll own the annual audit and keep us current on tax and regulatory requirements everywhere we operate.
  • Manage investor and lender relationships. You’ll own board and investor reporting, manage our banking and lending partners, and lead fundraising work from model to data room.
  • Level up the finance function. You’ll grow and lead the team, decide what to bring in-house versus outsource, and use AI and automation to keep a lean team operating well above its size.

What makes a great candidate

  • You cut your teeth in FP&A and have since overseen every part of finance, including accounting, at early stage and fast-growing SaaS companies.
  • You’ve built and led a finance team, and you’ve been the person accountable for the numbers, not just a contributor to them.
  • You’ve run an audit, supported a fundraise, and presented directly to a board.
  • You’re as comfortable reconciling an account as you are presenting a growth plan to the board.
  • You have a strong point of view and share it. You come with a recommendation and the math behind it, and you change your mind when the data says you should.
  • You can make finance make sense to anyone, from a first-time manager to a board member.
  • You’re highly autonomous and do your best work when you’re trusted to run your function.
  • You care about building a team with a culture of excellence, and you know how to hire, coach, and raise the bar.
  • You’re AI-native. You already use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to automate work, build models, and get to insights faster, and you’d rather build a tool than hire for a task.
  • You thrive on a fully distributed team, and move fast without losing rigor.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Senior Medical Director, Product Safety Physician Lead Job Location: Remote (US) Job Location Type: Remote Job Contract Type: Full-time Job Seniority Level: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Medical Director, Product Safety Physician Lead

Job Location: Remote (US)

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

The Senior Medical Director serves as the Lead Product Safety Physician for multiple or large complex strategically important developmental programs (often multi-indication) and creates and maintains a single interpretation of global safety data for developmental. With the support of Safety Physicians and Safety Scientists identifies and manages the documentation and communication of safety concerns and together with teams engaged in BeOne sponsored studies, ensures the safety of patients.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Accountable for oversight of benefit/risk safety profile of allocated products through the product life cycle with a principle focus on early development

  • Actively leads and enhances knowledge of safety profiles for allocated products, including both BeOne and competitor products

  • Identifies and actively leads management of safety concerns for developmental and approved BeOne products

  • Actively leads Development and, as required, Medical Affairs product teams in the identification of, and handling of product safety concerns

  • Governance:

  • Chairs Safety Management Team (SMT) meetings for assigned products, reviews SMT materials, develops & represents safety perspective in SMT meetings

  • Represents the SMT and participates in Company Safety Committee (CSC) meetings, support meeting preparations, develop & proposes review topics/ CSC agenda items

  • Actively leads communication of recommendations to labeling group/other stakeholders

  • Actively participates in meetings as required in External Safety Monitoring Committees (DMC) meetings through provision and review of safety data, insights and leadership and provides input to DMC Charters

  • Actively leads Internal Safety Monitoring Committees (SMC) meetings (e.g., dose escalation safety meeting) & supports as needed. Provides input to safety charters

Product Labeling, as Required for Work on Later Development Programs

  • Actively leads communication of CSC recommendations for labeling amendments, participates in Labeling Working Group meetings, leads communication of Safety outcomes to relevant stakeholders

  • Actively leads the development and maintenance of the Company Core Safety Information (CCSI), proposes edits and manages approval of amendments

  • Presents the CCSI to the labeling committee, contributes viewpoint to CCDS development, and reviews company core data sheet

  • Provides safety insights to development of Package Insert and Labeling Updates, develops labeling update impact summaries for use by RA, develops labeling prose text updates, based on internal aggregated reports

Issues Management

  • Leads and manages escalation of potential issues to the SMT, ensures internal notification and provides updates

  • Leads and develops strategy for issue management and facilitates internal approval of plans

  • Leads the review of issue data and closure on recommendations, leads the drafting of an issue response document, reviews, and manages approval of issue response documentation and responses

  • Leads the formulation of a rapid response procedure, triage of potential issues to safety committee, executes Crisis Management response plan, reviews ongoing issue and plan

  • Reviews regulatory inquiry to lead strategizing the nature of response, best course of action and determines data specifications, Reviews relevant data required for response

  • Leads responses and contributes to formal response provided to regulatory agencies, reviews draft response, and manages approval of response

  • Actively leads the incorporation of latest updates and findings from ongoing pharmacovigilance and epidemiological analysis

  • Actively leads BeOne safety in face-to-face regulatory meetings

  • Actively leads and develops an evaluation of safety enquiries (Internal, External, HCP & consumer), leads the assignment of response drafting responsibility, determines data required for response, reviews response data & drafts response and manages approval of responses

  • Guides and leads medical review of SAEs and provides immediate input to escalated reports, determines, and executes further escalation within BeOne as needed

Commercialization Support and Liaison with Other Functions

  • Leads and develops strategic plans for safety differentiation of BeOne products, provides training BeOne employees on product safety profiles/issues, provides input into commercial publications strategy, reviews publications, including abstracts, manuscripts, and speaker presentations, provides input for potential in-licensing opportunities as requested

  • Leads product liaison for BeOne functions (Legal, Bus Dev, Operations, Marketing, etc.), executes appropriate communication of safety data and interpretation to BeOne and external parties, globally, facilitates communication with country office medical directors as required.

  • Leads EU/International Safety Communication & Co-ordination training to BeOne employees on product safety issues and profiles

Trial Safety Support

  • Accountable for the collaborative authoring of safety content in clinical trial documentation, including but not limited to protocols, IBs, and ICFs. Able to collaborate and advise on technical aspects of trial design including escalation and expansion design, DLT criteria, inclusion and exclusion criteria, and risk monitoring and management aspects.

  • Accountable for safety data, reviews and provides advice on Safety Endpoints, safety related inclusion and exclusion criteria data to capture during trial, key review activities and timing, reviews and leads input on product program wide safety issues, protocols, and protocol updates. Expected to demonstrate and model responsive and collaborative medical review of ICSRs and aggregate safety reviews with cross functional colleagues.

  • Accountable for the content of safety sections of the Development Safety Update Report (DSUR), reviews and approves

  • Accountable for development and maintenance of RSIs, contributes to the safety sections of the IB, ICF and updates and manages any needs to reconsent subjects in ongoing trials based on emergent safety data assessment

  • Actively leads and develops expectations of expected, anticipated statistical analyses to run over trial for the SAP and provides product program wide input on safety statistical elements required for analysis

  • Accountable for data requirement recommendations and safety section for clinical data management plan for capture during clinical trials, supports the review and update of data management plan based on updates to integrated safety viewpoint during trial

  • Accountable for the determination of safety data required for capture in CRFs during clinical trials, reviews and provides product program wide input to CRFs

  • Leads the formulation safety criteria and review of study specific medical monitoring plans

  • Participates in investigator meetings, as needed, accountable for product safety profile and reviews, approves and updates of safety presentation content

Developmental Product Safety Monitoring and Surveillance (Protocol Specific)

  • Accountable for output/summary report for inclusion into clinical, filing

  • Accountable for daily, weekly, and monthly review of SAEs and abnormal labs, protocol specific review of aggregate SAEs and specific analysis of aggregate CTDB (AE tables, shift tables, listings)

Submission Filing Safety Support, as Required for Work on Later Development Programs

  • Proactively, reviews and interprets study safety data, supports Clinical Study Report narrative generation, leads the interpretation-based safety sections of reports, reviews draft report

  • Accountable for drafting the safety sections of the Summary of Clinical Safety and ISS

  • Leads 120-day update plans and activities

Extra-Departmental Liaison & Co-ordination

  • Represents and promotes safety at the product development team as core team member, contributes to development strategy for allocated compounds

  • Leads the preparations for and attends clinical team meetings

  • Actively leads contribution to development of differentiation of BeOne products, provides training guidance to marketing training materials, reviews, and contributes to marketing materials

Internal Global Patient Safety Department Development Interfaces

  • Leads GPS product co-ordination, chairs product group meetings across GPS

Pharmacovigilance

  • Leads and manages safety PV processes for BeOne and competitor products

  • Accountable for the development of Product Safety Strategy and the writing and maintenance of the Safety Surveillance Plans

  • Actively leads safety Issue Assessment and documentation, develop determination of issue scope, execute risk assessment

  • Accountable for development and update summary of competitor safety profile labelling, FOI, and issues

  • Accountable for development and maintenance of product safety profiles and develops Events of Interest

  • Presents data at scheduled and ad hoc product safety reviews, chair review meetings, identifies safety issues for escalation to SMT, determine if a safety concern needs escalation to management, facilitates closure on recommendations

  • Accountable for development and maintenance of updates to Product Surveillance Plans

  • Actively leads the scope, strategy, and content of responses to HA assessment reports, contribute to authoring of relevant sections

  • As required for work on later development programs:

    • Actively leads the definition of Risk Management Plan (RMP) drivers & content, reviews core RMP & local RMPs (or REMS) and leads execution of RMP elements, documentation of evidence of RMP execution, evaluates potential risks for evidence of risk confirmation and leads recommendations for RMP/REMS update

    • Actively leads the development of safety Post Approval Commitments (PAC) proposals, facilitates the design of PAC proposed safety study, executes PAC studies

    • Leads and manages the definition of events of interest, defines case follow-up needs

    • Accountable for development and implementation of product launch plans

  • Accountable for development of a publication plan, contributes to draft papers

  • Contributes to and promotes the development of a global Pharmacoepidemiology (PE) strategy

Compliance, Standards, Training & Project Management:

  • Actively leads the evaluation of current processes and assesses alignment with regulatory expectations, guidelines, mandates for regulatory inspections

  • Trains and mentors Safety Physicians and Safety Scientists

  • Actively leads and maintains an environment of continuous improvement within the team and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives across GPS

Required Qualifications

  • MD (or internationally recognized equivalent) plus accredited residency, with 6 + years’ pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry experience in Clinical Research, Clinical Development and 4 + years' experience in safety in Phase 1 and Phase 2

  • Accredited fellowship with 1-year clinical experience with patients in a relevant therapeutic area specialty, with significant knowledge of general medicine is preferred.

  • Experience in oncology in the preapproval space is preferred

  • Prior matrix management team experience

  • Prior experience as a product safety physician

  • Pharmaceutical product development experience, including individual study design and filing plans.

  • Experienced in global regulatory requirements for pharmacovigilance

  • Appropriate experience with Regulatory Agency and KOL interactions

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This position may have safety scientists/physicians reporting to them depending on the program / portfolio being led. The Senior Medical Director serves as Product Safety Physician Lead for multiple or large complex strategically important developmental programs. Works closely with the other Safety Science and Epidemiology Physicians and Safety Scientists as part of a flexible matrix team to conduct robust safety assessments and safety risk management activities, based on ICH standards, for developmental product safety upon which marketed product safety surveillance may be based. The Senior Medical Director is expected to mentor and develop junior staff and offer them support and advice to advance their work.

Computer Skills:

  • Intermediate knowledge working with a safety database for retrieval of safety information; Advanced knowledge of MedDRA; MS Office Suite: Advanced application capability with Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Familiarity with data mining tools and exploratory analyses tools such as Spotfire.

Travel:

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here.

Here's what we're looking for:

Position available remotely within EU

We are looking for an experienced, motivated Freelance Backend Software Engineerwho will work closely with their Backend colleagues, as well as support our product teams. You will contribute with your knowledge of Java, Spring, Hibernate, relational databases & REST within our agile and cross-functional teams. As a flexible and open-minded person with a passion for clean code you will be a perfect addition to our team. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to code reviews, test coverage, quality days and CI/CD principles.

If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you!

Essential skills for this mission:

  • You enjoy developing clean, stable, testable and performant backend code, serving our beautiful mobile applications

  • You have at least 3 years of experience working as a Software Engineer

  • You have at least 2 years of full-time experience as a Backend Engineer

  • You love working in and supporting an interdisciplinary team, together with architects, frontend engineers, QAs, and product owners

  • You are passionate about solid technical design, clean code and future-proof architectures

  • You are familiar with Java 17+ and frameworks like Spring 5, Hibernate, or JAX-RS

  • You have experience with SQL and relational databases like PostgreSQL

  • You have experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or any other cloud provider

  • You want to learn new technologies and are able to adopt them quickly

  • Great written and verbal communication in English

  • You are either an EU citizen or hold a valid Austrian work permit

Bonus skills:

  • Experience with medical, security, and privacy regulations

  • Knowledge of the diabetes industry or other comparable health industries

  • Experience working in agile environments

Here's what you can expect from us:

  • Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products

  • An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with really smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams

You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits. You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of health care systems around the world. Additionally, you may explore other roles related to software development, such as Product Owner or Scrum Master within our interdisciplinary team structure.

Who we are and what we care about?

We are committed to providing a healthy, equal and inclusive working environment for our employees to bring true relief to the patient! We care about family friendly career paths, sustainability, a healthy lifestyle and the flexibility of a modern workplace. We maintain a culture of learning and sharing, as well as open and candid feedback. At every level, there are many opportunities to develop and grow - both professionally and personally.

As a healthcare pioneer committed to transforming the lives of billions of people around the globe, we push boundaries to redefine what is possible. We know that early, accurate diagnosis is essential to maintain health, prevent disease and help advance new, targeted treatments and potential cures for the world’s most serious health problems. We have a passion for innovation and a profound commitment to make a lasting impact on society by continuing to improve the standard of care for humankind. Our culture inspires us to create healthcare that is sustainable, efficient and financially viable. Healthcare that is built on people’s needs, strong data and clinical insights. Healthcare that saves lives.

We are looking for our first dedicated Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs, payment flows, and active bug bounties. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe.

Also, the HQ office is in Berlin, where the team often meets.

Requirements

Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in AppSec (or 3+ years plus a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

About Clinical Solutions

Elsevier Clinical Solutions delivers trusted, evidence-based content and technology-enabled solutions that support healthcare professionals, institutions, and patients across the care journey. Our portfolio includes Clinical And Drug Reference, Clinical Decision Support, Patient Engagement, Performance Improvement, Workflow Solutions, Clinical Pathways, Order Sets, Care Planning, and emerging AI-enabled solutions.

Our products help healthcare organizations improve clinical decision-making, support patient safety, reduce variability in care, enhance workflow efficiency, and promote the use of trusted evidence at the point of care.

Elsevier is seeking a Physician Clinical Executive to drive the growth of Clinical Solutions across the APAC region. Based in Malaysia and reporting to the Product Sales Director, Clinical Solutions, this role serves as the physician-level clinical authority for commercial teams, customers, and partners, bringing deep clinical expertise and consultative leadership to the region.

The successful candidate will be a qualified medical doctor with clinical practice experience and the ability to act as a trusted clinical advisor to healthcare organizations across APAC. They will advise customers on the clinical value and strategic application of Elsevier’s Clinical Solutions portfolio, including Clinical Decision Support, solutions such: ClinicalKey, ClinicalKey AI, Drug Information, Clinical Pathways, and other Workflow Solutions.

This role will work closely with sales, product, marketing, customer success, implementation, and regional leadership teams to drive revenue growth, customer engagement, product adoption, and thought leadership across APAC.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the clinical authority and trusted physician advisor within sales engagements across APAC, leading opportunity identification, qualification, development, account planning, and solution-based customer engagements.

  • Lead conversations on clinical workflow integration, Clinical Decision Support, AI-enabled solutions, evidence-based practice, Care Standardization, Patient Safety, Clinical Quality, Medication Safety, Clinician Productivity, and Patient Engagement.

  • Lead the regional positioning and expansion of ClinicalKey AI and other AI-enabled Clinical Solutions, providing physician-led thought leadership on the responsible, ethical, safe, and effective use of AI in clinical workflows.

  • Excellent presentation, communication, storytelling, stakeholder management, analytical, and organizational skills, with the ability to synthesize complex clinical, technical, and commercial information.

jobs.description:
Start: ab sofort | Level: Senior | Location: Deutschland, remote | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche)

Als IT Security Architekt (gn) – IAM & OnPrem verantwortest du das Sicherheits-Zielbild und die Standards für Identitäten und die On-Premises-Infrastruktur. Du entwirfst Referenzarchitekturen für Identity & Access Management, On-Prem Active Directory (inkl. hybrider Anbindung an Entra ID) sowie die zugehörige On-Prem-Infrastruktur und berätst die umsetzenden Teams. Die operative Umsetzung liegt bei den Fachteams; dein Beitrag ist Design, Standardsetzung und fachliche Beratung.

Deine Mission bei uns

  • Verantwortungsbereiche / Domänen

    • Identity & Access Management (IAM): Referenzarchitektur und Standards für Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepte, Rezertifizierung, Joiner/Mover/Leaver-Prozesse und privilegierte Zugriffe (PAM).
    • On-Prem Active Directory: Härtungs- und Tiering-Konzepte, Absicherung privilegierter Konten, sichere Administrationsmodelle.
    • Entra ID (Hybrid): Sichere Kopplung von On-Prem AD und Cloud-Identität, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management – als Teil eines konsistenten hybriden Identitätskonzepts.
    • On-Prem Infrastruktur & Netzwerk: Sicherheitsvorgaben für Segmentierung, Zugriffs- und Übergangsarchitekturen sowie sichere Fernzugriffe im On-Prem-Umfeld.
    • OT / Produktionssicherheit (optional, zukünftig): Vorgesehen als zukünftige Erweiterung des Verantwortungsbereichs – Referenzarchitektur und Standards für die sichere Trennung und Anbindung von OT-/Produktionssystemen (Standort Elmshorn) an die IT. Entsprechende Kompetenz bzw. Bereitschaft, sich in das Thema einzuarbeiten, muss vorhanden sein.

    Architektur & Standards

    • Zielbild & Referenzarchitektur: Entwicklung von Sicherheits-Zielbildern und Referenzarchitekturen für IAM und die On-Prem-Infrastruktur.
    • Standards & Vorgaben: Erstellung verbindlicher Sicherheitsstandards, Guidelines und ADRs; Definition von Least-Privilege-, Tiering- und Security-by-Design-Prinzipien.
    • Risiko- & Architektur-Reviews: Bewertung bestehender und geplanter Lösungen, Identifikation von Schwachstellen und Ableitung von Maßnahmen – ohne selbst zu implementieren.

    Beratung & Enablement

    • Fachliche Beratung: Beratung aller technischen Teams (u. a. IT-Infrastruktur, Netzwerk, Engineering) zur sicheren Umsetzung der Vorgaben.
    • Tool-Auswahl & Einführung: Auswahl geeigneter IAM-/Security-Tools und fachliche Begleitung sowie Überwachung ihrer Einführung.

Deine Erfahrung & Skills

  • Erfahrung: Langjährige Erfahrung in Security-Architektur bzw. Identity-/Infrastruktursicherheit mit nachweisbaren Ergebnissen.
  • IAM: Fundiertes Verständnis von IAM-Konzepten und -Prozessen (Rollenmodelle, Rezertifizierung, Berechtigungsauswertung, PAM).
  • Active Directory & Entra ID: Tiefe Kenntnisse in On-Prem Active Directory (Härtung, Tiering) und Microsoft Entra ID inkl. hybrider Szenarien (Conditional Access, PIM).
  • Infrastruktur & Netzwerk: Verständnis für On-Prem-Infrastruktur- und Netzwerksicherheit (Segmentierung, sichere Zugriffe).
  • Arbeitsweise & Wirkung: Fähigkeit, Standards zu setzen, teamübergreifend zu beraten und Kolleg:innen fachlich weiterzuentwickeln; strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise.
  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.

jobs.excerpt: Être Consultant Product Owner chez OCTO, c’est : • Être garant de la vision produit : contribuer à la définition de la vision et la communiquer auprès de votre équipe.
jobs.description:
Être Consultant Product Owner chez OCTO, c’est :

  • Être garant de la vision produit : contribuer à la définition de la vision et la communiquer auprès de votre équipe. Décliner la feuille de route produit à court / moyen terme et la mettre en oeuvre.

  • Maintenir le backlog produit : définir, co-concevoir, rédiger et prioriser les prochaines user stories en fonction de l’impact sur la stratégie produit et sur l’expérience utilisateur.

  • S’assurer du bon déroulé du sprint : définir les objectifs et le contenu du sprint avec l’équipe, suivre l’avancement et les indicateurs. Valider les user stories développées et être responsable de l’adéquation de la solution réalisée.

  • Représenter les utilisateurs et des parties prenantes : écouter, observer et traduire les besoins exprimés en fonctionnalités. Capturer et implémenter les retours utilisateurs.

  • Être le représentant de l’équipe technique et de la qualité : favoriser dans la priorisation l’équilibre entre développements techniques et nouvelles fonctionnalités. Être en capacité de traduire les contraintes techniques à votre client.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de l’équipe et du produit : assurer les rituels de sprint (dont les démonstrations et rétrospectives) pour favoriser la collaboration et l’amélioration continue de l’organisation d’équipe et des processus.

Promis pas de liste à rallonge, mais des compétences clés pour vous permettre de réussir chez nous :

Vous avez au moins 3 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Owner ou rôle équivalent autour des enjeux data & IA.

Un socle de savoir-faire

  • Piloter par la valeur : prioriser, arbitrer et décider en fonction de la valeur utilisateur, business et des contraintes de delivery, en s’appuyant sur des frameworks reconnus (MoSCoW, RICE, WSJF).
  • Fédérer et communiquer : faire preuve d’excellente communication écrite et orale, d’écoute et de pédagogie pour aligner équipes pluridisciplinaires (UX, QA, dev, OPS) et parties prenantes autour d’une vision produit claire.
  • Garantir un delivery agile et fiable : maîtriser les rituels Agile/Scrum, gérer et affiner le backlog, suivre l’exécution des sprints, identifier blocages et risques, et piloter les livraisons de façon incrémentale.
  • Décider avec la donnée : exploiter les données d’usage, retours utilisateurs et métriques produit/delivery pour challenger les demandes, définir des critères de succès et mesurer l’impact des évolutions.
  • Intégrer l’IA générative dans ses pratiques : utiliser régulièrement des outils d’IA générative pour accélérer et améliorer la rédaction de User Stories, la formalisation des besoins, l’analyse, la priorisation et le suivi du delivery.

Un panel de savoir-être :

  • Esprit d'analyse et sens du challenge

Capacité à prendre du recul sur un besoin, poser les bonnes questions, challenger les demandes et identifier les problématiques les plus pertinentes à résoudre.

  • Communication et conviction

Capacité à porter ses idées, expliquer ses choix, défendre ses arbitrages et adapter sa communication aux différentes parties prenantes

  • Esprit d'équipe et intelligence collective

Capacité à travailler dans un environnement pluridisciplinaire, solliciter les bonnes personnes au bon moment, partager ses apprentissages et contribuer à une dynamique collective de confiance.

  • Autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités

Capacité à prendre des initiatives, gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle et mener les actions à leur terme avec fiabilité.

  • Curiosité et appétence pour les sujets Produit, Tech et IA

Envie d'apprendre en continu, d'explorer de nouveaux sujets, de développer sa culture numérique et de rester en veille sur les pratiques, outils et usages émergents.

OCTO Rewards

Et parce que nous savons qu’un job n’est pas “juste” un job, on vous partage aussi quelques petits + qui font notre différence :

  • 7 participations, 7 certifications et surtout 6 podiums au palmarès « Great Place To Work » : le bien-être et la progression des Octos sont vraiment au cœur de nos préoccupations ;
  • “There is always a better way” : nous encourageons et soutenons l’innovation par la R&D. Au-delà d’une direction scientifique dédiée, nous valorisons le temps hors mission pour partager ses connaissances : blog OCTO, talks, meet-up, livre blanc, BBL… en bref de l’open source alimenté par tous les Octos !
  • Parce que ce ne sont pas que des mots, nous marquons au quotidien notre engagement en matière de numérique responsable : nous formons les Octos et nos clients à la Fresque du Climat / 2 Tonnes et œuvrons pour la sobriété numérique en interne et auprès de nos clients. Depuis 2021, nous sommes labellisés B Corp, et nous sommes fiers de renouveler cette certification toujours plus exigeante en 2025 ;
  • Le management est un point central de notre culture. Les Octos managers sont tous formés via un socle de formations obligatoires pour vous accompagner dans votre développement (carrière, compétences, etc.) ;
  • Parce qu’on n’a jamais fini d’apprendre, vous pourrez tirer parti de notre large offre de formations (softskills, et hardskills), avec un accompagnement personnalisé et 5 jours de formation en moyenne par an, pour affûter vos compétences et vous certifier et, pourquoi pas, devenir vous-même formateur…
  • … sans oublier qu’OCTO est un bain apprenant : chaque jour, les Octos ont la possibilité d’apprendre ensemble, au-delà des formations : BBL, conférences, OCTO Fest, blog OCTO, livres blancs & ref cards, ou tout simplement lors d’échanges informels à la machine à café : c’est aussi ça l’expérience d’apprentissage “à la OCTO” ;
  • Le sujet de la parentalité compte aussi beaucoup à nos yeux. C’est pourquoi nous avons mis à disposition des places en crèche, ainsi que d’une permanence parentalité pour les parents et futurs parents ;
  • Depuis 2022, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de l’Autre Cercle concernant l’inclusion des personnes LGBTQIA+ en entreprise (renouvelée en 2025), et depuis 2023 de la Charte de la Diversité et de l'Accord Handicap. Collaborer avec des personnes talentueuses issues de différents horizons. Aussi, ce que nous cherchons avant tout, ce sont des personnalités qui enrichiront OCTO.

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tasks and responsibilitiesIn a public-sector digital-services environment, you will develop secure, accessible and responsive business applications that support citizens, healthcare professionals and internal users in Belgium.
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

In a public-sector digital-services environment, you will develop secure, accessible and responsive business applications that support citizens, healthcare professionals and internal users in Belgium. You will work across the application stack, from the Blazor user interface to the .NET services behind it, while contributing to technical decisions and supporting colleagues.

You will join an ICT department of approximately 250 professionals working on more than 50 projects in different development phases. The organisation is modernising its application landscape towards a cloud-native architecture on Microsoft Azure, using Azure Service Bus and containerised workloads. A platform engineering team provides shared libraries, the design system, DevOps pipelines and standards for the application teams.

Web user interfaces are standardised on Blazor, allowing one .NET skill set to cover the complete application. The UI is the part of the application used by citizens, healthcare professionals and employees, so it must be accessible, consistent and responsive. The organisation is also exploring the responsible use of AI in business applications and software development.

Job purpose

As Senior .NET Developer with a UI focus, you will design, develop, integrate and maintain modern business applications. You will take ownership of their user interfaces while contributing to the underlying services. The role combines advanced hands-on development with technical leadership, coaching and close collaboration with analysts, architects, UX stakeholders, security specialists, the platform engineering team and operations.

You will translate functional and technical requirements into reusable, accessible solutions. Your work will support a consistent user experience across devices and browsers, correct integration with services and APIs, reuse of the shared component library and design system, and compliance with standards for architecture, security, quality, maintainability and delivery.

As a senior developer, you will help resolve complex technical issues, make well-founded design choices, improve engineering practices and support colleagues through coaching and code reviews. The role remains strongly hands-on, with direct contributions to feature development, testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement across both the UI and its supporting services.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide technical direction for Blazor development across teams and promote consistent UI architecture, reusable components, coding standards and engineering practices in line with the platform team's standards.
  • Develop features, reusable components, prototypes, technical improvements and bug fixes using C#, modern .NET, Blazor, Razor components and the .NET Web APIs on which they depend.
  • Design scalable, maintainable and reusable front-end structures that align with the organisation's architectural principles, and contribute to the shared component library built on MudBlazor and the shared design system.
  • Build responsive interfaces with semantic HTML and modern CSS that meet WCAG 2.1 level AA, as required of Belgian public bodies under the European Web Accessibility Directive. Consider usability, browser compatibility and the public-service context throughout the development process.
  • Work with functional and business analysts and UX stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess feasibility and translate user and business needs into sound technical solutions.
  • Integrate Blazor applications with REST APIs and JSON-based services, including typed clients, suitable error handling, state management, validation and resilience. Extend the Web APIs when a feature requires it.
  • Implement secure authentication and authorisation flows using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect for internal users, healthcare professionals and citizens, each with its own identity provider. Apply secure development practices throughout the application lifecycle.
  • Maintain code quality through structured pull-request reviews, refactoring, SonarQube static analysis, coding standards and clear, reusable and testable components.
  • Define and maintain unit tests, Blazor component tests with bUnit, service-level integration tests and, where appropriate, automated UI tests with Playwright. Follow the test pyramid to support reliable releases and prevent regressions.
  • Use Git, Azure DevOps repositories, boards and CI/CD pipelines for controlled versioning, automated builds, testing and deployment to Azure environments.
  • Select the appropriate Blazor render mode for each application, monitor and improve loading time, rendering behaviour and responsiveness, and use Dynatrace and browser tools to diagnose issues in test and production.
  • Coach developers, share Blazor and accessibility expertise, document solutions and contribute to continuous technical improvement.
  • Lead the analysis and resolution of complex end-to-end issues from the browser through the API to the database across development, test and production environments.
  • Evaluate relevant .NET and web technologies and patterns, including AI-assisted development practices, and recommend adoption when they provide sustainable value and align with architectural and security decisions.

Key technical expertise

You should have recent, substantial hands-on experience in the following areas:

  • C# and modern .NET: Advanced proficiency in C# and current .NET, including .NET 10 or later, asynchronous programming, dependency injection, clean code and maintainable application design.
  • Blazor and Razor components: Recent experience developing production-grade Blazor applications, including the Blazor Web App model and its render modes: static server-side rendering, interactive Server, WebAssembly and Auto. You understand prerendering, streaming rendering, component lifecycle, state handling, forms, validation and reusable component libraries such as MudBlazor.
  • HTML, CSS and responsive design: Strong command of semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive design for consistent use across devices and screen sizes.
  • Accessibility: Practical experience delivering interfaces that meet WCAG 2.1 level AA, including keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, contrast, focus management and accessible forms. You are comfortable testing with assistive technologies.
  • REST API integration and JSON exchanges: Experience consuming and building REST APIs with ASP.NET Core, handling JSON exchanges and implementing robust validation, error handling and integration patterns.
  • OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect: Practical experience implementing secure authentication and authorisation in web applications with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and claims-based authorisation.
  • Data access: Working proficiency with Entity Framework Core and SQL, sufficient to implement features end to end and diagnose data-related issues.
  • Testing: Strong experience with unit testing, Blazor component testing with bUnit and service-level integration testing. Automated UI testing with Playwright is an advantage. You can design testable code and integrate automated tests into delivery pipelines.
  • Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines: Advanced use of Git, branching and pull-request workflows, Azure DevOps repositories and boards, and CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test and deployment.
  • Engineering quality and security: A demonstrated focus on code quality, code reviews, application security, maintainability, observability and reusable components.
  • AI-assisted development: Experience using GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or a similar coding assistant in a professional setting, with sound judgement about when to use these tools and how to review their output.
  • JavaScript and TypeScript interoperability: Knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and JavaScript-Blazor interoperability is an asset, particularly when integrating browser APIs or specialised front-end libraries.
  • Front-end architecture and design patterns: Ability to select and apply suitable patterns for component design, separation of concerns, state management, dependency management and scalable application structures.
  • Performance and browser diagnostics: Experience analysing rendering, network calls, memory usage and client-side performance with browser development tools, together with an understanding of the scalability characteristics of each Blazor render mode.
  • Cloud and containerised environments: Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and an understanding of containerised deployment for application delivery and troubleshooting.
  • Distributed systems: Sufficient understanding of messaging, including Azure Service Bus and NServiceBus, and distributed systems to collaborate effectively with integration-focused colleagues and diagnose end-to-end issues.
  • Additional ecosystem assets: Knowledge of SharePoint as a document management system or of legal document stores with WORM requirements is an asset where relevant to the assigned application domain.

Key soft skills

  • Technical leadership and mentorship: Guide developers, provide constructive feedback, share knowledge and support professional growth while remaining hands-on.
  • Collaboration: Work effectively with analysts, architects, UX stakeholders, security specialists, testers, platform engineering, operations and business representatives in a multidisciplinary public-service environment.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making: Identify root causes, compare options, explain trade-offs and make pragmatic, sustainable technical decisions.
  • User focus: Understand the needs of citizens, healthcare professionals and internal users, including users of assistive technologies, and translate them into clear, accessible and efficient digital experiences.
  • Communication: Explain complex technical matters clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and produce concise, useful technical documentation.
  • Resilience and adaptability: Manage changing technologies, priorities and requirements while maintaining quality, security and delivery commitments.
  • Continuous improvement: Follow relevant developments in .NET, Blazor, web standards, accessibility, security and software engineering, and apply them with sound judgement.

Language proficiency: Mastery of French or Dutch and professional proficiency in English are required. Passive understanding of the second national language is an asset.

Expected seniority

You should be able to work autonomously on complex application challenges, take ownership from requirements through production support, influence technical choices and raise the quality and consistency of the wider development team, particularly on the user-interface side. Seniority must be demonstrated through recent hands-on delivery, not only through coordination or advisory experience.

Demonstrated experience as a front-end developer with a strong .NET and Blazor background.

What You'll Do

  • Team Leadership and Development: Recruit, mentor, coach, and develop software quality engineers. Lead the software and firmware quality function for product software and cloud infrastructure, including the digital health platform.

  • Quality Management System Ownership: Maintain and improve software development, test, and change management procedures, as well as best practices for digital health platform management.

Your Background and Experience

Who we are

WELL Health Technologies is an innovative technology-enabled healthcare company whose overarching objective is to positively impact health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower and support healthcare practitioners and their patients.

WELL has built an innovative practitioner enablement platform that includes comprehensive end to end practice management tools inclusive of virtual care and digital patient engagement capabilities as well as Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and data protection services.
